function concat(...buffers) {

  let i = 0;
  for (const buffer of buffers)

var NON_ASCII = /[^\x00-\x7f]/;
function encode(string) {
  if (typeof string == "string" && string.length >= 128) {
    if (NON_ASCII.test(string))
      throw new TypeError("non-ASCII string encountered in encode()");
    return encoder.encode(string);
  }
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(string.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < string.length; i++) {
    const code = string.charCodeAt(i);
    if (code > 127)
      throw new TypeError("non-ASCII string encountered in encode()");
    bytes[i] = code;
  }
  return bytes;
}
function decodeBase64(encoded, url = false) {
  if (Uint8Array.fromBase64)
    return Uint8Array.fromBase64(encoded, { alphabet: url ? "base64url" : "base64" });
  if (url) {
    if (encoded.includes("+") || encoded.includes("/"))
      throw new TypeError("Invalid base64url");
    encoded = encoded.replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/");
  }
  const binary = atob(encoded), bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++)
    bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
  return bytes;
}

async function verifyCompact(jws, shared, key) {

function validateClaimsSet(protectedHeader, claimsSetBytes, options = {}) {
  let claimsSet;

    claimsSet = JSON.parse(strictDecoder.decode(claimsSetBytes));
  } catch (cause) {

  }

    throw new JWTInvalid("JWT Claims Set must be a top-level JSON object");
  const { typ } = options;
  if (typ !== void 0 && (typeof protectedHeader.typ != "string" || normalizeTyp(protectedHeader.typ) !== normalizeTyp(typ)))
    throw new JWTClaimValidationFailed('unexpected "typ" JWT header value', claimsSet, "typ", checkFailed);
  const { requiredClaims = [], issuer, subject, audience, maxTokenAge } = options, presenceCheck = [...requiredClaims];
  maxTokenAge !== void 0 && presenceCheck.push("iat"), audience !== void 0 && presenceCheck.push("aud"), subject !== void 0 && presenceCheck.push("sub"), issuer !== void 0 && presenceCheck.push("iss");
  for (const claim of new Set(presenceCheck.reverse()))
    if (!Object.hasOwn(claimsSet, claim))
      throw new JWTClaimValidationFailed(`missing required "${claim}" claim`, claimsSet, claim, "missing");
  issuer !== void 0 && !(Array.isArray(issuer) ? issuer : [issuer]).includes(claimsSet.iss) && unexpectedClaim(claimsSet, "iss"), subject !== void 0 && claimsSet.sub !== subject && unexpectedClaim(claimsSet, "sub"), audience !== void 0 && !checkAudiencePresence(claimsSet.aud, typeof audience == "string" ?   const { clockTolerance } = options;
  let tolerance = 0;
  if (typeof clockTolerance == "string")
    tolerance = secs(clockTolerance);
  else if (clockTolerance !== void 0) {
    if (typeof clockTolerance != "number")
      throw new TypeError("Invalid clockTolerance option type");
    tolerance = clockTolerance;
  }
  if (validateInput("clockTolerance option", tolerance), tolerance < 0)
    throw new TypeError("Invalid clockTolerance option input");
  const { currentDate } = options, now = validateInput("currentDate option", epoch(currentDate === void 0 ? /* @__PURE__ */ new Date() : currentDate)), iat = validateNumericDate(claimsSet, "iat", maxTokenAge !== void 0), nbf = validateNumericDate(claimsSet, "nbf");
  if (nbf !== void 0 && nbf > now + tolerance)
    throw new JWTClaimValidationFailed('"nbf" claim timestamp check failed', claimsSet, "nbf", checkFailed);
  const exp = validateNumericDate(claimsSet, "exp");
  if (exp !== void 0 && exp <= now - tolerance)
    throw new JWTExpired('"exp" claim timestamp check failed', claimsSet, "exp", checkFailed);
  if (maxTokenAge !== void 0) {
    const age = now - iat, max = validateInput("maxTokenAge option", typeof maxTokenAge == "number" ? maxTokenAge : secs(maxTokenAge));
    if (max < 0)
      throw new TypeError("Invalid maxTokenAge option input");
    if (age - tolerance > max)
      throw new JWTExpired('"iat" claim timestamp check failed (too far in the past)', claimsSet, "iat", checkFailed);
    if (age < -tolerance)
      throw new JWTClaimValidationFailed('"iat" claim timestamp check failed (it should be in the past)', claimsSet, "iat", checkFailed);
  }
  return claimsSet;
}

async function jwtVerify(jwt, key, options) {
  const [verified, b64] = await verifyCompact(jwt, prepareVerify(options), key);
  if (!b64)
    throw new JWTInvalid("JWTs MUST NOT use unencoded payload");

  return { ...verified, payload };
}

var page = LAB_PAGE;
var take = (start, end) => {
  const a = page.indexOf(start), b = page.indexOf(end, a);
  if (a < 0 || b < 0) throw Error("Workbench page boundary changed: " + start);
  const result = page.slice(a, b);
  page = page.slice(0, a) + page.slice(b);
  return result;
};

// src/interpretation/pipeline.js
var PACKET_VERSION = "passages-v1";
var RESPONSE_VERSION = "candidates-v1";
var VALIDATOR_VERSION = "evidence-v1";
var LIMITS = Object.freeze({
  text: 16e3,
  passages: 32,
  fields: 8,
  records: 50,
  spans: 4,
  quote: 2048,
  response: 131072,
  events: 1e3
});
var encoder2 = new TextEncoder();
var ContractError = class extends Error {
  constructor(code, message2) {
    super(message2);
    this.name = "ContractError";
    this.code = code;
  }
};
function check(ok, code, message2) {
  if (!ok) throw new ContractError(code, message2);
}
function object(v) {
  return v !== null && typeof v === "object" && !Array.isArray(v) && (Object.getPrototypeOf(v) === Object.prototype || Object.getPrototypeOf(v) === null);
}
function keys(v, allowed) {
  return object(v) && Object.keys(v).every((k) => allowed.includes(k));
}
function bounded(s, max) {
  return typeof s === "string" && s.length > 0 && s.length <= max;
}
function canonical(value, depth = 0) {
  check(depth <= 16, "json_depth", "JSON nesting exceeds the limit.");
  if (value === null || typeof value === "string" || typeof value === "boolean")
    return JSON.stringify(value);
  if (typeof value === "number") {
    check(
      Number.isFinite(value),
      "nonfinite_number",
      "Numbers must be finite."
    );
    return JSON.stringify(value);
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value))
    return "[" + Array.from(value, (v) => canonical(v, depth + 1)).join(",") + "]";
  check(object(value), "invalid_json", "Only plain JSON values are supported.");
  return "{" + Object.keys(value).sort().map((k) => JSON.stringify(k) + ":" + canonical(value[k], depth + 1)).join(",") + "}";
}
var copy = (v) => JSON.parse(canonical(v));
async function digest(value) {
  const bytes = await crypto.subtle.digest(
    "SHA-256",
    encoder2.encode(typeof value === "string" ? value : canonical(value))
  );
  return Array.from(
    new Uint8Array(bytes),
    (n) => n.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")
  ).join("");
}
function freeze(v) {
  if (v && typeof v === "object") {
    Object.values(v).forEach(freeze);
    Object.freeze(v);
  }
  return v;
}
function schemaOf(schema) {
  check(
    keys(schema, ["fields"]) && Array.isArray(schema.fields) && schema.fields.length > 0 && schema.fields.length <= LIMITS.fields,
    "invalid_schema",
    "Provide 1\u20138 requested fields."
  );
  const names = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  for (const f of schema.fields) {
    check(
      keys(f, ["name", "type", "required", "min", "max", "number_format"]) && typeof f.name === "string" && /^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,39}$/.test(f.name) && ![
        "constructor",
        "prototype",
        "__proto__",
        "record_id",
        "review_status",
        "validation_issues"
      ].includes(f.name) && !names.has(f.name),
      "invalid_schema",
      "Field names must be unique, safe identifiers."
    );
    check(
      ["string", "number"].includes(f.type) && typeof f.required === "boolean",
      "invalid_schema",
      "Each field requires a string/number type and a required boolean."
    );
    check(
      f.number_format === void 0 || f.type === "number" && f.number_format === "en-US-grouped",
      "invalid_schema",
      "number_format is only supported for numeric en-US-grouped fields."
    );
    for (const k of ["min", "max"])
      if (Object.hasOwn(f, k))
        check(
          f.type === "number" && Number.isFinite(f[k]),
          "invalid_schema",
          "Bounds must be finite and apply only to numeric fields."
        );
    check(
      f.min === void 0 || f.max === void 0 || f.min <= f.max,
      "invalid_schema",
      "Minimum cannot exceed maximum."
    );
    names.add(f.name);
  }
  return copy(schema);
}
async function createPacket({ source, schema }, now = (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toISOString()) {
  check(
    keys(source, ["url", "text"]) && bounded(source.text, LIMITS.text),
    "invalid_source",
    "Provide nonempty source text up to 16,000 UTF-16 code units. Text is never silently truncated."
  );
  let url = null;
  if (source.url !== void 0 && source.url !== null) {
    let u;
    try {
      u = new URL(source.url);
    } catch {
    }
    check(
      u?.protocol === "https:" && !u.username && !u.password && source.url.length <= 2048,
      "invalid_source",
      "Source attribution must be a credential-free HTTPS URL. No URL is fetched in this offline lane."
    );
    url = u.href;
  }
  check(
    typeof now === "string" && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(now)),
    "invalid_timestamp",
    "Invalid receipt timestamp."
  );
  const text = source.text.replace(/\r\n?/g, "\n");
  const passages = [];
  let start = 0;
  const add = (end) => {
    const slice = text.slice(start, end);
    const leading = slice.length - slice.trimStart().length;
    const value = slice.trim();
    if (value)
      passages.push({
        id: "p" + String(passages.length + 1).padStart(3, "0"),
        text: value,
        start: start + leading,
        end: start + leading + value.length
      });
  };
  for (const m of text.matchAll(/\n[ \t]*\n+/g)) {
    add(m.index);
    start = m.index + m[0].length;
  }
  add(text.length);
  check(
    passages.length > 0 && passages.length <= LIMITS.passages,
    "passage_limit",
    "Source must contain 1\u201332 paragraphs. No paragraphs are silently omitted."
  );
  for (const p of passages) p.hash = await digest(p.text);
  const packet = {
    version: PACKET_VERSION,
    source: {
      url,
      provenance: "user_supplied_text",
      received_at: new Date(now).toISOString(),
      text,
      text_hash: await digest(text),
      original_text_hash: await digest(source.text),
      offset_unit: "UTF-16 code units; start inclusive, end exclusive"
    },
    schema: schemaOf(schema),
    passages
  };
  return freeze({ ...packet, hash: await digest(packet) });
}
async function verifyPacket(packet) {
  check(
    keys(packet, ["version", "source", "schema", "passages", "hash"]) && packet.version === PACKET_VERSION,
    "invalid_packet",
    "Unsupported packet format."
  );
  const { hash, ...body } = packet;
  check(
    hash === await digest(body),
    "packet_hash_mismatch",
    "Packet content does not match its hash."
  );
  check(
    keys(packet.source, [
      "url",
      "provenance",
      "received_at",
      "text",
      "text_hash",
      "original_text_hash",
      "offset_unit"
    ]) && packet.source.provenance === "user_supplied_text",
    "invalid_packet",
    "Unsupported source provenance."
  );
  const rebuilt = await createPacket(
    {
      source: { url: packet.source.url, text: packet.source.text },
      schema: packet.schema
    },
    packet.source.received_at
  );
  check(
    packet.source.text_hash === rebuilt.source.text_hash && canonical(packet.passages) === canonical(rebuilt.passages) && canonical(packet.schema) === canonical(rebuilt.schema),
    "invalid_packet",
    "Passage offsets, hashes or schema are inconsistent with the retained snapshot."
  );
  check(
    /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(packet.source.original_text_hash),
    "invalid_packet",
    "Invalid original text hash."
  );
  return packet;
}
var issue = (code, message2) => ({ code, message: message2 });
function evidenceFor(candidate, field, packet) {
  const issues = [], evidence = [];
  if (!object(candidate)) {
    if (field.required)
      issues.push(
        issue(
          "missing_field",
          "No candidate supplied for this required field."
        )
      );
    return { value: null, evidence, issues };
  }
  const value = Object.hasOwn(candidate, "value") ? candidate.value : null;
  if (!keys(candidate, ["value", "evidence"]))
    issues.push(issue("unknown_field_metadata", "Unexpected field metadata."));
  if (value === null) {
    if (field.required)
      issues.push(
        issue("required_value_missing", "A required value is missing.")
      );
    if (candidate.evidence?.length)
      issues.push(
        issue("evidence_without_value", "Evidence supplied without a value.")
      );
    return { value, evidence, issues };
  }
  const correctType = typeof value === field.type && (field.type !== "number" || Number.isFinite(value));
  if (!correctType)
    issues.push(
      issue(
        "wrong_type",
        "Candidate type does not match the requested column."
      )
    );
  if (field.type === "string" && !bounded(value, 2048))
    issues.push(
      issue("invalid_string", "Text values must contain 1\u20132048 code units.")
    );
  if (correctType && field.type === "number" && (field.min !== void 0 && value < field.min || field.max !== void 0 && value > field.max))
    issues.push(
      issue("out_of_bounds", "Number is outside the requested bounds.")
    );
  if (!Array.isArray(candidate.evidence) || candidate.evidence.length === 0 || candidate.evidence.length > LIMITS.spans) {
    issues.push(
      issue(
        "evidence_required",
        "Supply 1\u20134 supporting spans per nonempty field."
      )
    );
    return { value, evidence, issues };
  }
  for (const span of candidate.evidence) {
    if (!keys(span, ["passage_id", "quote", "occurrence"]) || !bounded(span.quote, LIMITS.quote)) {
      issues.push(issue("invalid_evidence", "Malformed supporting span."));
      continue;
    }
    const p = packet.passages.find((p2) => p2.id === span.passage_id);
    if (!p) {
      issues.push(
        issue("unknown_passage", "Evidence references an unknown passage.")
      );
      continue;
    }
    const positions = [];
    let at = 0;
    while (at <= p.text.length) {
      const found = p.text.indexOf(span.quote, at);
      if (found < 0) break;
      positions.push(found);
      at = found + 1;
    }
    if (!positions.length) {
      issues.push(
        issue(
          "quote_not_found",
          "Exact quotation is absent from the cited passage."
        )
      );
      continue;
    }
    const occurrence = span.occurrence ?? (positions.length === 1 ? 0 : null);
    if (!Number.isInteger(occurrence) || occurrence < 0 || occurrence >= positions.length) {
      issues.push(
        issue(
          "ambiguous_quote",
          "Repeated quotations require a valid zero-based occurrence index."
        )
      );
      continue;
    }
    const local = positions[occurrence];
    evidence.push({
      passage_id: p.id,
      quote: span.quote,
      occurrence,
      passage_start: local,
      passage_end: local + span.quote.length,
      source_start: p.start + local,
      source_end: p.start + local + span.quote.length,
      source_hash: packet.source.text_hash
    });
  }
  if (correctType && evidence.length) {
    const supported = field.type === "string" ? evidence.some((e) => e.quote.includes(value)) : evidence.some(
      (e) => Array.from(
        e.quote.matchAll(
          field.number_format === "en-US-grouped" ? /(?<![\w.,])[-+]?(?:\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+(?:\.\d+)?|\d+(?:\.\d+)?|\.\d+)(?!\w|\.\d|,\d)/g : /(?<![\w.,])[-+]?(?:\d+(?:\.\d+)?|\.\d+)(?!\w|\.\d|,\d)/g
        ),
        (m) => Number(field.number_format === "en-US-grouped" ? m[0].replaceAll(",", "") : m[0])
      ).includes(value)
    );
    if (!supported)
      issues.push(
        issue(
          "literal_support_missing",
          field.number_format === "en-US-grouped" ? "The literal value is not supported by a strict en-US-grouped number in the retained quotations." : "The literal value is not supported by the retained quotations. Numeric formatting is limited to signed, ungrouped decimal notation."
        )
      );
  }
  return { value, evidence, issues };
}
async function validateResponse(packet, response) {
  await verifyPacket(packet);
  check(
    encoder2.encode(canonical(response)).byteLength <= LIMITS.response,
    "response_limit",
    "Response exceeds 128 KiB."
  );
  check(
    keys(response, ["version", "records", "outcomes"]) && response.version === RESPONSE_VERSION && Array.isArray(response.records) && response.records.length <= LIMITS.records && Array.isArray(response.outcomes) && response.outcomes.length <= LIMITS.passages,
    "invalid_response",
    "Expected a bounded versioned records/outcomes response."
  );
  const ids = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(), records = [];
  for (const candidate of response.records) {
    check(
      keys(candidate, ["id", "fields", "issues"]) && typeof candidate.id === "string" && /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,60}$/.test(candidate.id) && !ids.has(candidate.id) && object(candidate.fields),
      "invalid_response",
      "Record IDs must be unique, bounded, and accompanied by fields."
    );
    ids.add(candidate.id);
    const fields = {}, issues2 = [
      issue(
        "association_unverified",
        "Literal evidence and valid types do not establish entity/value association. Human review is required."
      )
    ];
    for (const name of Object.keys(candidate.fields))
      if (!packet.schema.fields.some((f) => f.name === name))
        issues2.push(
          issue(
            "unknown_column",
            "Interpreter supplied an unrequested column: " + name.slice(0, 40)
          )
        );
    for (const field of packet.schema.fields)
      fields[field.name] = evidenceFor(
        Object.hasOwn(candidate.fields, field.name) ? candidate.fields[field.name] : null,
        field,
        packet
      );
    if (candidate.issues !== void 0) {
      check(
        Array.isArray(candidate.issues) && candidate.issues.length <= 16 && candidate.issues.every((s) => bounded(s, 256)),
        "invalid_response",
        "Interpreter issues must be a bounded string list."
      );
      for (const text of candidate.issues)
        issues2.push(issue("interpreter_flag", text));
    }
    if (new Set(
      Object.values(fields).flatMap(
        (f) => f.evidence.map((e) => e.passage_id)
      )
    ).size > 1)
      issues2.push(
        issue(
          "cross_passage_association",
          "Support spans multiple passages; the association needs explicit review."
        )
      );
    records.push({
      id: candidate.id,
      fields,
      issues: issues2,
      review_status: "needs_review"
    });
  }
  const outcomes = [], issues = [], seen = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  for (const outcome of response.outcomes) {
    check(
      keys(outcome, ["passage_id", "status", "record_ids", "reason"]) && packet.passages.some((p) => p.id === outcome.passage_id) && !seen.has(outcome.passage_id) && ["records", "no_result"].includes(outcome.status) && Array.isArray(outcome.record_ids) && outcome.record_ids.length <= LIMITS.records && bounded(outcome.reason, 512),
      "invalid_response",
      "Every passage outcome needs valid identity, status, record IDs and reason."
    );
    seen.add(outcome.passage_id);
    check(
      new Set(outcome.record_ids).size === outcome.record_ids.length && outcome.record_ids.every((id) => ids.has(id)) && (outcome.status === "no_result" ? outcome.record_ids.length === 0 : outcome.record_ids.length > 0),
      "invalid_response",
      "Passage outcome record references are inconsistent."
    );
    const supportedIds = new Set(
      records.filter(
        (r) => Object.values(r.fields).some(
          (f) => f.evidence.some((e) => e.passage_id === outcome.passage_id)
        )
      ).map((r) => r.id)
    );
    for (const id of outcome.record_ids)
      if (!supportedIds.has(id))
        issues.push(
          issue(
            "outcome_without_evidence",
            "Record " + id + " is assigned to " + outcome.passage_id + " without supporting evidence."
          )
        );
    for (const id of supportedIds)
      if (!outcome.record_ids.includes(id))
        issues.push(
          issue(
            "unaccounted_record_evidence",
            "Evidence for " + id + " in " + outcome.passage_id + " is not accounted for."
          )
        );
    outcomes.push(copy(outcome));
  }
  for (const p of packet.passages)
    if (!seen.has(p.id)) {
      issues.push(
        issue("unaccounted_passage", "Interpreter did not account for " + p.id)
      );
      outcomes.push({
        passage_id: p.id,
        status: "not_processed",
        record_ids: [],
        reason: "No outcome supplied."
      });
    }
  for (const r of records)
    if (!outcomes.some((o) => o.record_ids.includes(r.id)))
      issues.push(
        issue("unaccounted_record", "No passage outcome accounts for " + r.id)
      );
  return freeze({
    validator_version: packet.schema.fields.some((f) => f.number_format) ? "evidence-grouped-v1" : VALIDATOR_VERSION,
    packet_hash: packet.hash,
    source_hash: packet.source.text_hash,
    status: issues.length ? "incomplete" : records.length ? "candidates_require_review" : "interpreter_reported_no_result",
    records,
    outcomes,
    issues
  });
}
async function scriptedInterpreter(response) {
  const raw = copy(response);
  check(
    encoder2.encode(canonical(raw)).byteLength <= LIMITS.response,
    "response_limit",
    "Scripted response exceeds 128 KiB."
  );
  return Object.freeze({
    identity: Object.freeze({
      id: "scripted",
      version: "1",
      script_hash: await digest(raw)
    }),
    interpret: async () => copy(raw)
  });
}
var keyFor = async (packet, identity) => digest({
  packet_version: PACKET_VERSION,
  response_version: RESPONSE_VERSION,
  packet_hash: packet.hash,
  interpreter: identity
});
async function revalidate(packet, entry) {
  await verifyPacket(packet);
  check(
    keys(entry, [
      "format",
      "key",
      "packet_hash",
      "interpreter",
      "raw_response",
      "raw_hash"
    ]) && entry.format === "response-cache-v1" && entry.packet_hash === packet.hash && entry.key === await keyFor(packet, entry.interpreter) && entry.raw_hash === await digest(entry.raw_response),
    "cache_integrity",
    "Cached raw response or packet identity is inconsistent."
  );
  check(
    keys(entry.interpreter, ["id", "version", "script_hash"]) && entry.interpreter.id === "scripted" && entry.interpreter.version === "1" && entry.interpreter.script_hash === entry.raw_hash,
    "cache_identity",
    "Unsupported or inconsistent interpreter identity."
  );
  return validateResponse(packet, entry.raw_response);
}
async function runInterpretation(packet, interpreter = null, cache2 = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map()) {
  await verifyPacket(packet);
  if (!interpreter)
    return {
      status: "capability_not_configured",
      packet,
      cache_entry: null,
      validation: null,
      issues: [
        issue(
          "interpreter_not_configured",
          "No interpreter configured. No inference or network request was made."
        )
      ]
    };
  check(
    interpreter.identity?.id === "scripted" && typeof interpreter.interpret === "function",
    "unsupported_interpreter",
    "Only an explicit scripted interpreter is enabled."
  );
  const key = await keyFor(packet, interpreter.identity);
  let entry = cache2.get(key), cache_hit = Boolean(entry);
  if (!entry) {
    const raw = copy(await interpreter.interpret(freeze(copy(packet))));
    entry = {
      format: "response-cache-v1",
      key,
      packet_hash: packet.hash,
      interpreter: copy(interpreter.identity),
      raw_response: raw,
      raw_hash: await digest(raw)
    };
    cache2.set(key, freeze(copy(entry)));
  }
  try {
    return {
      status: "validated",
      packet,
      cache_entry: freeze(copy(entry)),
      cache_hit,
      validation: await revalidate(packet, entry)
    };
  } catch (error2) {
    if (!(error2 instanceof ContractError)) throw error2;
    return {
      status: "invalid_response",
      packet,
      cache_entry: freeze(copy(entry)),
      cache_hit,
      validation: null,
      issues: [issue(error2.code, error2.message)]
    };
  }
}
var blocking = (r) => r.issues.some(
  (i) => !["association_unverified", "cross_passage_association"].includes(i.code)
) || Object.values(r.fields).some((f) => f.issues.length);
async function replayReviews(packet, validation, events = []) {
  check(
    validation.packet_hash === packet.hash,
    "review_identity",
    "Validation does not belong to this packet."
  );
  check(
    Array.isArray(events) && events.length <= LIMITS.events,
    "review_limit",
    "Review event limit exceeded."
  );
  const validation_hash = await digest(validation), states = new Map(validation.records.map((r) => [r.id, "needs_review"]));
  let previous = null;
  for (const [index, event] of events.entries()) {
    check(
      keys(event, [
        "sequence",
        "previous_hash",
        "packet_hash",
        "validation_hash",
        "record_id",
        "decision",
        "reviewer",
        "note",
        "confirmed_association",
        "at",
        "hash"
      ]) && event.sequence === index + 1 && event.previous_hash === previous && event.packet_hash === packet.hash && event.validation_hash === validation_hash && states.has(event.record_id),
      "review_identity",
      "Review history is out of order or belongs to a different validation."
    );
    const { hash, ...body } = event;
    check(
      hash === await digest(body),
      "review_integrity",
      "Review event hash mismatch."
    );
    check(
      ["approved", "rejected", "needs_review"].includes(event.decision) && bounded(event.reviewer, 80) && event.reviewer.trim().length > 0 && bounded(event.note, 1e3) && event.note.trim().length > 0 && typeof event.confirmed_association === "boolean" && typeof event.at === "string" && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(event.at)),
      "invalid_review",
      "Malformed review event."
    );
    if (event.decision === "approved")
      check(
        !validation.issues.length && !blocking(validation.records.find((r) => r.id === event.record_id)) && event.confirmed_association,
        "approval_blocked",
        "Approval requires clean independent checks and an explicit human association confirmation."
      );
    states.set(event.record_id, event.decision);
    previous = hash;
  }
  return states;
}
async function appendReview(packet, entry, events, decision, now = (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toISOString()) {
  return appendReviewBatch(packet, entry, events, [decision], now);
}
async function appendReviewBatch(packet, entry, events, decisions, now = (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toISOString()) {
  check(
    Array.isArray(decisions) && decisions.length > 0 && decisions.length <= LIMITS.records,
    "invalid_review",
    "Provide a bounded set of review decisions."
  );
  const validation = await revalidate(packet, entry);
  await replayReviews(packet, validation, events);
  const validationHash = await digest(validation), updated = copy(events);
  for (const decision of decisions) {
    check(
      keys(decision, ["record_id", "decision", "reviewer", "note", "confirmed_association"]),
      "invalid_review",
      "Unexpected review fields."
    );
    const body = {
      ...copy(decision),
      confirmed_association: decision.confirmed_association ?? false,
      sequence: updated.length + 1,
      previous_hash: updated.at(-1)?.hash ?? null,
      packet_hash: packet.hash,
      validation_hash: validationHash,
      at: now
    };
    updated.push({ ...body, hash: await digest(body) });
  }
  await replayReviews(packet, validation, updated);
  return freeze(updated);
}
function quoteCSV(value) {
  let text = String(value ?? "");
  if (/^[\s\u0000-\u001f]*[=+@-]/.test(text)) text = "'" + text;
  return '"' + text.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"';
}
async function exportInterpretation(packet, entry, events = [], { approvedOnly = true } = {}) {
  const validation = await revalidate(packet, entry), states = await replayReviews(packet, validation, events);
  const all = validation.records.map((r) => ({
    ...copy(r),
    review_status: states.get(r.id)
  }));
  const records = approvedOnly ? all.filter((r) => r.review_status === "approved") : all;
  const json2 = {
    kind: approvedOnly ? "approved_interpretation_export" : "interpretation_diagnostic_export",
    counts: {
      total_candidates: all.length,
      exported: records.length,
      excluded: all.length - records.length
    },
    notice: "Scripted candidate data; not AI inference or automatic factual verification. Only explicitly reviewed records may be approved.",
    packet: copy(packet),
    cache_identity: {
      key: entry.key,
      raw_hash: entry.raw_hash,
      interpreter: copy(entry.interpreter)
    },
    validation: { ...copy(validation), records },
    review_events: copy(events)
  };
  if (!approvedOnly) json2.raw_response = copy(entry.raw_response);
  const headers3 = [
    "record_id",
    "review_status",
    ...packet.schema.fields.map((f) => f.name),
    "validation_issues"
  ];
  const csv = [
    headers3,
    ...records.map((r) => [
      r.id,
      r.review_status,
      ...packet.schema.fields.map((f) => r.fields[f.name].value),
      [
        ...r.issues.map((i) => i.code),
        ...Object.entries(r.fields).flatMap(
          ([name, f]) => f.issues.map((i) => name + ":" + i.code)
        ),
        ...validation.issues.map((i) => i.code)
      ].join(";")
    ])
  ].map((row) => row.map(quoteCSV).join(",")).join("\r\n") + "\r\n";
  return { json: json2, csv };
}

// src/public-network.js
var InputError = class extends Error {
  constructor(message2, status = 400) {
    super(message2);
    this.status = status;
  }
};
function publicURL(input) {
  if (!input || input.length > 2048) throw new InputError("Enter a public HTTPS URL (up to 2048 characters).");
  let url;
  try {
    url = new URL(input);
  } catch {
    throw new InputError("Enter a valid public HTTPS URL.");
  }
  const host = url.hostname.toLowerCase();
  if (url.protocol !== "https:" || url.username || url.password || url.port && url.port !== "443" || host.length > 253 || host.endsWith(".") || !host.includes(".") || !/^[a-z0-9.-]+$/.test(host) || host.split(".").some((label) => label.length > 63 || !/^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$/.test(label)) || /^[0-9.]+$/.test(host) || /(?:^|\.)(localhost|local|internal|test|invalid|example|onion|home|lan)$/.test(host)) {
    throw new InputError("Use a public HTTPS hostname without credentials, IP addresses, or custom ports.");
  }
  url.hash = "";
  return url;
}
function publicAddress(ip) {
  if (ip.includes(":")) {
    return /^[23][0-9a-f]{3}:/i.test(ip) && !/^200[12]:|^3fff:/i.test(ip);
  }
  const octets = ip.split(".").map(Number);
  if (octets.length !== 4 || octets.some((n) => !Number.isInteger(n) || n < 0 || n > 255)) return false;
  const [a, b, c] = octets;
  return !(a === 0 || a === 10 || a === 127 || a >= 224 || a === 100 && b >= 64 && b <= 127 || a === 169 && b === 254 || a === 172 && b >= 16 && b <= 31 || a === 192 && (b === 168 || b === 0 || b === 88 && c === 99) || a === 198 && (b === 18 || b === 19 || b === 51 && c === 100) || a === 203 && b === 0 && c === 113);
}

// src/interpretation/workspace-core.js
var fail = (message2) => {
  throw new ContractError("workspace", message2);
};
var safeText = (s, max) => typeof s === "string" && s.trim() && s.length <= max;
var WORKSPACE_FORMAT = "toolkit-workspace-v1";
function validateRecipe(r) {
  if (!r || r.version !== "table-recipe-v1" || !safeText(r.id, 64) || !safeText(r.name, 100) || !safeText(r.host, 253) || !Array.isArray(r.headers) || r.headers.length < 2 || r.headers.length > 100 || r.headers.some((h) => !safeText(h, 2048)) || !Array.isArray(r.columns) || r.columns.length < 2 || r.columns.length > 8 || new Set(r.columns).size !== r.columns.length || r.columns.some((i) => !Number.isInteger(i) || i < 0 || i >= r.headers.length) || !Number.isInteger(r.first_row) || !Number.isInteger(r.last_row) || r.first_row < 1 || r.last_row < r.first_row || r.last_row - r.first_row >= 50 || r.title !== null && !safeText(r.title, 2048)) fail("Saved table settings are invalid.");
  return r;
}
function matchRecipe(recipe, tables, url) {
  validateRecipe(recipe);
  if (new URL(publicURL(url)).hostname !== recipe.host) return { status: "no_match", reason: "The saved settings belong to a different hostname." };
  const matches = tables.filter((t) => t.source_columns === recipe.headers.length && t.columns.length === recipe.headers.length && t.columns.every((c, i) => c.index === i && c.label === recipe.headers[i]) && (recipe.title === null || t.title === recipe.title));
  if (matches.length !== 1) return { status: matches.length ? "ambiguous" : "no_match", reason: matches.length ? "More than one table has these headings. Choose a table manually." : "The source headings or caption changed. Choose a table manually." };
  return { status: "matched", table: matches[0], options: { columns: recipe.columns, first_row: recipe.first_row, last_row: recipe.last_row } };
}
function workspaceShape(w) {
  if (!w || w.format !== WORKSPACE_FORMAT || !/^[-a-zA-Z0-9]{8,64}$/.test(w.id) || !safeText(w.name, 100) || !Array.isArray(w.recipes) || w.recipes.length > 20 || !Array.isArray(w.entries) || w.entries.length > 10 || !Array.isArray(w.history) || w.history.length > 200 || w.history.some((h) => !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(h))) fail("Workspace supports ten sources, twenty saved settings and 200 saved revisions.");
  if (w.modified_at !== void 0 && (typeof w.modified_at !== "string" || !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(w.modified_at)))) fail("Workspace modification time is invalid.");
  if (new Set(w.recipes.map((r) => r.id)).size !== w.recipes.length) fail("Saved setting IDs must be distinct.");
  w.recipes.forEach(validateRecipe);
  const ids = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  for (const entry of w.entries) {
    if (!entry || !safeText(entry.id, 64) || ids.has(entry.id) || !["queued", "fetching", "select", "ready", "failed"].includes(entry.status) || typeof entry.message !== "string" || entry.message.length > 1e3) fail("Workspace source entries are invalid.");
    ids.add(entry.id);
    publicURL(entry.url);
    if (entry.job) publicURL(entry.job.packet.source.url);
  }
  if (new TextEncoder().encode(canonical(w)).byteLength > 35e5) fail("Workspace exceeds 3.5 MB. Keep fewer source snapshots or export separate workspaces.");
  return w;
}
async function makeWorkspaceSnapshot(w) {
  workspaceShape(w);
  const workspace = structuredClone(w);
  const id = await digest(workspace);
  return { format: "toolkit-workspace-snapshot-v1", id, workspace };
}
async function verifyWorkspaceSnapshot(s) {
  if (!s || s.format !== "toolkit-workspace-snapshot-v1" || s.id !== await digest(s.workspace)) fail("Saved workspace checksum differs.");
  workspaceShape(s.workspace);
  return s;
}
var quoteWorkspaceCSV = (value) => {
  let s = String(value ?? "");
  if (/^[\s\u0000-\u001f]*[=+@-]/.test(s)) s = "'" + s;
  return '"' + s.replaceAll('"', '""') + '"';
};

  return digest(job.packet.schema);
}

// src/interpretation/requested-task.js
var TASK_VERSION = "requested-columns-v1";
function validateTask(task) {
  if (!task || Object.keys(task).some((k) => !["description", "diagram_relevance", "relevance_note"].includes(k)) || typeof task.description !== "string" || !task.description.trim() || task.description.length > 2e3 || !["undecided", "supplementary", "include", "exclude"].includes(task.diagram_relevance) || typeof task.relevance_note !== "string" || task.relevance_note.length > 1e3 || task.diagram_relevance === "exclude" && !task.relevance_note.trim()) throw new ContractError("invalid_task", "Describe the requested output and record a reason before excluding diagrams.");

}
function emptyTaskResponse(packet) {
  return { version: "candidates-v1", records: [], outcomes: packet.passages.map((p) => ({ passage_id: p.id, status: "no_result", record_ids: [], reason: "Requested columns are ready. No automatic rule or provider result has supplied records for this task; inspect the source or add a candidate manually." })) };

}

// src/interpretation/evidence-context.js
function evidenceContext(source, evidence, { document = false } = {}) {
  const start = document ? evidence.document_start : evidence.source_start, end = document ? evidence.document_end : evidence.source_end;
  if (typeof source !== "string" || !Number.isInteger(start) || !Number.isInteger(end) || start < 0 || end < start || end > source.length || source.slice(start, end) !== evidence.quote) return null;
  const from = Math.max(0, start - 350), to = Math.min(source.length, end + 350);
  return { before: source.slice(from, start), quote: source.slice(start, end), after: source.slice(end, to), start: from, end: to, truncated_before: from > 0, truncated_after: to < source.length, scope: document ? "retained page" : "current source snapshot" };
}

// src/interpretation/text-rules.js
function extractTextRules(packet) {
  if (packet.schema.fields.length !== 2 || packet.schema.fields[0].type !== "string" || packet.schema.fields[1].type !== "number")
    throw new ContractError("rule_schema", "The text parser needs a text column followed by a numeric column.");
  const [name, number2] = packet.schema.fields.map((f) => f.name);
  const records = [], outcomes = [];
  for (const p of packet.passages) {
    const ids = [];
    let cursor = 0;
    for (const line of p.text.split(/\n|(?<=[.!?])\s+(?=[A-Z])/)) {
      const quote = line.trim();
      const position = p.text.indexOf(quote, cursor);
      cursor = position + quote.length;
      let occurrence = 0, found = p.text.indexOf(quote);
      while (found >= 0 && found < position) {
        occurrence++;
        found = p.text.indexOf(quote, found + 1);
      }
      const match = quote.match(/^(.{1,120}?)\s*(?::|\s+(?:scored|received a score of|was given a score of))\s*([-+]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\.?$/i);
      if (!match || !/[\p{L}]/u.test(match[1]) || !Number.isFinite(Number(match[2]))) continue;
      if (records.length >= LIMITS.records) throw new ContractError("record_limit", "More than 50 rule matches. Use a smaller passage; no matches were silently dropped.");
      const id = "row-" + (records.length + 1);
      const span = { passage_id: p.id, quote, occurrence };
      const record = { id, fields: {
        [name]: { value: match[1].trim(), evidence: [span] },
        [number2]: { value: Number(match[2]), evidence: [span] }
      } };
      if (/\b(correct(?:ion|ed)?|revised|not|never|instead|however|previously|disputed)\b/i.test(p.text))
        record.issues = ["This paragraph includes correction, negation or uncertainty wording. The rule match needs a manually corrected candidate with supporting quotations."];
      records.push(record);
      ids.push(id);
    }
    outcomes.push({
      passage_id: p.id,
      status: ids.length ? "records" : "no_result",
      record_ids: ids,
      reason: ids.length ? "Matched a limited name/number grammar; human association review is still required." : "No supported name/number pattern matched. This does not mean the paragraph contains no useful data. Add a candidate manually or reformat the source in a new session."
    });
  }
  return { version: "candidates-v1", records, outcomes };
}

// src/interpretation/prose-rules.js
var PROSE_VERSION = "prose-facts-v2";
var LEGACY_PROSE_VERSION = "prose-facts-v1";
var PROSE_SCHEMA = { fields: [
  { name: "measure", type: "string", required: true },
  { name: "value", type: "number", required: true },
  { name: "unit", type: "string", required: false },
  { name: "qualifier", type: "string", required: false }
] };
var number = "[-+]?\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?";
var qualifiers = "over|more than|at least|about|approximately|roughly|nearly|under|less than|up to|at most";
var counts = "areas|states|employees|workers|establishments|respondents|participants|schools|hospitals|people|households|companies|students|patients";
var flags = /\b(correct(?:ion|ed)?|revised|no|not|never|instead|however|previously|disputed|forecast|projected|estimated)\b/i;
function extractProseRules(packet, version = PROSE_VERSION) {
  if (canonical(packet.schema) !== canonical(PROSE_SCHEMA))
    throw new ContractError("prose_schema", "Automatic prose mode uses its suggested measure/value/unit/qualifier columns.");
  const records = [], outcomes = [];
  for (const passage of packet.passages) {
    const ids = [], seen = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
    const masked = passage.text.replace(/https?:\/\/[^\s)"<>]+/g, (s) => " ".repeat(s.length));
    const sentences2 = [...masked.matchAll(/[^.!?\n]*(?:\.(?!\s|$)[^.!?\n]*)*(?:[.!?](?=\s|$)|$)/g)].filter((m) => m[0].trim());
    for (const sentence of sentences2) {
      const raw = passage.text.slice(sentence.index, sentence.index + sentence[0].length).trim();
      const searchable = sentence[0].trim();
      const add = (measure2, value, unit = null, qualifier = null, uncertain = false, quoteOverride = null) => {
        const quote = quoteOverride || raw;
        measure2 = measure2.trim().replace(/[\s,;:.]+$/, "");
        if (!measure2 || !/[\p{L}]/u.test(measure2)) return;
        if (quote.length > LIMITS.quote) throw new ContractError("quote_limit", "A matched sentence exceeds the 2,048-character evidence limit. Paste a smaller section.");
        const key = canonical([measure2, value, unit, qualifier, sentence.index]);
        if (seen.has(key)) return;
        seen.add(key);
        if (records.length >= LIMITS.records) throw new ContractError("record_limit", "More than 50 suggested facts. Paste a smaller section; nothing was silently truncated.");
        const id = "row-" + (records.length + 1);
        const local = passage.text.indexOf(quote, sentence.index);
        let occurrence = 0, found = passage.text.indexOf(quote);
        while (found >= 0 && found < local) {
          occurrence++;
          found = passage.text.indexOf(quote, found + 1);
        }
        const evidence = [{ passage_id: passage.id, quote, occurrence }];
        const field = (v) => ({ value: v, evidence: v === null ? [] : evidence });
        const candidate = { id, fields: { measure: field(measure2), value: field(value), unit: field(unit), qualifier: field(qualifier) } };
        if (flags.test(searchable) || uncertain)
          candidate.issues = [version === LEGACY_PROSE_VERSION ? "This sentence contains uncertainty, correction, negation or a percentage outside 0\u2013100. Inspect the context and explicitly correct the candidate before approval." : "This sentence contains uncertainty, correction, negation, ambiguous context or a percentage outside 0\u2013100. Inspect the context and explicitly correct the candidate before approval."];
        records.push(candidate);
        ids.push(id);
      };
      const current = version !== LEGACY_PROSE_VERSION;
      let accountedMatch = false;
      if (current) {
        const share = searchable.match(new RegExp("^(.{1,240}?)\\s+accounted for\\s+(" + number + ")\\s*(percent|%)\\s+of\\s+(.+?)(?:,\\s+followed by\\s+.+)?\\.?$", "i"));
        if (share) {
          const listAt = searchable.search(/,\s+followed by\b/i);
          add(
            share[1],
            Number(share[2]),
            share[3],
            null,
            Number(share[2]) < 0 || Number(share[2]) > 100,
            listAt >= 0 ? raw.slice(0, listAt) : raw
          );
          accountedMatch = true;
        }
      }
      if (current) {
        let previousEnd = 0;
        for (const m of searchable.matchAll(new RegExp("\\(\\s*(" + number + ")\\s*(percent|%)\\s*\\)", "gi"))) {
          let subject = searchable.slice(previousEnd, m.index).trim();
          previousEnd = m.index + m[0].length;
          const listIntro = [...subject.matchAll(/\b(?:followed by|included|include|including)\s+/gi)].at(-1);
          if (listIntro) subject = subject.slice(listIntro.index + listIntro[0].length);
          else if (subject.includes(":")) subject = subject.slice(subject.lastIndexOf(":") + 1);
          subject = subject.replace(/^[\s,;]+/, "").replace(/^(?:and|or)\s+/i, "").trim();
          if (!subject || subject.length > 180 || /\d|[.!?]/.test(subject)) continue;
          const subjectAt = searchable.lastIndexOf(subject, m.index);
          add(
            subject,
            Number(m[1]),
            m[2],
            null,
            Number(m[1]) < 0 || Number(m[1]) > 100,
            subjectAt >= 0 ? raw.slice(subjectAt, m.index + m[0].length) : raw
          );
        }
      }
      const based = new RegExp("(?<![\\w.,-])(?:(" + qualifiers + ")\\s+)?(" + number + ")\\s*(percent|%)\\s+(?:based on|of)\\s+([^.;!?]+?)(?=\\s+(?:and|or)\\s+(?:(?:" + qualifiers + ")\\s+)?" + number + "\\s*(?:percent|%)|[.;!?]|$)", "gi");
      let rateFound = false;
      for (const m of searchable.matchAll(based)) {
        if (current && accountedMatch) continue;
        const ambiguous = current && /\b(?:followed by|compared (?:to|with)|respectively|whereas|while)\b/i.test(m[4]);
        add(m[4], Number(m[2]), m[3], m[1] || null, Number(m[2]) < 0 || Number(m[2]) > 100 || ambiguous);
        rateFound = true;
      }
      const percentCount = [...searchable.matchAll(new RegExp(number + "\\s*(?:percent|%)", "gi"))].length;
      if (!accountedMatch && !rateFound && percentCount === 1) {
        const m = searchable.match(new RegExp("^(.{1,180}?)\\s*(?::\\s*|\\s+(?:was|were|is|are|reached|totaled|at)\\s+)(?:(" + qualifiers + ")\\s+)?(" + number + ")\\s*(percent|%)\\.?$", "i"));
        if (m) add(m[1], Number(m[3]), m[4], m[2] || null, Number(m[3]) < 0 || Number(m[3]) > 100);
      }
      const count = new RegExp("(?<![\\w.,-])(?:(" + qualifiers + ")\\s+)?(" + number + ")\\s+(" + counts + ")\\b", "gi");
      for (const m of searchable.matchAll(count)) add(m[3], Number(m[2]), m[3], m[1] || null);
    }
    if (!ids.length) {
      const pairPacket = { ...packet, passages: [passage], schema: { fields: [
        { name: "measure", type: "string", required: true },
        { name: "value", type: "number", required: true }
      ] } };
      for (const r of extractTextRules(pairPacket).records) {
        if (Object.values(r.fields).some((f) => f.evidence.some((e) => /https?:\/\//i.test(e.quote)))) continue;
        if (records.length >= LIMITS.records) throw new ContractError("record_limit", "More than 50 suggestions. Paste a smaller section.");
        r.id = "row-" + (records.length + 1);
        r.fields.unit = { value: null, evidence: [] };
        r.fields.qualifier = { value: null, evidence: [] };
        records.push(r);
        ids.push(r.id);
      }
    }
    outcomes.push({
      passage_id: passage.id,
      status: ids.length ? "records" : "no_result",
      record_ids: ids,
      reason: ids.length ? "Suggested explicit rates, count quantities or name/number pairs. Other information in this paragraph may be unrecognized; this is not a complete interpretation." : "No supported quantitative relationship was recognized. The text is retained. Add a candidate manually; arbitrary prose understanding is not enabled."
    });
  }
  return { version: "candidates-v1", records, outcomes };
}

// src/interpretation/quantity-rules.js
var QUANTITY_VERSION = "quantitative-prose-v1";
var QUANTITY_SCHEMA = { fields: PROSE_SCHEMA.fields.map((f) => f.name === "value" ? { ...f, number_format: "en-US-grouped", min: -Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, max: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER } : { ...f }) };

function hasRichQuantities(text) {
  return typeof text === "string" && text.length <= 16e3 && (/\$\s*[+-]?\d/.test(mask(text)) || /\b\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+(?:\.\d+)?\s+(?:workers|employees|users|articles|pages|people|households|companies|students|patients)\b/i.test(mask(text)));

function extractQuantities(packet) {

  }
  for (const p of packet.passages) {

      const basis = s.match(/\b(hourly|annually|annual|per hour|per year)\b/i)?.[0] || null;
      let end = 0;
      for (const m2 of s.matchAll(new RegExp("\\(\\s*\\$\\s*(" + amount + ")\\s*\\)", "g"))) {
        let label = s.slice(end, m2.index).trim();
        end = m2.index + m2[0].length;
        const intro = [...label.matchAll(/\b(?:included|include|including|followed by)\s+/gi)].at(-1);
        if (intro) label = label.slice(intro.index + intro[0].length);
        else if (label.includes(":")) label = label.slice(label.lastIndexOf(":") + 1);
        label = label.replace(/^[\s,;]+/, "").replace(/^(?:and|or)\s+/i, "").trim();
        if (label.length > 180 || /[\d.!?]/.test(label)) continue;
        const start = s.lastIndexOf(label, m2.index), quote = basis ? raw : raw.slice(start, m2.index + m2[0].length);
        add(p, quote, label, Number(m2[1].replaceAll(",", "")), "$", basis, uncertain);
      }
      let m = s.match(new RegExp("^(.{1,180}?)\\s+(?:was|were|is|are|reached|totaled|costs?|earned|reported revenue of|had revenue of)\\s+(?:(about|approximately|roughly|over|at least)\\s+)?\\$\\s*(" + amount + ")(?:\\s+(?:per hour|per year|hourly|annually))?[.!?]?$", "i"));
      if (m) add(p, raw, m[1], Number(m[3].replaceAll(",", "")), "$", m[2] || basis, uncertain);
      const wage = s.match(new RegExp("^(.{1,180}?)\\s+had\\s+(?:an?|the)\\s+(?:average\\s+)?(?:\\(mean\\)\\s+)?hourly wage of\\s+\\$\\s*(" + amount + ")(?=\\s|[,.!?]|$)", "i"));
      if (wage) {
        add(p, raw, wage[1], Number(wage[2].replaceAll(",", "")), "$", s.match(/hourly/i)[0], uncertain);
        const other = s.match(new RegExp("compared (?:to|with) (?:the )?(nationwide average) of\\s+\\$\\s*(" + amount + ")", "i"));
        if (other) add(p, raw, other[1], Number(other[2].replaceAll(",", "")), "$", s.match(/hourly/i)[0], uncertain);
      }
      for (const count of s.matchAll(/(?<![\w.,-])((?:\d{1,3})(?:,\d{3})+(?:\.\d+)?)\s+(workers|employees|users|articles|pages|people|households|companies|students|patients)\b/gi)) {
        const subject = s.match(new RegExp("^(.{1,150}?)\\s+(?:has|had|employs|employed|reported)\\s+" + count[1].replaceAll(",", "[,]") + "\\s+" + count[2] + "[.!?]?$", "i"))?.[1];
        add(p, raw, subject || count[2], Number(count[1].replaceAll(",", "")), count[2], null, uncertain);
      }
    }
  }
  for (const r of records) if (Number.isInteger(r.fields.value.value) && !Number.isSafeInteger(r.fields.value.value)) r.issues = [...r.issues || [], "This integer exceeds safe numeric precision. Retain its exact source text; do not approve a rounded numeric value."];
  return { version: "candidates-v1", records, outcomes: packet.passages.map((p) => {
    const ids = records.filter((r) => Object.values(r.fields).some((f) => f.evidence.some((e) => e.passage_id === p.id))).map((r) => r.id);
    return { passage_id: p.id, status: ids.length ? "records" : "no_result", record_ids: ids, reason: ids.length ? "Explicit quantities recognized, including supported dollar amounts and grouped counts. Coverage may be incomplete." : "No supported quantitative relationship recognized. Text is retained; numbers alone are not interpreted." };
  }) };
}

// src/interpretation/ranking-rules.js
var RANKING_VERSION = "semantic-ranking-v1";
var fail2 = (message2) => {
  throw new ContractError("ranking_limit", message2);
};
function rankShape(headers3) {
  const period = headers3.findIndex((h) => /^(?:year|date|period|season)$/i.test(h.trim()));
  const ranks = headers3.map((h, i) => {
    const m = h.trim().match(/^(?:#\s*|rank\s+)(\d{1,3})$/i);
    return m ? { index: i, rank: Number(m[1]), label: h.trim() } : null;
  }).filter(Boolean);
  if (period >= 0 && ranks.length === headers3.length - 1 && ranks.every((r) => r.rank > 0) && new Set(ranks.map((r) => r.rank)).size === ranks.length) return { period, ranks, wide: true, periodLabel: headers3[period].trim() };
  const rank = headers3.findIndex((h) => /^(?:rank|position|place)$/i.test(h.trim()));
  const item = headers3.findIndex((h) => /^(?:item|title|name|article|topic|entry)$/i.test(h.trim()));
  if (rank >= 0 && item >= 0 && headers3.length === (period < 0 ? 2 : 3)) return { period, rank, item, wide: false, periodLabel: period >= 0 ? headers3[period].trim() : null };
  return null;
}
function rankingPlan(text) {
  if (typeof text !== "string" || text.length > LIMITS.text) return null;
  const lines = [];
  let start = 0;
  for (const raw of text.split("\n")) {
    if (raw.trim()) lines.push({ quote: raw.trim(), start: start + raw.length - raw.trimStart().length });
    start += raw.length + 1;
  }
  let header, shape, delimiter, headerIndex;
  for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(5, lines.length); i++) {
    const value = lines[i].quote;
    if (value.startsWith("Table context: ")) continue;
    const split = value.includes("	") ? "	" : value.includes("|") ? "|" : ",";
    if (split === "," && value.includes('"')) continue;
    let cells = value.split(split).map((v) => v.trim());
    if (split === "|") {
      if (!cells[0]) cells.shift();
      if (!cells.at(-1)) cells.pop();
    }
    const found = rankShape(cells);
    if (found) {
      header = { ...lines[i], cells };
      shape = found;
      delimiter = split;
      headerIndex = i;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (!shape) return null;
  const rows = [], unrecognized = [];
  for (const line of lines.slice(headerIndex + 1)) {
    if (delimiter === "|" && /^\|?[\s:|-]+\|?$/.test(line.quote)) continue;
    if (delimiter === "," && line.quote.includes('"')) {
      unrecognized.push(line);
      continue;
    }
    let cells = line.quote.split(delimiter).map((v) => v.trim());
    if (delimiter === "|") {
      if (!cells[0]) cells.shift();
      if (!cells.at(-1)) cells.pop();
    }
    if (cells.every((c, i) => c === header.cells[i])) continue;
    if (cells.length !== header.cells.length) {
      unrecognized.push(line);
      continue;
    }
    rows.push({ ...line, cells });
  }
  if (!rows.length) return null;
  const factCount = rows.length * (shape.wide ? shape.ranks.length : 1);
  if (factCount > LIMITS.records) fail2("This ranking produces more than 50 ranked items. Paste fewer source rows or fetch a bounded ranking selection.");
  const context = lines.slice(0, headerIndex).find((l) => l.quote.startsWith("Table context: "));
  const caption = context?.quote.slice("Table context: ".length) || null;
  const metricMatch = caption?.match(/\b(most\s+(?:viewed|popular|visited|read|watched|downloaded)|best[- ]selling|highest[- ]rated|top[- ]ranked)\b(?:\s+(.+?))?(?=\s+(?:of|on|in|by|for)\b|\[\d|$)/i);
  const metric = metricMatch?.[1] || null, category = metricMatch?.[2]?.trim() || null;
  const periodKey = shape.periodLabel ? shape.periodLabel.toLowerCase() : "period";
  const fields = [...shape.period >= 0 ? [{ name: periodKey, type: "string", required: true }] : [], { name: "rank", type: "number", required: true, min: 1, max: 999 }, { name: "item", type: "string", required: true }, ...metric ? [{ name: "metric", type: "string", required: true }] : [], ...category ? [{ name: "category", type: "string", required: true }] : []];
  return { header, shape, rows, context, caption, metric, category, periodKey, schema: { fields }, factCount, unrecognized };
}
function sourceSpan(packet, line) {
  const quote = line.quote.trim(), start = line.start + line.quote.length - line.quote.trimStart().length;
  const p = packet.passages.find((p2) => start >= p2.start && start + quote.length <= p2.end);
  if (!p || quote.length > LIMITS.quote) fail2("Ranking evidence is outside a retained passage or exceeds the evidence limit.");
  let occurrence = 0, at = p.text.indexOf(quote);
  while (at >= 0 && p.start + at < start) {
    occurrence++;
    at = p.text.indexOf(quote, at + 1);
  }
  return { passage_id: p.id, quote, occurrence };
}
function extractRanking(packet) {
  const plan = rankingPlan(packet.source.text);
  if (!plan || canonical(plan.schema) !== canonical(packet.schema)) fail2("Ranking columns do not match the explicit source header.");
  const header = sourceSpan(packet, plan.header), context = plan.context ? sourceSpan(packet, plan.context) : null, records = [];
  for (const row of plan.rows) {
    const rowSpan = sourceSpan(packet, row);
    const positions = plan.shape.wide ? plan.shape.ranks : [{ index: plan.shape.item, rank: /^[1-9]\d{0,2}$/.test(row.cells[plan.shape.rank]) ? Number(row.cells[plan.shape.rank]) : null }];
    for (const position of positions) {
      const field = (value, evidence) => ({ value: value || value === 0 ? value : null, evidence: value || value === 0 ? evidence : [] });
      const fields = { ...plan.shape.period >= 0 ? { [plan.periodKey]: field(row.cells[plan.shape.period], [rowSpan, header]) } : {}, rank: field(position.rank, [header, rowSpan]), item: field(row.cells[position.index], [rowSpan, header]), ...plan.metric ? { metric: field(plan.metric, [context]) } : {}, ...plan.category ? { category: field(plan.category, [context]) } : {} };
      records.push({ id: "row-" + (records.length + 1), fields });
    }
  }
  return { version: "candidates-v1", records, outcomes: packet.passages.map((p) => {
    const ids = records.filter((r) => Object.values(r.fields).some((f) => f.evidence.some((e) => e.passage_id === p.id))).map((r) => r.id);
    return { passage_id: p.id, status: ids.length ? "records" : "no_result", record_ids: ids, reason: ids.length ? "Explicit source rank positions, item names and period/caption context retained. No numeric popularity score was inferred." : "Text outside the supported ranking remains retained and unprocessed." };
  }) };
}
function rankingMeaning(packet) {
  const p = rankingPlan(packet.source.text);
  return {
    kind: "ranking",
    title: "Ranked items",
    context: p.caption,
    metric: p.metric,
    category: p.category,
    source_rows: p.rows.length,
    record_count: p.factCount,
    explanation: p.metric ? "Ranks come from the explicit headers; the ranking measure and category come from the quoted caption. Item names remain text." : "Ranks come from explicit headers. No ranking measure was supplied in the snapshot; popularity, views or scores were not inferred.",
    context_evidence: p.context ? sourceSpan(packet, p.context) : null,
    unsupported_items: p.unrecognized.length
  };
}

function descriptiveTableName(title, headers3) {
  const actual = String(title || "").slice(0, 180);
  if (!/^(?:Accessible table|Table) \d+$/i.test(actual)) return (/^item$/i.test(headers3[0]) && /^count$/i.test(headers3[1]) ? actual + " \u2014 item counts" : actual).slice(0, 180);
  const lead = headers3[0] || "Rows", others = headers3.slice(1, 4).join(", ");
  return (lead + " comparison" + (others ? " \u2014 " + others + (headers3.length > 4 ? "\u2026" : "") : "")).slice(0, 180);
}
function capturedTableCatalog(datasets) {
  const groups2 = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  for (const d of datasets) {
    if (!d.grid) continue;
    if (!groups2.has(d.table_key)) groups2.set(d.table_key, []);
    groups2.get(d.table_key).push(d);
  }
  const catalog = [];
  for (const [key, parts] of groups2) {
    const columns = [...new Set(parts.flatMap((p) => p.column_indices))].sort((a, b) => a - b), labels = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map(), rows = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    for (const part of parts) {
      part.column_indices.forEach((c, i) => {
        if (labels.has(c) && labels.get(c) !== part.grid.headers[i]) fail3("Captured column headings disagree.");
        labels.set(c, part.grid.headers[i]);
      });
      part.grid.rows.forEach((cells, i) => {
        const row = part.row_start + i;
        if (!rows.has(row)) rows.set(row, /* @__PURE__ */ new Map());
        const target = rows.get(row);
        part.column_indices.forEach((c, j) => {
          if (target.has(c) && target.get(c) !== cells[j]) fail3("Overlapping captured cells disagree.");
          target.set(c, cells[j]);
        });
      });
    }
    const parent = { version: "captured-table-v1", key, title: parts[0].table_title, name: parts[0].table_name, source_rows: parts[0].total_rows, source_columns: parts[0].total_columns, columns: columns.map((index) => ({ index, label: labels.get(index) })), rows: [...rows].sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]).map(([index, cells]) => ({ index, cells: columns.map((c) => cells.has(c) ? cells.get(c) : null) })) };
    catalog.push(parent);
  }
  return catalog;
}
function validateParent(p) {
  if (!p || p.version !== "captured-table-v1" || typeof p.key !== "string" || p.key.length > 100 || typeof p.title !== "string" || p.title.length > 2048 || /[\t\r\n]/.test(p.title) || typeof p.name !== "string" || p.name.length > 180 || !Number.isInteger(p.source_rows) || p.source_rows < 1 || p.source_rows > 5e3 || !Number.isInteger(p.source_columns) || p.source_columns < 2 || p.source_columns > 100 || !Array.isArray(p.columns) || p.columns.length < 2 || p.columns.length > 100 || !Array.isArray(p.rows) || !p.rows.length || p.rows.length > 800 || canonical(p).length > 5e5) fail3("Captured table is outside the supported size or shape.");
  if (p.columns.some((c, i) => !Number.isInteger(c.index) || c.index < 0 || c.index >= p.source_columns || i && c.index <= p.columns[i - 1].index || typeof c.label !== "string" || c.label.length > 2048)) fail3("Captured source columns must be distinct and ordered.");
  if (p.rows.some((r, i) => !Number.isInteger(r.index) || r.index < 1 || r.index > p.source_rows || i && r.index <= p.rows[i - 1].index || !Array.isArray(r.cells) || r.cells.length !== p.columns.length || r.cells.some((c) => c !== null && (typeof c !== "string" || c.length > 2048 || /[\t\n\r]/.test(c))))) fail3("Captured source rows must retain their original positions and cells.");
}
async function selectCapturedTable(parent, options) {
  validateParent(parent);
  if (!options || Object.keys(options).some((k) => !["columns", "first_row", "last_row"].includes(k)) || !Array.isArray(options.columns) || options.columns.length < 2 || options.columns.length > 8 || new Set(options.columns).size !== options.columns.length || options.columns.some((c) => !Number.isInteger(c) || !parent.columns.some((p) => p.index === c))) fail3("Choose 2\u20138 distinct captured columns.");
  if (!Number.isInteger(options.first_row) || !Number.isInteger(options.last_row) || options.first_row < 1 || options.last_row < options.first_row || options.last_row > parent.source_rows) fail3("Choose a valid source row range.");
  const selected = parent.rows.filter((r) => r.index >= options.first_row && r.index <= options.last_row);
  if (selected.length !== options.last_row - options.first_row + 1) fail3("That row range includes rows that were not captured. Choose a smaller captured range.");
  if (selected.length > 50) fail3("Choose no more than 50 source rows per review.");
  const positions = options.columns.map((c) => parent.columns.findIndex((p) => p.index === c)), headers3 = positions.map((i) => parent.columns[i].label), rows = selected.map((r) => positions.map((i) => {
    if (r.cells[i] === null) fail3("A selected cell was not captured. Choose available rows and columns.");
    return r.cells[i];
  }));
  const line = (cells) => cells.join("	"), ranked = rankShape(headers3), context = ranked && parent.title.length <= 500 ? "Table context: " + parent.title + "\n\n" : "";
  if (headers3.some((h) => /[\t\n\r]/.test(h)) || [headers3, ...rows].some((r) => line(r).length > LIMITS.quote)) fail3("The selected header or row exceeds the evidence size limit.");
  const text = context + [headers3, ...rows].map(line).join("\n");
  if (text.length > LIMITS.text) fail3("Selected text exceeds 16,000 characters. Choose fewer rows or columns.");
  const ranking = rankingPlan(text);
  const selection = { version: "table-slice-v1", parent, parent_hash: await digest(parent), columns: [...options.columns], first_row: options.first_row, last_row: options.last_row };
  const label = (parent.name + " \xB7 selected rows " + options.first_row + "\u2013" + options.last_row + " of " + parent.source_rows + " \xB7 columns " + options.columns.map((c) => c + 1).join(", ")).slice(0, 1e3);
  return { kind: "table", label, text, snapshot_hash: await digest(text), row_count: rows.length, column_count: headers3.length, record_count: ranking?.factCount || rows.length, table_key: parent.key, table_selection: selection, table_preview: { headers: headers3, rows: rows.slice(0, 3) }, total_columns: parent.source_columns };
}
async function validateTableSelection(selection, text) {
  if (!selection || selection.version !== "table-slice-v1" || Object.keys(selection).some((k) => !["version", "parent", "parent_hash", "columns", "first_row", "last_row"].includes(k))) fail3("Invalid saved table selection.");
  const result = await selectCapturedTable(selection.parent, { columns: selection.columns, first_row: selection.first_row, last_row: selection.last_row });
  if (selection.parent_hash !== result.table_selection.parent_hash || text !== result.text) fail3("Selected content does not match the retained captured table and row/column choices.");
  return result;
}

// src/interpretation/feedback-snapshots.js
var SNAPSHOT_FORMAT = "toolkit-feedback-snapshot-v1";
async function makeFeedbackSnapshot(job, example) {
  const history = [];
  for (const revision of job.revisions || []) {
    for (const event of revision.prior_events) history.push(await digest(event));
    const { prior_events, ...change } = revision;
    history.push(await digest(change));
  }
  for (const event of job.events) history.push(await digest(event));
  const data = { format: SNAPSHOT_FORMAT, session: job.packet.hash, history, example, ...example ? {} : { job } };
  return { ...data, id: await digest(data) };
}

// src/interpretation/feedback.js
var FEEDBACK_FORMAT = "toolkit-feedback-case-v1";
async function feedbackCase(job, validation, original) {
  const reviewed = validation.records.filter((r) => r.review_status === "approved" || r.review_status === "rejected");
  if (!reviewed.length) throw new ContractError("feedback_needs_review", "Approve or reject at least one record before collecting feedback. Corrections remain proposals until reviewed.");
  const values = (r) => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(r.fields).map(([name, f]) => [name, f.value]));
  const expectations = { approved: reviewed.filter((r) => r.review_status === "approved").map((r) => ({ record_id: r.id, values: values(r) })), rejected: reviewed.filter((r) => r.review_status === "rejected").map((r) => ({ record_id: r.id, values: values(r) })), unreviewed_count: validation.records.length - reviewed.length, coverage: "partial-review; unreviewed or absent records are not ground truth" };
  const baseline = { candidate_values: original.records.map(values) };
  const payload = { format: FEEDBACK_FORMAT, job, expectations, baseline };
  const result = { ...payload, id: await digest(payload) };
  if (new TextEncoder().encode(canonical(result)).byteLength > 95e4) throw new ContractError("feedback_limit", "This feedback case exceeds the portable case limit. Use a smaller source selection.");
  return result;
}

var TEXT_FACTS_VERSION = "text-relations-v1";
var TEXT_FACTS_V2 = "text-relations-v2";
var TEXT_FACTS_SCHEMA = { fields: [
  { name: "subject", type: "string", required: true },
  { name: "relationship", type: "string", required: false },
  { name: "answer", type: "string", required: true },
  { name: "numeric_value", type: "number", required: false },
  { name: "unit", type: "string", required: false },
  { name: "qualifier", type: "string", required: false },
  { name: "time_context", type: "string", required: false }
] };
var TEXT_FACTS_V2_SCHEMA = { fields: TEXT_FACTS_SCHEMA.fields.map((f) => f.name === "numeric_value" ? { ...f, number_format: "en-US-grouped", min: -Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, max: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER } : { ...f }) };
var measure = "most (?:popular|viewed|visited|read|watched|downloaded)|best[- ]selling|highest[- ]rated|top[- ]ranked";
function relation(raw) {
  const text = raw.trim().replace(/[.!?]$/, "").trim();
  let m;
  if (m = text.match(new RegExp("^(?:The )?(" + measure + ") (.{1,120}?)(?: (?:in|of|for) (\\d{4}))? (?:is|was|are|were) (.{1,300})$", "i"))) return { subject: m[2], relationship: m[1], answer: m[4], time_context: m[3] || null };
  if (m = text.match(/^(?:The )?(capital|winner|category) of (.{1,120}?) (?:is|was|are|were) (.{1,300})$/i)) return { subject: m[2], relationship: m[1], answer: m[3], time_context: null };
  if (m = text.match(/^(.{1,120}?) (belongs to) (.{1,300})$/i)) return { subject: m[1], relationship: m[2], answer: m[3], time_context: null };
  if (m = text.match(/^(.{1,300}?) (?:is|was) the (capital|winner) of (.{1,120})$/i)) return { subject: m[3], relationship: m[2], answer: m[1], time_context: null };
  return null;
}
function sentences(text) {
  return [...text.matchAll(/[^.!?\n]*(?:\.(?!\s|$)[^.!?\n]*)*(?:[.!?](?=\s|$)|$)/g)].filter((m) => m[0].trim());
}
function accepted(raw) {
  const value = relation(raw);
  if (!value || /^(?:not|never)\b/i.test(value.answer) || /\b(?:but|while|whereas|instead|however|corrected|revised|forecast|projected|estimated)\b/i.test(raw)) return null;
  return value;
}
function hasTextRelations(text) {
  return typeof text === "string" && text.length <= 16e3 && sentences(text.replace(/https?:\/\/[^\s)"<>]+/g, (s) => " ".repeat(s.length))).some((m) => accepted(m[0]));
}
function assertTextFactConsistency(response, version = TEXT_FACTS_VERSION) {
  for (const r of response.records) {
    const n = r.fields.numeric_value?.value, answer = r.fields.answer?.value;
    if (n !== null && n !== void 0 && (!(version === TEXT_FACTS_V2 ? /^[+-]?(?:\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+|\d+)(?:\.\d+)?$/ : /^[+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/).test(answer) || Number(version === TEXT_FACTS_V2 ? answer.replaceAll(",", "") : answer) !== n)) throw new ContractError("fact_value_mismatch", "The literal answer and numeric value disagree. Correct both fields or retain the answer as text.");
  }
}
function extractTextFacts(packet, version = TEXT_FACTS_VERSION) {

    const r = { id: "row-" + (records.length + 1), fields };
    records.push(r);
    return r;
  };
  for (const p of packet.passages) {
    const masked = p.text.replace(/https?:\/\/[^\s)"<>]+/g, (s) => " ".repeat(s.length));
    for (const m of sentences(masked)) {
      const raw = p.text.slice(m.index, m.index + m[0].length).trim(), value = accepted(raw);
      if (!value) continue;

      const local = p.text.indexOf(raw, m.index);
      let occurrence = 0, at = p.text.indexOf(raw);
      while (at >= 0 && at < local) {
        occurrence++;
        at = p.text.indexOf(raw, at + 1);
      }
      const evidence = [{ passage_id: p.id, quote: raw, occurrence }];
      const field = (value2) => ({ value: value2, evidence: value2 === null ? [] : evidence });
      push({ subject: field(value.subject), relationship: field(value.relationship), answer: field(value.answer), numeric_value: field(null), unit: field(null), qualifier: field(null), time_context: field(value.time_context) });
    }
  }
  const numeric2 = richer ? extractQuantities({ ...packet, schema: QUANTITY_SCHEMA }) : extractProseRules({ ...packet, schema: PROSE_SCHEMA }, "prose-facts-v2");
  for (const r of numeric2.records) {
    const f = r.fields, value = f.value.value;
    let literal2;
    for (const e of f.value.evidence) {
      literal2 = [...e.quote.matchAll(richer ? /[+-]?(?:\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+|\d+)(?:\.\d+)?/g : /[+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?/g)].find((m) => Number(richer ? m[0].replaceAll(",", "") : m[0]) === value)?.[0];

    }
    if (!literal2) throw new ContractError("fact_literal", "Numeric fact has no supported literal representation.");
    const empty = { value: null, evidence: [] };
    const next = push({ subject: f.measure, relationship: empty, answer: { value: literal2, evidence: f.value.evidence }, numeric_value: f.value, unit: f.unit, qualifier: f.qualifier, time_context: empty });
    if (r.issues) next.issues = r.issues;
  }
  const response = { version: "candidates-v1", records, outcomes: packet.passages.map((p) => {
    const ids = records.filter((r) => Object.values(r.fields).some((f) => f.evidence.some((e) => e.passage_id === p.id))).map((r) => r.id);
    return { passage_id: p.id, status: ids.length ? "records" : "no_result", record_ids: ids, reason: ids.length ? "Recognized explicit text relationships and/or quantitative facts. Noun answers remain text; unrecognized relationships may still be present." : "No supported noun relationship or quantitative fact recognized. Text is retained, not fully interpreted." };
  }) };
  assertTextFactConsistency(response, version);
  return response;
}
function textFactMeaning() {
  return { kind: "text_relationships", title: "Recognized facts", context: null, explanation: "Explicit subject\u2013relationship\u2013answer statements are recognized. Answers may be names or nouns. Numerical facts are retained separately with their units. Unsupported prose is not interpreted, and every relationship still needs source review." };
}
