var MAPPING_VERSION = "mapped-table-v2";
var LEGACY_MAPPING_VERSION = "mapped-table-v1";
var fail4 = (message2) => {
  throw new ContractError("column_mapping", message2);
};
var literal = /^([+-]?)\$?([+-]?(?:\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+|\d+)(?:\.\d+)?)(%)?$/;
function numeric(raw, version = MAPPING_VERSION) {
  const value = raw.trim(), m = value.match(version === LEGACY_MAPPING_VERSION ? literal : /^([+-]?)\s*\$?\s*([+-]?(?:\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+|\d+)(?:\.\d+)?)(?:\s*(%|percent))?$/i);
  if (!m || m[1] && /^[+-]/.test(m[2])) return null;
  const number2 = Number((m[1] || "") + m[2].replaceAll(",", ""));
  return Number.isFinite(number2) ? { value: number2, dollar: value.includes("$"), percent: !!m[3] } : null;
}
var kinds = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(["text", "number", "percent", "dollars"]);
var reserved = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(["constructor", "prototype", "__proto__", "record_id", "review_status", "validation_issues"]);
function nameFor(label, index, used, suffix = "") {
  let name = label.toLowerCase().replace(/%/g, " percent ").replace(/\$/g, " dollars ").replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "_").replace(/^_+|_+$/g, "").slice(0, 32);
  if (!/^[a-z]/.test(name) || reserved.has(name)) name = "column_" + (index + 1);
  if (suffix && !name.endsWith(suffix)) name = name.slice(0, 32 - suffix.length) + suffix;
  const base = name;
  let duplicate = 2;
  while (used.has(name)) name = base + "_" + duplicate++;
  used.add(name);
  return name;
}
function detectColumns(text, version = MAPPING_VERSION, explicitHeader = false) {
  const legacy = version === LEGACY_MAPPING_VERSION;
  if (typeof text !== "string" || text.length > LIMITS.text) return null;
  const lines = [];
  let start = 0;
  for (const raw of text.split("\n")) {
    const quote = legacy ? raw.trim() : raw.replace(/^ +| +$/g, "");
    if (quote.trim() || !legacy && quote.includes("	")) lines.push({ quote, start: start + raw.indexOf(quote) });
    start += raw.length + 1;
  }
  if (lines.length < 2) return null;
  const headerAt = lines.findIndex((l) => /\t|\||,/.test(l.quote));
  if (headerAt < 0 || headerAt > 3) return null;
  const header = lines[headerAt];
  const delimiter = header.quote.includes("	") ? "	" : header.quote.includes("|") ? "|" : ",";
  const split = (quote) => {
    if (delimiter === "," && quote.includes('"')) return null;
    let value = quote;
    if (delimiter === "|") value = value.replace(/^\|/, "").replace(/\|$/, "");
    return value.split(delimiter).map((v) => v.trim());
  };
  if (!header.quote.trim()) return null;
  const labels = split(header.quote);
  if (!labels || labels.length < 2 || labels.length > LIMITS.fields || labels.some((l) => !/[\p{L}]/u.test(l) && !(!legacy && (/^#\s*\d+$/.test(l) || explicitHeader)) || l.length > 100 || (legacy || !explicitHeader) && /[\n<>]/.test(l) || delimiter === "," && /\d/.test(l))) return null;
  const rows = [], skipped = [];
  for (const line of lines.slice(headerAt + 1)) {
    if (delimiter === "|" && /^\|?[\s:|-]+\|?$/.test(line.quote)) continue;
    const cells = split(line.quote);
    if (!cells || cells.length !== labels.length || line.quote.length > LIMITS.quote) {
      skipped.push({ quote: line.quote.slice(0, 120), reason: "Row has a different cell count, unsupported CSV quoting or exceeds the evidence limit." });
      continue;
    }
    if (!legacy && cells.every((v) => !v)) {
      skipped.push({ quote: line.quote, reason: "Row has no readable text; image-only content was not read." });
      continue;
    }
    rows.push({ ...line, cells });
  }
  if (!rows.length) return null;
  if (rows.length > LIMITS.records) fail4("More than 50 mapped rows. Paste a smaller table; no rows were truncated.");
  if (header.quote.length > LIMITS.quote) fail4("The header exceeds the evidence limit.");
  const used = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  const columns = labels.map((label, index) => {
    const values = rows.map((r) => r.cells[index]).filter(Boolean), numbers = values.map((v) => numeric(v, version));
    let kind = "text", reason = "Retained as text; no numeric conversion was assumed.";
    const identifier = /\b(id|identifier|code|zip|postal|date|year)\b/i.test(label) || values.some((v) => /^[-+]?0\d/.test(v));
    if (!identifier && /%|\bpercent(?:age)?\b/i.test(label)) {
      kind = "percent";
      reason = "Percentage heading; values remain on the 0\u2013100 scale.";
    } else if (!identifier && /\$|\bdollars?\b/i.test(label)) {
      kind = "dollars";
      reason = "Explicit dollar heading; no currency conversion or ISO currency inference.";
    } else if (!legacy && !identifier && /^(?:count|number of .+)$/i.test(label)) {
      kind = "number";
      reason = "Explicit count heading; annotated or malformed values require review rather than guessed conversion.";
    } else if (!identifier && values.length && numbers.every(Boolean)) {
      if (numbers.every((n) => n.percent && !n.dollar)) kind = "percent";
      else if (numbers.every((n) => n.dollar && !n.percent)) kind = "dollars";
      else if (numbers.every((n) => !n.dollar && !n.percent)) kind = "number";
      reason = kind === "text" ? "Mixed unit markers retained as text." : "Consistent literal cell format; verify the heading before approval.";
    }
    if (!legacy && kind === "text" && numbers.some(Boolean) && !numbers.every(Boolean)) reason = "Mixed numeric/annotated text retained as text; no annotation was stripped.";
    const required = legacy || kind !== "text" || !rows.some((r) => !r.cells[index]);
    if (!required) reason += " Empty text cells remain null; images are not read.";
    const suffix = !legacy ? kind === "percent" ? "_percent" : kind === "dollars" ? "_dollars" : "" : "";
    const exportLabel = !legacy && /^#?\s*\d[\d.,]*$/.test(label) ? "column " + label.replace("#", "") : label;
    return { label, name: nameFor(exportLabel, index, used, suffix), kind, reason, required };
  });
  return { delimiter: delimiter === "	" ? "tab" : delimiter, header, rows, columns, skipped, prefix_lines: headerAt, version };
}
function mappedSchema(plan, overrides) {
  const columns = overrides === void 0 ? plan.columns.map(({ name, kind }) => ({ name, kind })) : overrides;
  if (!Array.isArray(columns) || columns.length !== plan.columns.length || columns.some((c) => !c || Object.keys(c).some((k) => !["name", "kind"].includes(k)) || typeof c.name !== "string" || !kinds.has(c.kind))) fail4("Choose one valid mapping for every source column.");
  const schema = { fields: columns.map((c) => ({
    name: c.name,
    type: c.kind === "text" ? "string" : "number",
    required: plan.version === LEGACY_MAPPING_VERSION || c.kind !== "text" || !plan.rows.some((r) => !r.cells[columns.indexOf(c)]),
    ...c.kind === "text" ? {} : { number_format: "en-US-grouped" },
    ...c.kind === "percent" ? { min: 0, max: 100 } : {}
  })) };
  return { columns, schema };
}
function mappingFor(job) {
  if (![MAPPING_VERSION, LEGACY_MAPPING_VERSION].includes(job.parser_version)) return null;
  const plan = detectColumns(job.packet.source.text, job.parser_version, job.retrieval?.content_kind === "table");
  if (!plan) fail4("No supported delimited table remains in this source.");
  const mapping = mappedSchema(plan, job.mapping);
  if (canonical(mapping.schema) !== canonical(job.packet.schema)) fail4("Saved columns differ from the recorded mapping.");
  return { plan, ...mapping };
}
function extractMappedTable(job) {
  const { plan, columns } = mappingFor(job), packet = job.packet;
  const locate = (line) => {
    const quote = line.quote.trim(), start = line.start + line.quote.length - line.quote.trimStart().length;
    const passage = packet.passages.find((p) => start >= p.start && start + quote.length <= p.end);
    if (!passage) fail4("A mapped row crosses a source boundary.");
    let occurrence = 0, found = passage.text.indexOf(quote);
    while (found >= 0 && found + passage.start < start) {
      occurrence++;
      found = passage.text.indexOf(quote, found + 1);
    }
    return { passage_id: passage.id, quote, occurrence };
  };
  const header = locate(plan.header);
  const records = plan.rows.map((row, index) => {
    const span = locate(row), issues = [];
    const fields = Object.fromEntries(columns.map((column, i) => {
      const raw = row.cells[i], n = numeric(raw, job.parser_version);
      let value = column.kind === "text" ? job.parser_version !== LEGACY_MAPPING_VERSION && !raw ? null : raw : n?.value ?? null;
      if (column.kind !== "text" && n && (n.percent && column.kind !== "percent" || n.dollar && column.kind !== "dollars")) {
        value = null;
        issues.push("A unit marker conflicts with the selected column mapping. Correct the mapping before approval.");
      }
      return [column.name, { value, evidence: value === null ? [] : [span, header] }];
    }));
    return { id: "row-" + (index + 1), fields, ...issues.length ? { issues } : {} };
  });
  return { version: "candidates-v1", records, outcomes: packet.passages.map((p) => {
    const ids = records.filter((r) => Object.values(r.fields).some((f) => f.evidence.some((e) => e.passage_id === p.id))).map((r) => r.id);
    return { passage_id: p.id, status: ids.length ? "records" : "no_result", record_ids: ids, reason: ids.length ? "Cells mapped using an explicit delimited header; source row and header retained. This does not prove completeness." : "Retained text outside mapped rows." };
  }) };
}

// src/interpretation/review-queue.js
var tableMethods = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(["semantic-ranking-v1", "mapped-table-v1", "mapped-table-v2", "pasted-wage-table-v1", "pasted-wage-table-v2", "pasted-page-table-v1"]);
var reviewOnly = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(["association_unverified", "cross_passage_association"]);
function reviewQueue(job, validation) {
  const structured = tableMethods.has(job.parser_version);
  const changed = new Set((job.revisions || []).map((r) => r.record_id));
  const eligible_ids = [], exception_ids = [], individual_ids = [];
  for (const row of validation.records) {
    if (row.review_status !== "needs_review") continue;
    const blocked = validation.issues.length > 0 || row.issues.some((i) => !reviewOnly.has(i.code)) || Object.values(row.fields).some((f) => f.issues.length > 0);
    if (blocked) exception_ids.push(row.id);
    else if (structured && !changed.has(row.id) && !row.id.startsWith("manual-")) eligible_ids.push(row.id);
    else individual_ids.push(row.id);
  }
  return {
    structured,
    eligible_ids,
    exception_ids,
    individual_ids,
    remaining_review_events: Math.max(0, 64 - job.events.length),
    notice: "Batch approval is an explicit human decision on supported table mappings. Prose, changed candidates and validation exceptions require individual review. No record is automatically accepted."
  };
}

// src/interpretation/wage-table.js
var WAGE_VERSION = "pasted-wage-table-v2";
var LEGACY_WAGE_VERSION = "pasted-wage-table-v1";
var WAGE_SCHEMA = { fields: [
  { name: "occupational_group", type: "string", required: true },
  { name: "employment_percent_national", type: "number", required: true, min: 0, max: 100 },
  { name: "employment_percent_local", type: "number", required: true, min: 0, max: 100 },
  { name: "hourly_wage_national_dollars", type: "number", required: true, min: 0 },
  { name: "hourly_wage_local_dollars", type: "number", required: true, min: 0 }
] };
function wageHeader(packet, version = WAGE_VERSION) {
  const matches = packet.passages.map((p) => {
    const normalized = p.text.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
    const legacy = normalized.match(/^Major occupational group Percent of total employment Mean hourly wage \(\$\) (United States (.+?)) \1$/i);
    const m = version === LEGACY_WAGE_VERSION ? legacy : normalized.match(/^(?:Table\s+[A-Z0-9]+[.:]\s+.{1,700}?)?Major occupational group Percent of total employment Mean hourly wage \(\$\) (United States (.+?)) \1$/i);
    return m ? { passage: p, national: "United States", local: m[2] } : null;
  }).filter(Boolean);
  if (matches.length > 1) throw new ContractError("ambiguous_table_header", "More than one wage-table header was found. Paste one table at a time.");
  return matches[0] || null;
}
function extractWageTable(packet, version = WAGE_VERSION) {
  const header = wageHeader(packet, version);
  if (!header || canonical(packet.schema) !== canonical(WAGE_SCHEMA))
    throw new ContractError("wage_table_schema", "The pasted wage table needs its explicit grouped percentage and hourly-dollar headers.");
  const records = [], outcomes = [];
  const names = WAGE_SCHEMA.fields.map((f) => f.name);
  for (const p of packet.passages) {
    const ids = [];
    if (p.id !== header.passage.id) {
      let cursor = 0;
      const wrapped = version !== LEGACY_WAGE_VERSION && p.text.trim().match(/^([^\d]+?)\s+(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s+(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s+\$?(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s+\$?(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)$/);
      for (const line of wrapped ? [p.text] : p.text.split("\n")) {
        const quote = line.trim();
        const pos = p.text.indexOf(quote, cursor);
        cursor = pos + quote.length;
        const m = wrapped || quote.match(/^(.+?)[ \t]+(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)[ \t]+(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)[ \t]+\$?(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)[ \t]+\$?(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)$/);
        if (!m || !/[\p{L}]/u.test(m[1]) || /\d$/.test(m[1]) || /https?:\/\//i.test(quote)) continue;
        if (records.length >= LIMITS.records) throw new ContractError("record_limit", "More than 50 table rows. Paste a smaller table.");
        if (quote.length > LIMITS.quote || header.passage.text.length > LIMITS.quote) throw new ContractError("quote_limit", "Table row or header exceeds the evidence limit.");
        let occurrence = 0, found = p.text.indexOf(quote);
        while (found >= 0 && found < pos) {
          occurrence++;
          found = p.text.indexOf(quote, found + 1);
        }
        const span = { passage_id: p.id, quote, occurrence };
        const fields = Object.fromEntries(names.map((name, i) => [name, {
          value: i === 0 ? version === LEGACY_WAGE_VERSION ? m[1] : m[1].replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim() : Number(m[i + 1]),
          evidence: i === 0 ? [span] : [span, { passage_id: header.passage.id, quote: header.passage.text, occurrence: 0 }]
        }]));
        const id = "row-" + (records.length + 1);
        records.push({ id, fields });
        ids.push(id);
      }
    }
    outcomes.push({
      passage_id: p.id,
      status: ids.length ? "records" : "no_result",
      record_ids: ids,
      reason: p.id === header.passage.id ? "Grouped header supplies column meanings and currency units; it is retained as evidence, not a data row." : ids.length ? "Four numeric cells mapped to the explicit grouped header. Confirm row alignment and units before approval." : "No complete four-value row recognized. This text was retained, not guessed or discarded."
    });
  }
  const h = outcomes.find((o) => o.passage_id === header.passage.id);
  if (records.length) {
    h.status = "records";
    h.record_ids = records.map((r) => r.id);
  }
  return { version: "candidates-v1", records, outcomes };
}

// src/interpretation/page-intake.js
var PAGE_TABLE_VERSION = "pasted-page-table-v1";
var PAGE_LIMIT = 64e3;
var grouped = { type: "number", required: true, min: 0, number_format: "en-US-grouped" };
var EMPLOYMENT_SCHEMA = { fields: [
  { name: "occupation", type: "string", required: true },
  { name: "employment_count", ...grouped },
  { name: "location_quotient", type: "number", required: true, min: 0 },
  { name: "hourly_wage_dollars", type: "number", required: true, min: 0 },
  { name: "annual_wage_dollars", ...grouped }
] };
var plain = "\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?";
var group = "(?:\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})+|\\d+)(?:\\.\\d+)?";
var rowPatterns = {
  shares: new RegExp("^(.+?)\\s+(" + plain + ")\\s+(" + plain + ")\\s+\\$?(" + plain + ")\\s+\\$?(" + plain + ")$"),
  employment: new RegExp("^(.+?)\\s+(" + group + ")\\s+(" + plain + ")\\s+\\$?(" + plain + ")\\s+\\$?(" + group + ")$")
};
function rowMatch(text, kind) {
  const m = text.trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ").match(rowPatterns[kind]);
  return m && /[\p{L}]/u.test(m[1]) && !/\d$/.test(m[1]) && !/https?:\/\//i.test(m[1]) ? m : null;
}
function paragraphs(text, start = 0, end = text.length) {
  const result = [];
  let at = start;
  const add = (stop) => {
    const raw = text.slice(at, stop), trimmed = raw.trim();
    if (trimmed) {
      const lead = raw.length - raw.trimStart().length;
      result.push({ start: at + lead, end: at + lead + trimmed.length, text: trimmed });
    }
  };
  for (const m of text.slice(start, end).matchAll(/\n[ \t]*\n+/g)) {
    add(start + m.index);
    at = start + m.index + m[0].length;
  }
  add(end);
  return result;
}
function pageHeaders(text) {
  const found = [];
  const specs = [
    ["shares", /Major occupational group\s+Percent of total employment\s+Mean hourly wage \(\$\)\s+(United States[ \t]+([^\n]+?))\s+\1(?=\n|$)/gi],
    ["employment", /Occupation(?:\(1\))?[ \t]+Employment[ \t]+Mean wages \(\$\)[ \t\n]+Level(?:\(2\))?[ \t]+Location quotient(?:\(3\))?[ \t]+Hourly[ \t]+Annual(?:\(4\))?(?=\n|$)/gi]
  ];
  for (const [kind, re] of specs) for (const m of text.matchAll(re)) {
    found.push({ kind, start: text.lastIndexOf("\n", m.index - 1) + 1, end: m.index + m[0].length, local: kind === "shares" ? m[2] : null });
  }
  return found.sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start);
}
function needsPageIntake(source) {
  if (typeof source?.text !== "string") return false;
  const text = source.text.replace(/\r\n?/g, "\n");
  return text.length > LIMITS.text || paragraphs(text).length > LIMITS.passages || pageHeaders(text).length > 1 || pageHeaders(text).some((h) => h.kind === "employment");
}
function planPage(source, proseVersion = PROSE_VERSION, { semantic = false, enhanced = false } = {}) {
  if (!source || Object.keys(source).some((k) => !["text", "url"].includes(k)) || typeof source.text !== "string" || !source.text.trim() || source.text.length > PAGE_LIMIT)
    throw new ContractError("page_limit", "Paste nonempty page text up to 64,000 characters. Nothing is silently truncated.");
  const text = source.text.replace(/\r\n?/g, "\n");
  if (paragraphs(text).length > 512) throw new ContractError("page_limit", "The page exceeds 512 paragraphs. Use a smaller page.");
  const headers3 = pageHeaders(text), datasets = [], consumed = [];
  const add = (label, ranges, schema, parser_version, kind, row_count = null) => {
    if (datasets.length >= 32) throw new ContractError("section_limit", "More than 32 bounded sections. Use a smaller page.");
    let selected = "";
    const source_map = [];
    for (const r of ranges) {
      if (selected) selected += "\n\n";
      source_map.push({ packet_start: selected.length, document_start: r.start, length: r.end - r.start });
      selected += text.slice(r.start, r.end);
    }
    if (selected.length > LIMITS.text || paragraphs(selected).length > LIMITS.passages)
      throw new ContractError("section_limit", "One section exceeds a bounded packet. Paste a smaller section.");
    datasets.push({ id: "section-" + (datasets.length + 1), label, text: selected, schema, parser_version, kind, row_count, source_map });
  };
  for (let i = 0; i < headers3.length; i++) {
    const h = headers3[i], end = headers3[i + 1]?.start ?? text.length;
    const rows = [];
    for (const p of paragraphs(text, h.end, end)) {
      if (!rowMatch(p.text, h.kind)) break;
      rows.push(p);
    }
    if (!rows.length) continue;
    consumed.push({ start: h.start, end: rows.at(-1).end });
    for (let at2 = 0; at2 < rows.length; at2 += 24) {
      const batch2 = rows.slice(at2, at2 + 24);
      const label = h.kind === "shares" ? "Employment percentages and hourly dollars" : "Employment counts, location quotients, hourly and annual dollars";
      add(
        label + " \xB7 rows " + (at2 + 1) + "\u2013" + (at2 + batch2.length) + " of " + rows.length + (h.local ? " \xB7 " + h.local : ""),
        [{ start: h.start, end: h.end }, { start: batch2[0].start, end: batch2.at(-1).end }],
        h.kind === "shares" ? WAGE_SCHEMA : EMPLOYMENT_SCHEMA,
        PAGE_TABLE_VERSION,
        h.kind,
        batch2.length
      );
    }
  }
  if (headers3.length > 1 && !consumed.length)
    throw new ContractError("ambiguous_table_header", "Repeated table headers have no recognizable rows. Paste a complete table or select a smaller section.");
  let at = 0;
  const rest = [];
  for (const r of consumed) {
    rest.push(...paragraphs(text, at, r.start));
    at = r.end;
  }
  rest.push(...paragraphs(text, at));
  let batch = [], size = 0, part = 0;
  const flush = () => {
    if (batch.length) {
      const sectionText = batch.map((p) => p.text).join("\n\n"), nounFacts = semantic && hasTextRelations(sectionText), rich = enhanced && !nounFacts && hasRichQuantities(sectionText), richerText = enhanced && nounFacts && hasRichQuantities(sectionText);
      add("Other page text \xB7 part " + ++part, batch, nounFacts ? richerText ? TEXT_FACTS_V2_SCHEMA : TEXT_FACTS_SCHEMA : rich ? QUANTITY_SCHEMA : PROSE_SCHEMA, nounFacts ? richerText ? TEXT_FACTS_V2 : TEXT_FACTS_VERSION : rich ? QUANTITY_VERSION : proseVersion, "prose");
      batch = [];
      size = 0;
    }
  };
  for (const p of rest) {
    if (p.text.length > 12e3) throw new ContractError("section_limit", "A single page paragraph exceeds 12,000 characters. Add paragraph breaks before parsing.");
    if (batch.length >= 24 || size + p.text.length + 2 > 12e3) flush();
    batch.push(p);
    size += p.text.length + 2;
  }
  flush();
  if (!datasets.length) throw new ContractError("empty_page", "No nonempty page sections found.");
  return { text, datasets };
}
function extractPageTable(packet) {
  const headers3 = pageHeaders(packet.source.text);
  if (headers3.length !== 1) throw new ContractError("page_table_header", "Expected one explicit grouped table header in this selection.");
  const h = headers3[0], schema = h.kind === "shares" ? WAGE_SCHEMA : EMPLOYMENT_SCHEMA;
  if (canonical(schema) !== canonical(packet.schema)) throw new ContractError("page_table_schema", "Selected columns do not match the table header.");
  const headerPassage = packet.passages.find((p) => p.start <= h.start && p.end >= h.end);
  if (!headerPassage) throw new ContractError("page_table_header", "Header must be retained in its own evidence passage.");
  const fields = schema.fields, records = [], outcomes = [];
  for (const p of packet.passages) {
    const m = p.id === headerPassage.id ? null : rowMatch(p.text, h.kind);
    const ids = [];
    if (m) {
      if (records.length >= LIMITS.records || p.text.length > LIMITS.quote || headerPassage.text.length > LIMITS.quote)
        throw new ContractError("page_table_limit", "Table selection exceeds row or quotation limits.");
      const id = "row-" + (records.length + 1), span = { passage_id: p.id, quote: p.text, occurrence: 0 };
      records.push({ id, fields: Object.fromEntries(fields.map((f, i) => [f.name, {
        value: i ? Number(m[i + 1].replaceAll(",", "")) : m[1],
        evidence: i ? [span, { passage_id: headerPassage.id, quote: headerPassage.text, occurrence: 0 }] : [span]
      }])) });
      ids.push(id);
    }
    outcomes.push({
      passage_id: p.id,
      status: ids.length ? "records" : "no_result",
      record_ids: ids,
      reason: ids.length ? "Typed cells mapped from this row and the explicit selected table header; review alignment before approval." : "Retained supporting header or unrecognized text; no data row inferred."
    });
  }
  const headerOutcome = outcomes.find((o) => o.passage_id === headerPassage.id);
  if (records.length) {
    headerOutcome.status = "records";
    headerOutcome.record_ids = records.map((r) => r.id);
  }
  return { version: "candidates-v1", records, outcomes };
}
function documentEvidence(validation, selection, text, hash) {
  const copy2 = structuredClone(validation);
  for (const row of copy2.records) for (const field of Object.values(row.fields)) for (const e of field.evidence) {
    const part = selection.source_map.find((r) => e.source_start >= r.packet_start && e.source_end <= r.packet_start + r.length);
    if (!part) throw new ContractError("document_evidence", "Evidence crosses a section boundary without a source mapping.");
    const start = part.document_start + e.source_start - part.packet_start;
    if (text.slice(start, start + e.quote.length) !== e.quote) throw new ContractError("document_evidence", "Section evidence differs from the retained page.");
    e.document_start = start;
    e.document_end = start + e.quote.length;
    e.document_hash = hash;
  }
  return copy2;
}

  async function request(path, body) {
    const response = await fetch(path, {

      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    });
    if (!response.ok) {
      let error;
      try {
        error = await response.json();
      } catch {}
      throw Error(
        error?.error ||
          "The lab request failed. Your current session was kept.",
      );
    }
    return response;

  function highlight(paragraph, ranges) {
    const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
    let cursor = 0;
    const merged = [];
    for (const r of ranges.sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start)) {
      const last = merged.at(-1);
      if (last && r.start <= last.end) last.end = Math.max(last.end, r.end);
      else merged.push({ ...r });
    }
    for (const r of merged) {
      fragment.append(
        document.createTextNode(paragraph.slice(cursor, r.start)),
      );
      fragment.append(text("mark", paragraph.slice(r.start, r.end)));
      cursor = r.end;
    }
    fragment.append(document.createTextNode(paragraph.slice(cursor)));
    return fragment;
  }

Reference only; this pasted review did not fetch the URL.");

  function displayValue(row, field) {

    const mappedKind = state.view.column_mapping?.editable ? state.view.column_mapping.columns.find(c => c.name === field.name)?.kind : null;
    if (typeof value === "number" && (mappedKind === "dollars" || /^(?:hourly|annual)_wage(?:_.*)?_dollars$/.test(field.name)))
      return "$" + new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 20 }).format(value);

    if (typeof value === "number" && field.number_format === "en-US-grouped") return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", { maximumFractionDigits: 20 }).format(value);

  }

          button.onclick = () => {
            const changed = state.rowId !== row.id;
            if (changed) clearDecision();
            state.rowId = row.id;
            state.field = f.name;
            render();
            if (changed) editCandidate();
          };
          td.append(button);
          tr.append(td);
        }
        tr.append(
          text(
            "td",
            row.review_status === "needs_review"
              ? queue().exception_ids.includes(row.id) ? "Check needed" : queue().eligible_ids.includes(row.id) ? "Ready for batch" : "Individual review"
              : labels[row.review_status] || row.review_status,
            "status " + row.review_status,
          ),
        );
        return tr;
      }),
    );
  }
  function renderEvidence() {
    const row = selected(),
      field = row?.fields[state.field];
    if (!row || !field) {
      $("field-title").textContent = state.view.validation.records.length ? "No records in this view" : "No candidates yet";
      $("evidence").replaceChildren(text("p", state.view.validation.records.length ? "Choose All records to see completed or batch-ready rows." : "No supported pattern matched. You can add a record manually with supporting text."));
      $("findings-details").open = false;
      $("review-position").textContent="No selected record";$("review-reason").textContent="Select a record or change the filter.";$("selected-value").textContent="";$("review-field").replaceChildren();
      $("findings").replaceChildren();
      $("review-title").textContent = "Add a candidate to review";
      return;
    }
    $("field-title").textContent =
      columnLabel(state.field) + " \xB7 record " + recordNumber(row);
    const rows=visibleRows();
    $("review-position").textContent=(rows.findIndex(r=>r.id===row.id)+1)+" of "+rows.length;
    const reasons=blockers(row),reason=reasons[0]?.message;
    $("review-reason").dataset.blocked=String(reasons.length>0);
    $("review-reason").textContent=reason?(reason.length>170?reason.slice(0,167)+"\u2026":reason)+" Full details below.":row.review_status==="approved"?"Approved. This record is included in approved exports.":row.review_status==="rejected"?"Rejected. This record is excluded from approved exports.":"Check the values against the source, then approve, reject or leave pending.";
    $("selected-value").textContent=displayValue(row,state.view.job.packet.schema.fields.find(f=>f.name===state.field));
    $("review-field").replaceChildren(...state.view.job.packet.schema.fields.map(f=>{const option=text("option",columnLabel(f.name));option.value=f.name;return option;}));
    $("review-field").value=state.field;
    const evidence = [];
    const additional=document.createElement("details");
    additional.append(text("summary","More supporting quotations ("+Math.max(0,field.evidence.length-1)+")"));
    for (const [index,e] of field.evidence.entries()) {
      const reference = document.createElement("details");
      reference.append(text("summary", passageLabel(e.passage_id) + " \xB7 source reference"),
        text("p", "Internal ID " + e.passage_id + " \xB7 snapshot offsets " + e.source_start + "\u2013" + e.source_end +
          (e.document_start !== undefined ? " \xB7 original page offsets " + e.document_start + "\u2013" + e.document_end : ""), "hint"));
      const context=state.view.evidence_context?.[row.id+":"+state.field]?.[index];
      if(context&&(context.before||context.after)){
        const surrounding=document.createElement("details"),excerpt=document.createElement("p"),mark=text("mark",context.quote);
        surrounding.append(text("summary","Surrounding text \xB7 "+context.scope),text("p","Context helps you check subjects and dates. Only the highlighted quotation is validated evidence; nearby text does not establish the relationship.","hint"));
        excerpt.append(document.createTextNode((context.truncated_before?"\u2026":"")+context.before),mark,document.createTextNode(context.after+(context.truncated_after?"\u2026":"")));excerpt.style.whiteSpace="pre-wrap";surrounding.append(excerpt);if(index===0)evidence.push(surrounding);else additional.append(surrounding);
      }
      if(index===0)evidence.push(text("blockquote", e.quote), reference);else additional.append(text("blockquote",e.quote),reference);
    }
    if (!field.evidence.length) {
      evidence.push(
        text("p", "No validated supporting quotation for this value."),
      );
      const raw = state.view.job.cache_entry.raw_response.records.find(
        (r) => r.id === row.id,
      )?.fields?.[state.field];
      for (const e of raw?.evidence || [])
        evidence.push(
          text("blockquote", e.quote),
          text("p", "Proposed quotation \xB7 not validated", "hint"),
        );
    }
    if(field.evidence.length>1)evidence.push(additional);
    $("evidence").replaceChildren(...evidence);
    if(state.inspectedRow!==row.id||state.inspectedPacket!==state.view.job.packet.hash){$("findings-details").open=false;state.inspectedRow=row.id;state.inspectedPacket=state.view.job.packet.hash;}
    const list = document.createElement("ul");
    const findings=[
      ...state.view.validation.issues,
      ...row.issues,
      ...Object.values(row.fields).flatMap((f) => f.issues),
    ];
    const uniqueFindings=[...new Set(findings.map(f=>f.message))];
    for(const message of uniqueFindings)list.append(text("li",message));
    $("findings-summary").textContent="All checks and findings ("+uniqueFindings.length+")";
    $("findings").replaceChildren(
      text("strong", row.review_status === "approved" ? "Original automated findings \xB7 human association review completed" : "System findings \u2014 retained after review"),
      list,
    );
    $("review-title").textContent =
      "Review record " +
      recordNumber(row) +
      " \xB7 " +
      (labels[row.review_status] || row.review_status);

  }

  async function perform(task) {
    if (state.busy) return;
    state.busy = true;
    controls();
    try {
      await task();
    } catch (error) {
      say(
        error.message || "The request failed. Your current session was kept.",
      );
    } finally {
      state.busy = false;
      controls();
    }
  }
  function editCandidate(add = false) {
    const row = add ? null : selected();
    state.editingId = row?.id || null;
    $("correction-title").textContent = row ? "Correct " + row.id : "Add a new record";
    $("correction-note").value = "";
    const nodes = state.view.job.packet.schema.fields.map((f) => {
      const section = document.createElement("section");
      section.dataset.column = f.name;
      const field = row?.fields[f.name], first = field?.evidence[0];
      const valueLabel = text("label", f.name + " value");
      const value = document.createElement("input");
      value.dataset.part = "value"; value.required = f.required;
      value.type = f.type === "number" ? "number" : "text";
      if (f.type === "number") value.step = "any";
      value.value = field?.value ?? "";
      valueLabel.append(value);
      const passageLabel = text("label", "Supporting paragraph");
      const passage = document.createElement("select"); passage.dataset.part = "passage";
      for (const p of state.view.job.packet.passages) {
        const option = text("option", p.id + " \xB7 " + p.text.slice(0, 70));
        option.value = p.id; passage.append(option);
      }
      passage.value = first?.passage_id || state.view.job.packet.passages[0].id;
      passageLabel.append(passage);
      const quoteLabel = text("label", "Exact quotation");
      const quote = document.createElement("textarea"); quote.dataset.part = "quote";
      quote.required = f.required; quote.maxLength = 2048; quote.value = first?.quote || "";
      quoteLabel.append(quote);
      const occurrenceLabel = text("label", "Quotation occurrence (zero-based)");
      const occurrence = document.createElement("input"); occurrence.type = "number"; occurrence.min = "0";
      occurrence.step = "1"; occurrence.required = true; occurrence.dataset.part = "occurrence";
      occurrence.value = first?.occurrence ?? 0; occurrenceLabel.append(occurrence);
      section.append(valueLabel, passageLabel, quoteLabel, occurrenceLabel);
      return section;
    });
    $("correction-fields").replaceChildren(...nodes);
    controls();
  }

    const key=r=>r.snapshot_hash+'|'+r.label;
    if(state.view?.job.retrieval?.retrieved_at===state.retrieved.retrieved_at)fileReviews.set(key(state.view.job.retrieval),state.view);
    const cached=fileReviews.get(key(retrieval));

  }

  function renderCoverage(){
    if(!$("source-part")||!sourceAudit)return;
    const select=$("source-part"),chosen=select.value;
    select.replaceChildren(...sourceAudit.coverage.map(p=>{const o=text('option',p.label+' \xB7 '+p.status+(p.error?' \xB7 unread/unsupported':''));o.value=p.id;return o;}));

    $('coverage-counts').textContent=counts.pending+' pending \xB7 '+counts.reviewed+' checked \xB7 '+counts.excluded+' intentionally excluded \xB7 '+counts.unsupported+' unsupported. '+sourceAudit.coverage.filter(p=>p.error).length+' parts have capture limitations. These counts describe captured parts, not complete original-document coverage.';

    if(part.rows){const table=document.createElement('table');for(const row of part.rows.slice(0,100)){const tr=document.createElement('tr');for(const cell of row)tr.append(text('td',cell));table.append(tr);}preview.append(table);if(part.rows.length>100)preview.append(text('p','Showing 100 of '+part.rows.length+' source rows. Captured-source download keeps all rows.'));}
    else preview.append(text('p',part.text||'[No readable text captured]'));
    $('source-part-links').textContent=part.dataset_ids.length?'Included in review selections: '+part.dataset_ids.map(id=>sourceAudit.datasets.find(d=>d.id===id)?.display_label||sourceAudit.datasets.find(d=>d.id===id)?.label||id).join('; '):'No review selection covers this part. Inspect manually, edit/paste readable text, or intentionally exclude it with a reason. No values have been invented.';
    $('coverage-reviewed').disabled=state.busy||!!part.error;
  }
  function setCoverage(status){
    if(state.busy)return;
    const part=sourceAudit?.coverage.find(p=>p.id===$('source-part').value);if(!part)return;
    const note=$('coverage-note').value.trim();
    if(status!=='pending'&&!note){say('Enter what you checked or why you excluded this source part.');return;}
    part.status=status==='pending'&&part.error?'unsupported':status;part.note=status==='pending'?'':note;renderCoverage();
  }

  function auditSnapshots(value,name,format){

    for(const [i,issue]of (value.issues||[]).entries())coverage.push({id:'limitation-'+i,label:'Capture limitation '+(i+1),kind:'limitation',text:issue,error:issue,dataset_ids:[],status:'unsupported',note:''});
    sourceAudit={...value,file:{name,format},coverage,captured_source:{source:value.source,issues:value.issues||[],inventory:value.inventory||[],content:value.datasets.map(d=>({label:d.label,text:d.text})),coverage}};
    fileCapture=sourceAudit.captured_source;showFileReport({...sourceAudit.file,issues:sourceAudit.issues||[],inventory:sourceAudit.inventory||[]});
  }

  $("correction-form").onsubmit = (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!$("reviewer").value.trim()) { say("Enter your reviewer name above before saving a candidate."); return; }
    perform(async () => {
      const fields = {};
      for (const section of document.querySelectorAll("#correction-fields section")) {
        const field = state.view.job.packet.schema.fields.find(f => f.name === section.dataset.column);
        const part = key => section.querySelector('[data-part="' + key + '"]').value;
        const empty = !field.required && !part("value").trim();
        fields[field.name] = { value: empty ? null : field.type === "number" ? Number(part("value")) : part("value"),
          evidence: empty ? [] : [{ passage_id: part("passage"), quote: part("quote"), occurrence: Number(part("occurrence")) }] };
      }
      const response = await request("/api/interpretation/action", { action: "correct", job: state.view.job,
        correction: { record_id: state.editingId, fields, reviewer: $("reviewer").value.trim(), note: $("correction-note").value.trim() } });
      state.view = await response.json();
      state.rowId = state.editingId || state.view.validation.records.at(-1)?.id;
      state.field = state.view.job.packet.schema.fields[0].name;
      clearDecision(); render(); editCandidate();
      await autoSaveFeedback(state.view.job);notifyWorkspace();
      say("Candidate revision saved and evidence revalidated. All current approvals reset; earlier decisions retained in revision history. Review the revised candidates before exporting.");
    });
  };

  $("review").onsubmit = (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const row = selected(),
      decision = event.submitter?.dataset.decision;
    if (!row || !decision) return;
    if (!$("reviewer").value.trim() || !$("note").value.trim()) {
      say("Enter a reviewer name and a meaningful review note.");
      return;
    }
    if (decision === "approved" && (blocking(row) || !$("confirm").checked)) {
      say(
        "Approval requires clean checks and explicit association confirmation.",
      );
      return;
    }
    perform(async () => {
      const response = await request("/api/interpretation/action", {
        action: "review",
        job: state.view.job,
        decision: {
          record_id: row.id,
          decision,
          reviewer: $("reviewer").value.trim(),
          note: $("note").value.trim(),
          confirmed_association: $("confirm").checked,
        },
      });
      state.view = await response.json();
      clearDecision();
      render();
      await autoSaveFeedback(state.view.job);notifyWorkspace();
      say(
        "Appended " +
          labels[decision].toLowerCase() +
          " decision for " +
          row.id +
          ". Earlier events were kept.",
      );
    });
  };

  function saveBlob(blob, filename) {

  }

  }
  async function loadStorage(){
    state.storage=await storageRequest({action:"status"});feedbackSummary();
    if(!state.storage.enabled){storageMessage(state.storage.message+" Reviewed changes remain unsaved until connected; keep a portable backup.");return;}
    const data=await storageRequest({action:"list"}),verified=[];

  }

    if(!state.storage?.enabled)return;
    for(const [key,job]of state.unsavedFeedback){

      state.savedReviews=state.savedReviews.filter(s=>s.session!==key&&!result.conflicts.includes(s.session));

      state.feedback=state.feedback.slice(0,20);storageInventory(result);feedbackSummary();
      storageMessage(result.message+" Folder: "+state.storage.directory+(result.conflicts.length?" Conflicting review histories need attention; those examples are excluded.":""));
    }
    controls();
  }

  $("open-feedback-review").onclick=()=>perform(async()=>{

  function feedbackChoices(){

var headers = {
  "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff",
  "Referrer-Policy": "no-referrer",
  "Cache-Control": "no-store",
  "Content-Security-Policy": "default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'"

var reply = (data, status = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(data), {
  status,
  headers: { ...headers, "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" }
