var fail5 = (code, message2, status = 400) => {
  const error2 = new ContractError(code, message2);
  error2.status = status;
  throw error2;
};
var plain2 = (value) => value !== null && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value);
var only = (value, keys2) => plain2(value) && Object.keys(value).every((key) => keys2.includes(key));
async function readBody(request) {
  if (!/^application\/json(?:;|$)/i.test(
    request.headers.get("content-type") || ""
  ))
    fail5("json_required", "Send a JSON request.", 415);
  let oversized = Number(request.headers.get("content-length")) > 1048576;
  const reader = request.body?.getReader(), chunks = [];
  let bytes = 0;
  if (reader)
    try {
      while (true) {
        const { value, done } = await reader.read();
        if (done) break;
        bytes += value.byteLength;
        if (bytes > 1048576) {
          oversized = true;
          chunks.length = 0;
        }
        if (bytes > 2097152) {
          await reader.cancel();
          fail5("request_limit", "The lab request exceeds 1 MiB.", 413);
        }
        if (!oversized) chunks.push(value);
      }
    } finally {
      reader.releaseLock();
    }
  if (oversized) fail5("request_limit", "The lab request exceeds 1 MiB. Export the current diagnostic report before starting a smaller session.", 413);
  let body;
  try {
    body = JSON.parse(await new Blob(chunks).text());
  } catch {
    fail5("invalid_json", "The lab request is not valid JSON.");
  }
  return body;
}
async function entryFor(packet, response) {
  return (await runInterpretation(packet, await scriptedInterpreter(response))).cache_entry;
}
function applyCorrection(packet, response, change) {
  if (!only(change, ["record_id", "fields", "reviewer", "note", "at", "prior_events"]) || typeof change.reviewer !== "string" || !change.reviewer.trim() || change.reviewer.length > 80 || typeof change.note !== "string" || !change.note.trim() || change.note.length > 1e3 || typeof change.at !== "string" || !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(change.at)) || !Array.isArray(change.prior_events) || change.prior_events.length > 64 || !plain2(change.fields))
    fail5("invalid_correction", "A correction requires a reviewer, note, timestamp and requested fields.");
  const next = structuredClone(response);
  const index = next.records.findIndex((r) => r.id === change.record_id);
  if (change.record_id !== null && index < 0) fail5("unknown_record", "Select an existing record to correct.");
  const candidate = { id: index < 0 ? "manual-" + (next.records.length + 1) : change.record_id, fields: change.fields };
  if (index < 0) next.records.push(candidate);
  else next.records[index] = candidate;
  next.outcomes = packet.passages.map((p) => {
    const ids = next.records.filter((r) => Object.values(r.fields).some((f) => Array.isArray(f?.evidence) && f.evidence.some((e) => e.passage_id === p.id))).map((r) => r.id);
    return {
      passage_id: p.id,
      status: ids.length ? "records" : "no_result",
      record_ids: ids,
      reason: ids.length ? "Candidate evidence references this paragraph; associations require human review." : "No current candidate cites this paragraph. This is not proof that it contains no useful data."
    };
  });
  return next;
}
function originalResponse(job) {
  if (job.parser_version === TASK_VERSION) return taskResponse(job);
  if (job.example_id !== "custom-text") return examples[job.example_id].scripted_response;
  if ([MAPPING_VERSION, LEGACY_MAPPING_VERSION].includes(job.parser_version)) return extractMappedTable(job);
  if (job.parser_version === RANKING_VERSION) return extractRanking(job.packet);
  if (job.parser_version === QUANTITY_VERSION) return extractQuantities(job.packet);
  if ([TEXT_FACTS_VERSION, TEXT_FACTS_V2].includes(job.parser_version)) return extractTextFacts(job.packet, job.parser_version);
  if (job.parser_version === "name-number-v1") return extractTextRules(job.packet);
  if (job.parser_version === PAGE_TABLE_VERSION) return extractPageTable(job.packet);
  if ([WAGE_VERSION, LEGACY_WAGE_VERSION].includes(job.parser_version)) return extractWageTable(job.packet, job.parser_version);
  if ([PROSE_VERSION, LEGACY_PROSE_VERSION].includes(job.parser_version)) return extractProseRules(job.packet, job.parser_version);
  fail5("parser_version", "Unsupported text parser version.");
}
async function documentInfo(job) {
  if (!job.document) return null;
  if (job.example_id !== "custom-text" || !only(job.document, ["source", "dataset_id"]))
    fail5("invalid_document", "Invalid full-page source or selection.");
  const plan = planPage(job.document.source, job.parser_version === LEGACY_PROSE_VERSION ? LEGACY_PROSE_VERSION : PROSE_VERSION, { semantic: [TEXT_FACTS_VERSION, TEXT_FACTS_V2].includes(job.parser_version), enhanced: [QUANTITY_VERSION, TEXT_FACTS_V2].includes(job.parser_version) });
  const selected = plan.datasets.find((d) => d.id === job.document.dataset_id);
  if (!selected || job.parser_version !== selected.parser_version)
    fail5("invalid_document", "The selected section or parser does not match the retained page.");
  const rebuilt = await createPacket({ source: { text: selected.text, url: job.document.source.url ?? null }, schema: selected.schema }, job.packet.source.received_at);
  if (canonical(rebuilt) !== canonical(job.packet))
    fail5("document_mismatch", "The selected packet does not match its original full-page source.");
  return { plan, selected, hash: await digest(plan.text), original_hash: await digest(job.document.source.text) };
}
function publicDocument(info, job) {
  const selected = info.selected;
  const batches = selected.kind === "prose" ? [] : info.plan.datasets.filter((d) => d.kind === selected.kind && d.source_map[0].document_start === selected.source_map[0].document_start);
  const index = batches.findIndex((d) => d.id === selected.id);
  const start = batches.slice(0, index).reduce((n, d) => n + d.row_count, 0) + 1;
  const selected_scope = batches.length ? {
    kind: "table_batch",
    row_start: start,
    row_end: start + selected.row_count - 1,
    table_rows: batches.reduce((n, d) => n + d.row_count, 0),
    batch_number: index + 1,
    batch_count: batches.length,
    previous_id: batches[index - 1]?.id ?? null,
    next_id: batches[index + 1]?.id ?? null
  } : { kind: "prose", previous_id: null, next_id: null };
  return {
    text: info.plan.text,
    text_hash: info.hash,
    original_text_hash: info.original_hash,
    url: job.packet.source.url,
    selected_id: info.selected.id,
    source_map: info.selected.source_map,
    selected_scope,
    datasets: info.plan.datasets.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, label: d.label, row_count: d.row_count, kind: d.kind })),
    notice: "Only the selected section is parsed/reviewed/exported as current records. The full page is retained; other sections are not implicitly approved. Switching sections starts a new review session."
  };
}
async function checkJob(job) {
  if (!only(job, ["example_id", "packet", "cache_entry", "events", "revisions", "parser_version", "document", "mapping", "retrieval", "task", "proposal"]) || !Array.isArray(job.events) || job.events.length > 64 || job.revisions !== void 0 && (!Array.isArray(job.revisions) || job.revisions.length > 8))
    fail5("invalid_lab_job", "Invalid session. Maximum 64 review events and 8 candidate revisions.");
  if (job.parser_version === TASK_VERSION) {
    validateTask(job.task);
    taskResponse(job);
  } else if (job.task !== void 0 || job.proposal !== void 0) fail5("invalid_task", "Task metadata requires a requested-column session.");
  if (job.mapping !== void 0 && ![MAPPING_VERSION, LEGACY_MAPPING_VERSION].includes(job.parser_version)) fail5("column_mapping", "Recorded column mappings require a mapped table session.");
  if (job.retrieval !== void 0) {
    const r = job.retrieval;
    if (!only(r, ["method", "source", "retrieved_at", "snapshot_hash", "label", "content_kind", "table_selection", "file"]) || !["static-html", "local-chromium", "browser-file"].includes(r.method) || r.content_kind !== void 0 && !["table", "prose"].includes(r.content_kind) || r.source !== job.packet.source.url || r.snapshot_hash !== job.packet.source.text_hash || typeof r.label !== "string" || r.label.length > 1e3 || typeof r.retrieved_at !== "string" || !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(r.retrieved_at))) fail5("retrieval_metadata", "Retrieval description does not match the retained text snapshot.");
    if (r.method === "browser-file") {
      const f = r.file;
      if (r.source !== null || !only(f, ["name", "format", "issues", "inventory"]) || typeof f.name !== "string" || f.name.length > 255 || !["xlsx", "csv", "tsv", "pdf", "docx", "txt"].includes(f.format) || !Array.isArray(f.issues) || !Array.isArray(f.inventory) || [...f.issues, ...f.inventory].some((s) => typeof s !== "string" || s.length > 2048) || f.issues.length > 512 || f.inventory.length > 512) fail5("retrieval_metadata", "Invalid file coverage metadata.");
    } else if (r.file !== void 0) fail5("retrieval_metadata", "File notes require a file import.");
  }
  if (job.retrieval && job.retrieval.table_selection !== void 0) {
    if (job.retrieval.content_kind !== "table") fail5("table_selection", "Selections require table content.");
    await validateTableSelection(job.retrieval.table_selection, job.packet.source.text);
  }
  await revalidate(job.packet, job.cache_entry);
  await documentInfo(job);
  let response;
  if (job.example_id === "custom-text") {
    response = originalResponse(job);
  } else {
    if (!Object.hasOwn(examples, job.example_id)) fail5("invalid_lab_job", "Unknown example.");
    const fixture = examples[job.example_id];
    if (job.packet.source.text !== fixture.source.text || job.packet.source.url !== fixture.source.url || canonical(job.packet.schema) !== canonical(fixture.schema))
      fail5("example_mismatch", "The fictional example source or columns changed. Start again.");
    response = fixture.scripted_response;
  }
  for (const change of job.revisions || []) {
    const prior = await entryFor(job.packet, response);
    await exportInterpretation(job.packet, prior, change.prior_events, { approvedOnly: false });
    response = applyCorrection(job.packet, response, change);
    await revalidate(job.packet, await entryFor(job.packet, response));
  }
  if ([TEXT_FACTS_VERSION, TEXT_FACTS_V2].includes(job.parser_version)) assertTextFactConsistency(response, job.parser_version);
  if (canonical(job.cache_entry.raw_response) !== canonical(response))
    fail5("example_mismatch", "Candidate data differs from its rule output and recorded corrections.");
  return exportInterpretation(job.packet, job.cache_entry, job.events, { approvedOnly: false });
}
async function view(job, result) {
  const info = await documentInfo(job);
  if (info) result.json.validation = documentEvidence(result.json.validation, info.selected, info.plan.text, info.hash);
  const records = result.json.validation.records;
  const mapped = mappingFor(job);
  const meaning = job.parser_version === QUANTITY_VERSION ? { kind: "quantities", title: "Recognized quantities", explanation: "Supported dollar amounts and grouped counts retain their literal units and evidence. Monetary scale, currencies beyond the literal dollar sign, and unstated time bases are not inferred. Every association still needs review." } : job.parser_version === RANKING_VERSION ? rankingMeaning(job.packet) : [TEXT_FACTS_VERSION, TEXT_FACTS_V2].includes(job.parser_version) ? textFactMeaning() : null;
  const unmatched = result.json.validation.outcomes.filter((o) => o.status === "no_result");
  const tableLike = /(?:percent of total employment|mean hourly wage|major occupational group)/i.test(job.packet.source.text) || job.packet.passages.some((p) => /^.+?\s+\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s+\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s+\$?\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s+\$?\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(p.text.trim()));
  return {
    job,
    meaning,
    column_mapping: mapped ? {
      editable: true,
      delimiter: mapped.plan.delimiter,
      columns: mapped.columns.map((c, i) => ({ ...c, source_label: mapped.plan.columns[i].label, required: mapped.schema.fields[i].required, reason: mapped.plan.columns[i].reason, samples: mapped.plan.rows.slice(0, 3).map((r) => r.cells[i]) })),
      skipped_rows: mapped.plan.skipped,
      prefix_lines: mapped.plan.prefix_lines,
      notice: "Suggested from explicit source columns. No code changes needed. Remapping starts a new unapproved review; save the current session first."
    } : {
      editable: false,
      columns: job.packet.schema.fields.map((f) => ({ name: f.name, kind: f.type === "string" ? "text" : /percent/.test(f.name) ? "percent" : /dollars/.test(f.name) ? "dollars" : "number", source_label: f.name.replaceAll("_", " "), samples: records.slice(0, 3).map((r) => r.fields[f.name]?.value) })),
      skipped_rows: [],
      notice: job.task ? "Requested output columns. Proposals and manually added records still require evidence and review." : "Columns selected by the supported extraction method; inspect their source evidence."
    },
    extraction: {
      unmatched_passages: unmatched.length,
      mapping_unresolved: records.length === 0 && tableLike,
      message: records.length === 0 ? job.task ? "Requested columns are ready. No candidate records have been supplied for this task. The retained source is not considered extracted." : tableLike ? "Table-like content detected, but column mapping is unresolved. No records extracted. Keep the complete grouped headings with the rows; manual two-column mode cannot represent this table." : "No supported relationships found. No records extracted; source text is retained." : records.length + " candidate records extracted. " + (unmatched.length ? unmatched.length + (unmatched.length === 1 ? " passage produced" : " passages produced") + " no records; inspect unmatched source text for omissions." : "Inspect the column mapping and evidence before approval. Extraction may still be incomplete.") + (mapped?.plan.skipped.length ? " " + mapped.plan.skipped.length + " malformed rows were not mapped; inspect the column preview." : "")
    },
    ...info ? { document: publicDocument(info, job) } : {},
    evidence_context: Object.fromEntries(records.flatMap((r) => Object.entries(r.fields).map(([name, f]) => [r.id + ":" + name, f.evidence.map((e) => evidenceContext(info ? info.plan.text : job.packet.source.text, e, { document: !!info }))]))),
    validation: result.json.validation,
    review_queue: reviewQueue(job, result.json.validation),
    counts: {
      candidates: records.length,
      approved: records.filter((r) => r.review_status === "approved").length,
      rejected: records.filter((r) => r.review_status === "rejected").length,
      pending: records.filter((r) => r.review_status === "needs_review").length
    },
    interpretation: {
      method: job.parser_version || "fictional-scripted-example",
      columns: job.packet.schema.fields.map((f) => f.name),
      explanation: job.task ? "Task: " + job.task.description + ". Diagram relevance: " + job.task.diagram_relevance + ". " + (job.proposal ? "AI proposals from " + job.proposal.provider + " / " + job.proposal.model + ". Quotations are checked; semantic correctness still requires your review." : "No AI call was made. Add records manually or import a provider proposal.") : meaning ? meaning.explanation : mapped ? "Delimited table: suggested columns from the header and literal cell formats. Identifiers stay text; units are not converted. Malformed rows are listed in the mapping preview. Review the row/header association before approval." : info ? "Full page retained. Current section: " + info.selected.label + ". Other sections remain selectable and are not included in current approvals or records. Review row/header evidence and original-page offsets." : [WAGE_VERSION, LEGACY_WAGE_VERSION].includes(job.parser_version) ? "Pasted wage table: the header defines two employment percentages followed by two hourly wages in dollars. National = United States; local = " + wageHeader(job.packet).local + ". Dollar amounts stay numeric, with currency and hourly basis in the column names. Inspect row and header evidence before approval." : [PROSE_VERSION, LEGACY_PROSE_VERSION].includes(job.parser_version) ? "Suggested measure, value, unit and qualifier columns from explicit quantitative patterns. All suggestions require review. Counts, rates and scores can describe different concepts; inspect the full quotation. Unmatched text is retained. This is limited rule-based interpretation, not general language understanding." : "Limited name/number rules or prewritten examples. All candidates require review."
    },
    notice: job.proposal ? "AI proposals, independently checked against retained source evidence. All records require human review; provider metadata is descriptive, not authenticated provenance." : "Rule-based, scripted or manually requested candidates. Session-only, self-declared review; not an authenticated audit service."
  };
}
async function labFetch(request) {
  const url = new URL(request.url);
  if (url.pathname === "/interpretation" || url.pathname === "/interpretation-client.js") {
    if (request.method !== "GET")
      return new Response("Method not allowed", {
        status: 405,
        headers: { ...headers, Allow: "GET" }
      });
    return new Response(
      url.pathname === "/interpretation" ? LAB_PAGE : lab_client_default,
      {
        headers: {
          ...headers,
          "Content-Type": url.pathname === "/interpretation" ? "text/html; charset=utf-8" : "application/javascript; charset=utf-8"
        }
      }
    );
  }
  if (request.method !== "POST") {
    const response = reply(
      {
        error: "Use a same-origin JSON POST request.",
        code: "method_not_allowed"
      },
      405
    );
    response.headers.set("Allow", "POST");
    return response;
  }
  const origin = request.headers.get("origin");
  if (origin && origin !== url.origin)
    return reply(
      {
        error: "Cross-origin lab requests are not supported.",
        code: "origin_not_allowed"
      },
      403
    );
  try {
    const body = await readBody(request);
    if (url.pathname === "/api/interpretation/select") {
      if (!only(body, ["parent", "options"])) fail5("table_selection", "Choose a captured table and row/column options.");
      return reply(await selectCapturedTable(body.parent, body.options));
    }
    if (url.pathname === "/api/interpretation/start") {
      let packet, response, parserVersion, document, mapping;
      if (body?.example_id === "custom-text") {
        if (!only(body, ["example_id", "source", "schema", "mode", "dataset_id", "mapping", "retrieval", "task", "proposal"]) || body.mode !== void 0 && !["auto", "pair", "requested"].includes(body.mode))
          fail5("invalid_input", "Choose automatic suggestions, manual pair columns or requested columns.");
        if (body.mode !== "requested" && (body.task !== void 0 || body.proposal !== void 0)) fail5("invalid_task", "Task metadata requires requested-column mode.");
        if (body.mapping !== void 0 && (body.mode !== "auto" || body.dataset_id !== void 0)) fail5("column_mapping", "Column mapping requires automatic mode on one pasted table.");
        if (body.mode === "auto" && body.schema !== void 0)
          fail5("invalid_input", "Automatic suggestions choose their own columns. Use manual mode to supply columns.");
        const columns = body.mode === "auto" ? detectColumns(body.source?.text?.replace(/\r\n?/g, "\n"), MAPPING_VERSION, body.retrieval?.content_kind === "table") : null;
        if (body.mapping !== void 0 && !columns) fail5("column_mapping", "No supported delimited header found.");
        const ranking = body.mode === "auto" ? rankingPlan(body.source?.text?.replace(/\r\n?/g, "\n")) : null;
        if (body.mode === "requested") {
          validateTask(body.task);
          if (body.dataset_id !== void 0 || body.mapping !== void 0) fail5("invalid_task", "Start requested columns from one selected source section.");
          packet = await createPacket({ source: body.source, schema: body.schema });
          parserVersion = TASK_VERSION;
        } else if (ranking && body.mapping === void 0 && body.dataset_id === void 0) {
          packet = await createPacket({ source: body.source, schema: ranking.schema });
          parserVersion = RANKING_VERSION;
        } else if (columns && body.dataset_id === void 0) {
          const mapped = mappedSchema(columns, body.mapping);
          mapping = mapped.columns;
          packet = await createPacket({ source: body.source, schema: mapped.schema });
          parserVersion = MAPPING_VERSION;
        } else if (body.mode === "auto" && (needsPageIntake(body.source) || body.dataset_id !== void 0)) {
          const plan = planPage(body.source, PROSE_VERSION, { semantic: true, enhanced: true });
          const selected = body.dataset_id === void 0 ? plan.datasets[0] : plan.datasets.find((d) => d.id === body.dataset_id);
          if (!selected) fail5("invalid_selection", "Choose a listed full-page section.");
          document = { source: body.source, dataset_id: selected.id };
          packet = await createPacket({ source: { text: selected.text, url: body.source.url ?? null }, schema: selected.schema });
          parserVersion = selected.parser_version;
        } else {
          if (body.dataset_id !== void 0) fail5("invalid_selection", "Section selection requires automatic mode.");
          const textFacts = body.mode === "auto" && hasTextRelations(body.source?.text);
          const richerText = textFacts && hasRichQuantities(body.source?.text);
          const rich = body.mode === "auto" && !textFacts && hasRichQuantities(body.source?.text);
          packet = await createPacket({ source: body.source, schema: body.mode === "auto" ? textFacts ? richerText ? TEXT_FACTS_V2_SCHEMA : TEXT_FACTS_SCHEMA : rich ? QUANTITY_SCHEMA : PROSE_SCHEMA : body.schema });
          parserVersion = body.mode === "auto" ? textFacts ? richerText ? TEXT_FACTS_V2 : TEXT_FACTS_VERSION : rich ? QUANTITY_VERSION : PROSE_VERSION : "name-number-v1";
          if (body.mode === "auto" && wageHeader(packet)) {
            packet = await createPacket({ source: body.source, schema: WAGE_SCHEMA }, packet.source.received_at);
            parserVersion = WAGE_VERSION;
          }
        }
        response = originalResponse({ example_id: "custom-text", parser_version: parserVersion, packet, ...mapping ? { mapping } : {}, ...body.retrieval ? { retrieval: body.retrieval } : {}, ...body.mode === "requested" ? { task: body.task, ...body.proposal ? { proposal: body.proposal } : {} } : {} });
      } else {
        if (!only(body, ["example_id"]) || !Object.hasOwn(examples, body.example_id))
          fail5("unknown_example", "Choose an example or paste your own text.");
        const fixture = examples[body.example_id];
        packet = await createPacket(fixture);
        response = fixture.scripted_response;
      }
      const run = await runInterpretation(
        packet,
        await scriptedInterpreter(response)
      );
      if (body.retrieval && document && body.retrieval.snapshot_hash !== await digest(body.source.text.replace(/\r\n?/g, "\n"))) fail5("retrieval_metadata", "The retained page differs from the recorded retrieved snapshot.");
      const job = {
        example_id: body.example_id,
        packet,
        cache_entry: run.cache_entry,
        events: [],
        revisions: [],
        ...document ? { document } : {},
        ...mapping ? { mapping } : {},
        ...body.mode === "requested" ? { task: body.task, ...body.proposal ? { proposal: body.proposal } : {} } : {},
        ...body.retrieval ? { retrieval: document ? { ...body.retrieval, snapshot_hash: packet.source.text_hash } : body.retrieval } : {},
        ...body.example_id === "custom-text" ? { parser_version: parserVersion } : {}
      };
      return reply(await view(job, await checkJob(job)));
    }
    if (url.pathname !== "/api/interpretation/action")
      return reply({ error: "Not found", code: "not_found" }, 404);
    if (!only(body, ["action", "job", "decision", "format", "diagnostic", "correction", "session", "record_ids", "reviewer", "note", "confirmed_mapping"]) || !["revalidate", "review", "export", "correct", "save", "restore", "review_batch", "feedback"].includes(body.action))
      fail5("invalid_action", "Choose revalidate, review, correct, export, save or restore.");
    if (body.action === "restore") {
      if (!only(body, ["action", "session"]) || !only(body.session, ["format", "job"]) || body.session.format !== "toolkit-review-session-v1")
        fail5("invalid_session", "Choose a toolkit review session JSON file, not a CSV or data export.");
      return reply(await view(body.session.job, await checkJob(body.session.job)));
    }
    const result = await checkJob(body.job);
    if (body.action === "feedback") return reply(await feedbackCase(body.job, result.json.validation, originalResponse(body.job)));
    if (body.action === "review_batch") {
      const queue = reviewQueue(body.job, result.json.validation);
      if (!only(body, ["action", "job", "record_ids", "reviewer", "note", "confirmed_mapping"]) || !Array.isArray(body.record_ids) || !body.record_ids.length || body.record_ids.length > 50 || new Set(body.record_ids).size !== body.record_ids.length || body.record_ids.some((id) => !queue.eligible_ids.includes(id)) || body.confirmed_mapping !== true)
        fail5("batch_not_eligible", "Select pending, unchanged table rows with clean checks and explicitly confirm the column mapping. Prose and exceptions need individual review.");
      if (body.record_ids.length > queue.remaining_review_events)
        fail5("review_limit", "This batch exceeds the session review limit. Save the session and reduce the selection.", 413);
      if (typeof body.reviewer !== "string" || !body.reviewer.trim() || body.reviewer.length > 80 || typeof body.note !== "string" || !body.note.trim() || body.note.length > 900)
        fail5("invalid_review", "Enter a reviewer name and a batch review note (up to 900 characters).");
      const events = await appendReviewBatch(
        body.job.packet,
        body.job.cache_entry,
        body.job.events,
        body.record_ids.map((id) => ({
          record_id: id,
          decision: "approved",
          reviewer: body.reviewer.trim(),
          note: "Batch table review (" + body.record_ids.length + " selected rows): " + body.note.trim(),
          confirmed_association: true
        }))
      );
      const job = { ...body.job, events };
      return reply(await view(job, await checkJob(job)));
    }
    if (body.action === "save") {
      const session = JSON.stringify({ format: "toolkit-review-session-v1", job: body.job });
      if (new TextEncoder().encode(session).byteLength > 1e6)
        fail5("session_limit", "This review session exceeds the portable file limit. Export diagnostic JSON instead.", 413);
      return new Response(session + "\n", { headers: {
        ...headers,
        "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
        "Content-Disposition": 'attachment; filename="toolkit-review-session.json"'
      } });
    }
    if (body.action === "correct") {
      if ((body.job.revisions || []).length >= 8) fail5("revision_limit", "Maximum 8 revisions. Download diagnostic JSON before starting a new session.");
      if (!only(body.correction, ["record_id", "fields", "reviewer", "note"])) fail5("invalid_correction", "Unexpected correction fields.");
      const change = { ...body.correction, at: (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toISOString(), prior_events: body.job.events };
      const response = applyCorrection(body.job.packet, body.job.cache_entry.raw_response, change);
      const job = {
        ...body.job,
        revisions: [...body.job.revisions || [], change],
        events: [],
        cache_entry: await entryFor(body.job.packet, response)
      };
      return reply(await view(job, await checkJob(job)));
    }
    if (body.action === "review") {
      if (body.job.events.length >= 64)
        fail5(
          "review_limit",
          "This demo is limited to 64 review events. Download a diagnostic report, then load a new example.",
          413
        );
      const events = await appendReview(
        body.job.packet,
        body.job.cache_entry,
        body.job.events,
        body.decision
      );
      const job = { ...body.job, events };
      return reply(await view(job, await checkJob(job)));
    }
    if (body.action === "revalidate") return reply(await view(body.job, result));
    if (!["csv", "json"].includes(body.format) || body.diagnostic !== void 0 && typeof body.diagnostic !== "boolean")
      fail5(
        "invalid_export",
        "Choose CSV or JSON and a boolean diagnostic flag."
      );
    const exported = await exportInterpretation(
      body.job.packet,
      body.job.cache_entry,
      body.job.events,
      { approvedOnly: !body.diagnostic }
    );
    const info = await documentInfo(body.job);
    if (info) {
      exported.json.document = publicDocument(info, body.job);
      exported.json.validation = documentEvidence(exported.json.validation, info.selected, info.plan.text, info.hash);
    }
    exported.json.candidate_revision_history = body.job.revisions || [];
    exported.json.original_candidates = originalResponse(body.job);
    if (body.job.retrieval) exported.json.source_retrieval = { ...body.job.retrieval, notice: "Descriptive session metadata, not authenticated source provenance. Snapshot hash is revalidated." };
    if (body.job.parser_version === RANKING_VERSION) exported.json.interpretation_context = rankingMeaning(body.job.packet);
    if ([TEXT_FACTS_VERSION, TEXT_FACTS_V2].includes(body.job.parser_version)) exported.json.interpretation_context = textFactMeaning();
    if (body.job.task) exported.json.requested_task = body.job.task;
    if (body.job.proposal) exported.json.ai_provider = { provider: body.job.proposal.provider, model: body.job.proposal.model, source_hash: body.job.proposal.source_hash };
    exported.json.method = body.job.parser_version || "fictional-scripted-example";
    exported.json.notice = "Limited rules or scripted examples, with optional human corrections. No AI inference. Original automated findings are retained separately from human review.";
    const prefix = body.diagnostic ? "interpretation-diagnostic" : "interpretation-approved";
    return new Response(
      body.format === "csv" ? exported.csv : JSON.stringify(exported.json, null, 2) + "\n",
      {
        headers: {
          ...headers,
          "Content-Type": body.format === "csv" ? "text/csv; charset=utf-8" : "application/json; charset=utf-8",
          "Content-Disposition": `attachment; filename="${prefix}.${body.format}"`,
          "X-Exported-Records": String(exported.json.counts.exported)
        }
      }
    );
  } catch (error2) {
    return reply(
      {
        error: error2 instanceof ContractError ? error2.message : "The lab request failed. Your current session has not been replaced.",
        code: error2 instanceof ContractError ? error2.code : "lab_request_failed"
      },
      error2.status || (error2 instanceof ContractError ? 400 : 500)
    );
  }
}
async function validatedFeedbackSnapshot(job) {
  const result = await checkJob(job);
  const reviewed = result.json.validation.records.some((r) => ["approved", "rejected"].includes(r.review_status));
  const example = reviewed ? await feedbackCase(job, result.json.validation, originalResponse(job)) : null;
  return makeFeedbackSnapshot(job, example);
}
async function validatedWorkspaceJob(job) {
  const result = await checkJob(job);
  return view(job, result);
}

// src/interpretation/table-export.js
async function exportTable(body, validate) {
  const { parts, total_rows, format } = body;
  if (!["csv", "json"].includes(format) || !Number.isInteger(total_rows) || total_rows < 1 || total_rows > 5e3 || !Array.isArray(parts) || !parts.length || parts.length > 32) throw Error("Choose a captured table with at most 32 batches.");
  const ordered = [...parts].sort((a, b) => a.row_start - b.row_start), records = [], sources = [];
  let next = 1, fields = null, identity = null, pending = 0, rejected = 0, unopened = 0;
  for (const p of ordered) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(p.row_start) || !Number.isInteger(p.row_count) || p.row_start !== next || p.row_count < 1 || p.row_count > 50) throw Error("Table batches overlap or have missing captured rows. Export selections separately.");
    next += p.row_count;
    if (!p.job) {
      unopened += p.row_count;
      continue;
    }
    const view2 = await validate(p.job), r = p.job.retrieval;
    if (!r || r.content_kind !== "table" || p.snapshot_hash !== p.job.packet.source.text_hash || view2.validation.records.length !== p.row_count) throw Error("A review does not match its captured table batch.");
    const id = canonical([r.source, r.retrieved_at, p.job.packet.schema]);
    if (identity !== null && id !== identity) throw Error("Table reviews use different captures or column mappings. Export selections separately.");
    identity = id;
    fields = p.job.packet.schema.fields;
    const seen = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
    for (const row of view2.validation.records) {
      const n = Number(/^row-(\d+)$/.exec(row.id)?.[1]);
      if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 1 || n > p.row_count || seen.has(n)) throw Error("Edited record positions cannot be combined safely. Export this selection separately.");
      seen.add(n);
      if (row.review_status === "approved") records.push({ ...row, source_row: p.row_start + n - 1, snapshot_hash: p.snapshot_hash });
      else if (row.review_status === "rejected") rejected++;
      else pending++;
    }
    sources.push({ row_start: p.row_start, row_count: p.row_count, job: p.job });
  }
  if (next !== total_rows + 1 || !fields) throw Error("The full captured table range is unavailable. Open a table review first.");
  records.sort((a, b) => a.source_row - b.source_row);
  const coverage = { source_rows: total_rows, approved: records.length, pending, rejected, unopened, excluded: total_rows - records.length };
  const result = { format: "toolkit-table-export-v1", coverage, schema: fields, records, sources, notice: "Approved rows only. Pending, rejected and unopened rows are excluded and counted. Captured positions and grouping are descriptive, not authenticated provenance. JSON retains reviewed source text and history." };
  const content = format === "json" ? JSON.stringify(result, null, 2) + "\n" : [["source_row", "record_id", "review_status", ...fields.map((f) => f.name)], ...records.map((r) => [r.source_row, r.id, r.review_status, ...fields.map((f) => r.fields[f.name].value)])].map((row) => row.map(quoteWorkspaceCSV).join(",")).join("\r\n") + "\r\n";
  return new Response(content, { headers: { "content-type": format === "csv" ? "text/csv; charset=utf-8" : "application/json", "cache-control": "no-store", "X-Exported-Records": String(records.length), "X-Excluded-Rows": String(coverage.excluded) } });
}

// src/interpretation/workspace-api.js
var reply2 = (value, status = 200) => Response.json(value, { status, headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store", "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff" } });
async function workspaceAPI(request, env) {
  const url = new URL(request.url), origin = request.headers.get("origin");
  if (origin && origin !== url.origin || request.headers.get("sec-fetch-site") === "cross-site") return reply2({ error: "Workspace requests must come from the same origin." }, 403);
  if (request.method !== "POST" || !request.headers.get("content-type")?.startsWith("application/json")) return reply2({ error: "Use JSON POST." }, 405);
  try {
    const reader = request.body?.getReader();
    if (!reader) throw Error("JSON body required.");
    const chunks = [];
    let size = 0;
    while (true) {
      const { done, value } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      size += value.length;
      if (size > 4e6) {
        await reader.cancel();
        return reply2({ error: "Workspace request exceeds 4 MB." }, 413);
      }
      chunks.push(value);
    }
    const buffer = new Uint8Array(size);
    let at = 0;
    for (const c of chunks) {
      buffer.set(c, at);
      at += c.length;
    }
    const body = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(buffer));
    if (body.action === "urls") {
      if (!Array.isArray(body.urls) || !body.urls.length || body.urls.length > 10) throw Error("Add one to ten public HTTPS URLs.");
      return reply2({ urls: [...new Set(body.urls.map((value) => {
        const u = publicURL(value);
        u.hash = "";
        return u.href;
      }))] });
    }
    if (body.action === "replace_job") {
      const old = await validatedWorkspaceJob(body.current), next = await validatedWorkspaceJob(body.job);
      if (!next.job.mapping || next.job.events.length || (next.job.revisions || []).length || old.job.packet.source.text_hash !== next.job.packet.source.text_hash || old.job.packet.source.url !== next.job.packet.source.url) throw Error("Only an explicitly remapped, unreviewed copy of this source can replace its review.");
      return reply2({ job: next.job, counts: next.counts, schema_key: await schemaKey(next.job), columns: next.job.packet.schema.fields.map((f) => f.name) });
    }
    if (body.action === "update_job") {
      const old = await validatedWorkspaceJob(body.current), next = await validatedWorkspaceJob(body.job);
      if (old.job.packet.hash !== next.job.packet.hash) throw Error("This review belongs to a different source snapshot. Reopen it from the workspace.");
      const a = (await makeFeedbackSnapshot(old.job, null)).history, b = (await makeFeedbackSnapshot(next.job, null)).history;
      const prefix = (x, y) => x.length <= y.length && x.every((h, i) => h === y[i]);
      if (prefix(b, a)) return reply2({ stale: true });
      if (!prefix(a, b)) throw Error("Conflicting review edits. Keep both histories and reopen the intended version; no update was applied.");
      return reply2({ job: next.job, counts: next.counts, schema_key: await schemaKey(next.job), columns: next.job.packet.schema.fields.map((f) => f.name) });
    }
    if (body.action === "match") return reply2(matchRecipe(body.recipe, body.tables, body.url));
    if (body.action === "check_job") {
      const v = await validatedWorkspaceJob(body.job);
      return reply2({ job: v.job, counts: v.counts, schema_key: await schemaKey(v.job), columns: v.job.packet.schema.fields.map((f) => f.name) });
    }
    if (body.action === "table_export") return await exportTable(body, validatedWorkspaceJob);
    if (["save", "snapshot", "restore", "export"].includes(body.action)) {
      const w = body.action === "restore" ? (await verifyWorkspaceSnapshot(body.snapshot)).workspace : workspaceShape(body.workspace);
      const checked = [];
      for (const entry of w.entries) if (entry.job) checked.push({ entry, view: await validatedWorkspaceJob(entry.job), key: await schemaKey(entry.job) });
      if (body.action === "restore") return reply2({ workspace: w, groups: await groups(checked) });
      if (body.action === "snapshot") return reply2({ snapshot: await makeWorkspaceSnapshot(w) });
      if (body.action === "save") {
        const snapshot = await makeWorkspaceSnapshot(w);
        if (!env?.LOCAL_WORKSPACE) return reply2({ saved: false, snapshot, message: "Drive workspace storage is not connected. Download a portable workspace." });
        if (!["127.0.0.1", "localhost", "[::1]"].includes(url.hostname)) return reply2({ error: "Drive workspace storage requires the local launcher." }, 403);
        const response2 = await env.LOCAL_WORKSPACE.fetch(new Request("http://workspace/save", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ action: "save", snapshot }) }));
        const data2 = await response2.json();

      }
      const selected = checked.filter((c) => c.key === body.schema_key && c.entry.status === "ready");
      if (!selected.length) throw Error("Choose a compatible schema group first.");
      const fields = selected[0].entry.job.packet.schema.fields, rows = [];

      for (const { entry, view: view2 } of selected) {
        const reviewHash = await digest(entry.job);
        reviewHashes.set(entry.id, reviewHash);
        for (const row of view2.validation.records.filter((r) => r.review_status === "approved")) rows.push({ source_id: entry.id, review_hash: reviewHash, source_url: entry.job.packet.source.url, source_label: entry.job.retrieval?.label || "Pasted source", snapshot_hash: entry.job.packet.source.text_hash, record_id: row.id, review_status: row.review_status, fields: row.fields });
      }
      if (body.format === "csv") {
        const header = ["_toolkit_source_id", "_toolkit_review_hash", "_toolkit_source_url", "_toolkit_source_label", "_toolkit_snapshot_hash", "_toolkit_record_id", "_toolkit_review_status", ...fields.map((f) => f.name)];
        const csv = [header, ...rows.map((r) => [r.source_id, r.review_hash, r.source_url, r.source_label, r.snapshot_hash, r.record_id, r.review_status, ...fields.map((f) => r.fields[f.name].value)])].map((r) => r.map(quoteWorkspaceCSV).join(",")).join("\r\n") + "\r\n";
        return new Response(csv, { headers: { "Content-Type": "text/csv; charset=utf-8", "Content-Disposition": 'attachment; filename="workspace-approved.csv"', "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
      }
      if (body.format !== "json") throw Error("Choose CSV or JSON.");
      return reply2({ format: "toolkit-workspace-export-v1", name: w.name, schema: fields, records: rows, sources: selected.map(({ entry }) => ({ source_id: entry.id, review_hash: reviewHashes.get(entry.id), requested_url: entry.url, url: entry.job.packet.source.url, packet: entry.job.packet, retrieval: entry.job.retrieval || null, review_history: entry.job.events, candidate_revision_history: entry.job.revisions || [] })), notice: "Approved records only; source packets retain full source text including unapproved content. Sources are not deduplicated or joined. Review names are self-declared." });
    }
    if (!["list", "read"].includes(body.action)) throw Error("Unknown workspace action.");
    if (!env?.LOCAL_WORKSPACE) return reply2({ enabled: false, heads: [], conflicts: [], message: "Use the local launcher and connect Google Drive in Interpretation Lab." });
    if (!["127.0.0.1", "localhost", "[::1]"].includes(url.hostname)) return reply2({ error: "Workspace storage requires a loopback host." }, 403);
    const response = await env.LOCAL_WORKSPACE.fetch(new Request("http://workspace/" + body.action, { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(body) }));
    const data = await response.json();
    if (!response.ok) return reply2(data, response.status);
    if (body.action === "read") {
      await verifyWorkspaceSnapshot(data.snapshot);
      for (const e of data.snapshot.workspace.entries) if (e.job) await validatedWorkspaceJob(e.job);
    }
    return reply2(data);
  } catch (error2) {
    return reply2({ error: error2.message }, 422);
  }
}
async function groups(checked) {
  const result = [];
  for (const c of checked.filter((c2) => c2.entry.status === "ready")) {
    let g = result.find((g2) => g2.key === c.key);
    if (!g) {
      g = { key: c.key, columns: c.entry.job.packet.schema.fields.map((f) => f.name), sources: 0, approved: 0, pending: 0 };
      result.push(g);
    }
    g.sources++;
    g.approved += c.view.counts.approved;
    g.pending += c.view.counts.pending;
  }
  return result;
}

// src/interpretation/feedback-storage-api.js
var reply3 = (data, status = 200) => Response.json(data, { status, headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store", "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff" } });
async function feedbackStorage(request, env) {
  const url = new URL(request.url), origin = request.headers.get("origin");
  if (origin && origin !== url.origin || request.headers.get("sec-fetch-site") === "cross-site") return reply3({ error: "Feedback storage is available only to the same-origin local app." }, 403);
  if (request.method !== "POST" || !request.headers.get("content-type")?.startsWith("application/json")) return reply3({ error: "Use a same-origin JSON POST." }, 405);
  if (!env?.LOCAL_FEEDBACK) return reply3({ enabled: false, message: "Automatic feedback storage requires the normal local launcher. Portable downloads still work." });
  if (!["127.0.0.1", "localhost", "[::1]"].includes(url.hostname)) return reply3({ error: "Feedback storage requires a loopback host." }, 403);
  try {
    const reader = request.body?.getReader();
    if (!reader) throw Error("A JSON request body is required.");
    const chunks = [];
    let length = 0;
    while (true) {
      const { done, value } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      length += value.byteLength;
      if (length > 1e6) {
        await reader.cancel();
        return reply3({ error: "Feedback request exceeds 1 MB." }, 413);
      }
      chunks.push(value);
    }
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(length);
    let at = 0;
    for (const chunk of chunks) {
      bytes.set(chunk, at);
      at += chunk.length;
    }
    const body = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(bytes));
    if (!["status", "configure", "list", "read", "save"].includes(body.action)) return reply3({ error: "Unknown feedback storage action." }, 400);
    if (body.action === "save") {
      const snapshot = await validatedFeedbackSnapshot(body.job);
      const response2 = await env.LOCAL_FEEDBACK.fetch(new Request("http://feedback/save", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ action: "save", snapshot }) }));
      const stored = await response2.json();
      return reply3({ ...stored, ...response2.ok ? { snapshot } : {} }, response2.status);
    }
    const response = await env.LOCAL_FEEDBACK.fetch(new Request("http://feedback/" + body.action, { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(body) }));
    const data = await response.json();
    if (!response.ok) return reply3(data, response.status);
    if (body.action === "read") {
      const snapshot = data.snapshot, job = snapshot?.example?.job || snapshot?.job;
      if (canonical(await validatedFeedbackSnapshot(job)) !== canonical(snapshot)) throw Error("Stored feedback differs from its validated review history.");
    }
    return reply3(data);
  } catch (e) {
    return reply3({ error: e.message || "Feedback storage failed." }, 422);
  }
}

function isInvalidCodePoint(codePoint) {
  return codePoint === 0 || codePoint >= 55296 && codePoint <= 57343 || codePoint > 1114111;
}
function replaceCodePoint(codePoint) {
  if (isInvalidCodePoint(codePoint)) {
    return 65533;
  }
  if (codePoint >= 128 && codePoint <= 159) {
    return c1[codePoint - 128] || codePoint;
  }
  return codePoint;
}
function codePointToString(codePoint) {
  return codePoint - 1 >>> 0 < 127 || codePoint - 160 >>> 0 < 55136 ? String.fromCharCode(codePoint) : String.fromCodePoint(replaceCodePoint(codePoint));
}

var BASE91_INVERSE = /* @__PURE__ */ (() => {
  const table2 = new Uint8Array(127);
  let code = 0;
  for (let char = 33; char <= 126; char++) {
    if (char !== 34 && char !== 36 && char !== 92) {
      table2[char] = code++;
    }
  }
  return table2;
})();
function decodeTrieDict(input, resultLength, atomCount, dict1AtomCount, ngramCount, dictSize) {
  const base = 91;
  const inputLength = input.length;
  const twoCharBias = dictSize * (base - 1);
  let pos = 0;
  const readSlotCode = () => {
    const c12 = BASE91_INVERSE[input.charCodeAt(pos++)];
    return c12 < dictSize ? c12 : c12 * base - twoCharBias + BASE91_INVERSE[input.charCodeAt(pos++)];
  };
  const dict2AtomCount = atomCount - dict1AtomCount;
  const slotCount = atomCount + ngramCount;
  const single = new Int32Array(slotCount);
  single.fill(-1, dict1AtomCount, dictSize);
  single.fill(-1, dictSize + dict2AtomCount, slotCount);
  const start = new Int32Array(slotCount);
  const length = new Int32Array(slotCount);
  function decodeDelta(count, off) {
    let previous = 0;
    let slot = off;
    const end = off + count;
    while (slot < end) {
      const code = BASE91_INVERSE[input.charCodeAt(pos++)];
      if (code < 89) {
        previous += code;
        single[slot++] = previous;
      } else if (code === 89) {
        let runLength = BASE91_INVERSE[input.charCodeAt(pos++)] + 2;
        while (runLength--)
          single[slot++] = ++previous;
      } else {
        const next = BASE91_INVERSE[input.charCodeAt(pos++)];
        previous += 89 + // eslint-disable-next-line unicorn/prefer-minimal-ternary -- branches read a different number of side-effecting input bytes
        (next < 90 ? next * base + BASE91_INVERSE[input.charCodeAt(pos++)] : BASE91_INVERSE[input.charCodeAt(pos++)] * 8281 + BASE91_INVERSE[input.charCodeAt(pos++)] * base + BASE91_INVERSE[input.charCodeAt(pos++)]);
        single[slot++] = previous;
      }
    }
  }
  decodeDelta(dict1AtomCount, 0);
  decodeDelta(dict2AtomCount, dictSize);
  const references = new Int32Array(ngramCount * 2);
  let poolSize = 0;
  let ngramIndex = 0;
  function readNgramReferences(count, startSlot) {
    for (let index = 0; index < count; index++) {
      const slot = startSlot + index;
      const a = readSlotCode();
      const b = readSlotCode();
      references[ngramIndex * 2] = a;
      references[ngramIndex * 2 + 1] = b;
      ngramIndex += 1;
      start[slot] = poolSize;
      const entryLength = (single[a] < 0 ? length[a] : 1) + (single[b] < 0 ? length[b] : 1);
      length[slot] = entryLength;
      poolSize += entryLength;
    }
  }
  readNgramReferences(ngramCount - dictSize + dict1AtomCount, dictSize + dict2AtomCount);
  readNgramReferences(dictSize - dict1AtomCount, dict1AtomCount);
  const pool = new Uint16Array(poolSize);
  let write = 0;
  for (let index = 0; index < ngramIndex; index++) {
    for (let half = 0; half < 2; half++) {
      const source = references[index * 2 + half];
      const value = single[source];
      if (value < 0) {
        let read = start[source];
        const readEnd = read + length[source];
        while (read < readEnd)
          pool[write++] = pool[read++];
      } else {
        pool[write++] = value;
      }
    }
  }
  const out = new Uint16Array(resultLength);
  let outIndex = 0;
  while (pos < inputLength) {
    let slot = BASE91_INVERSE[input.charCodeAt(pos++)];
    if (slot >= dictSize) {
      slot = slot * base - twoCharBias + BASE91_INVERSE[input.charCodeAt(pos++)];
    }
    const value = single[slot];
    if (value < 0) {
      let read = start[slot];
      const readEnd = read + length[slot];
      while (read < readEnd)
        out[outIndex++] = pool[read++];
    } else {
      out[outIndex++] = value;
    }
  }
  return out;
}

// node_modules/entities/dist/internal/bin-trie-flags.js
var BinTrieFlags;
(function(BinTrieFlags2) {
  BinTrieFlags2[BinTrieFlags2["VALUE_LENGTH"] = 49152] = "VALUE_LENGTH";
  BinTrieFlags2[BinTrieFlags2["FLAG13"] = 8192] = "FLAG13";
  BinTrieFlags2[BinTrieFlags2["BRANCH_LENGTH"] = 8064] = "BRANCH_LENGTH";
  BinTrieFlags2[BinTrieFlags2["JUMP_TABLE"] = 127] = "JUMP_TABLE";
  BinTrieFlags2[BinTrieFlags2["VALUE_MASK"] = 8191] = "VALUE_MASK";
})(BinTrieFlags || (BinTrieFlags = {}));

// node_modules/entities/dist/decode.js
var CharCodes;
(function(CharCodes2) {
  CharCodes2[CharCodes2["AMP"] = 38] = "AMP";
  CharCodes2[CharCodes2["NUM"] = 35] = "NUM";
  CharCodes2[CharCodes2["SEMI"] = 59] = "SEMI";
  CharCodes2[CharCodes2["EQUALS"] = 61] = "EQUALS";
  CharCodes2[CharCodes2["ZERO"] = 48] = "ZERO";
  CharCodes2[CharCodes2["NINE"] = 57] = "NINE";
  CharCodes2[CharCodes2["LOWER_A"] = 97] = "LOWER_A";
  CharCodes2[CharCodes2["LOWER_X"] = 120] = "LOWER_X";
})(CharCodes || (CharCodes = {}));
var TO_LOWER_BIT = 32;
var CONSUMED_SHIFT = 21;
var CODE_POINT_MASK = 2097151;
var CONSUMED_OVERFLOW = 2047;
var longNumericConsumed = 0;
function unpackConsumed(packed) {
  const consumed = packed >>> CONSUMED_SHIFT;
  return consumed === CONSUMED_OVERFLOW ? longNumericConsumed : consumed;
}
function isNumber(code) {
  return code - CharCodes.ZERO >>> 0 <= 9;
}
function isHexadecimalCharacter(code) {
  return (code | TO_LOWER_BIT) - CharCodes.LOWER_A >>> 0 <= 5;
}
function isAlpha(code) {
  return (code | TO_LOWER_BIT) - CharCodes.LOWER_A >>> 0 <= 25;
}
function isEntityInAttributeInvalidEnd(code) {
  return code === CharCodes.EQUALS || isAlpha(code) || isNumber(code);
}
var EntityDecoderState;
(function(EntityDecoderState2) {
  EntityDecoderState2[EntityDecoderState2["EntityStart"] = 0] = "EntityStart";
  EntityDecoderState2[EntityDecoderState2["NumericStart"] = 1] = "NumericStart";
  EntityDecoderState2[EntityDecoderState2["NumericDecimal"] = 2] = "NumericDecimal";
  EntityDecoderState2[EntityDecoderState2["NumericHex"] = 3] = "NumericHex";
  EntityDecoderState2[EntityDecoderState2["NamedEntity"] = 4] = "NamedEntity";
})(EntityDecoderState || (EntityDecoderState = {}));
var DecodingMode;
(function(DecodingMode2) {
  DecodingMode2[DecodingMode2["Legacy"] = 0] = "Legacy";
  DecodingMode2[DecodingMode2["Strict"] = 1] = "Strict";
  DecodingMode2[DecodingMode2["Attribute"] = 2] = "Attribute";
})(DecodingMode || (DecodingMode = {}));
function determineBranch(decodeTree, current, nodeIndex, char) {
  const branchCount = (current & BinTrieFlags.BRANCH_LENGTH) >> 7;
  const jumpOffset = current & BinTrieFlags.JUMP_TABLE;
  if (jumpOffset) {
    if (branchCount === 0) {
      return char === jumpOffset ? nodeIndex : -1;
    }
    const slot = char - jumpOffset;
    if (slot >>> 0 >= branchCount)
      return -1;
    const stored = decodeTree[nodeIndex + slot];
    return stored === 0 ? -1 : nodeIndex + branchCount + stored - 1 & 65535;
  }
  if (branchCount === 0)
    return -1;
  const packedKeySlots = branchCount + 1 >> 1;
  const branchEnd = nodeIndex + packedKeySlots + branchCount;
  for (let index = 0; index < branchCount; index++) {
    const packed = decodeTree[nodeIndex + (index >> 1)];
    const key = packed >> ((index & 1) << 3) & 255;
    if (key === char) {
      const pointerIndex = nodeIndex + packedKeySlots + index;
      return branchEnd + decodeTree[pointerIndex] & 65535;
    }
    if (key > char)
      return -1;
  }
  return -1;
}
function readTrieValue(decodeTree, nodeIndex, valueLength) {
  if (valueLength === 1) {
    return String.fromCharCode(decodeTree[nodeIndex] & BinTrieFlags.VALUE_MASK);
  }
  if (valueLength === 2) {
    return String.fromCharCode(decodeTree[nodeIndex + 1]);
  }
  return String.fromCharCode(decodeTree[nodeIndex + 1], decodeTree[nodeIndex + 2]);
}
function parseNumericEntity(input, numberStart, inputLength) {
  let offset = numberStart + 1;
  let cp = 0;
  let digitStart = offset;
  if (offset < inputLength && (input.charCodeAt(offset) | TO_LOWER_BIT) === CharCodes.LOWER_X) {
    offset += 1;
    digitStart = offset;
    while (offset < inputLength) {
      const char = input.charCodeAt(offset);
      if (isNumber(char)) {
        cp = cp * 16 + (char - CharCodes.ZERO);
      } else if (isHexadecimalCharacter(char)) {
        cp = cp * 16 + ((char | TO_LOWER_BIT) - CharCodes.LOWER_A + 10);
      } else {
        break;
      }
      offset += 1;
    }
  } else {
    while (offset < inputLength) {
      const digit = input.charCodeAt(offset) - CharCodes.ZERO;
      if (digit >>> 0 > 9)
        break;
      cp = cp * 10 + digit;
      offset += 1;
    }
  }
  if (offset === digitStart)
    return 0;
  if (offset < inputLength && input.charCodeAt(offset) === CharCodes.SEMI) {
    offset += 1;
  }
  if (cp > 1114111)
    cp = 1114112;
  let consumed = offset - numberStart;
  if (consumed >= CONSUMED_OVERFLOW) {
    longNumericConsumed = consumed;
    consumed = CONSUMED_OVERFLOW;
  }
  return consumed << CONSUMED_SHIFT | cp;
}
function decodeWithTrie(input, isStrict, isAttribute) {
  const decodeTree = htmlDecodeTree;
  let offset = input.indexOf("&");
  if (offset < 0)
    return input;
  const inputLength = input.length;
  let chunkStart = 0;
  let result = "";
  const root = decodeTree[0];
  const rootJumpOffset = root & BinTrieFlags.JUMP_TABLE;
  const rootBranchCount = (root & BinTrieFlags.BRANCH_LENGTH) >> 7;
  do {
    const entityStart = offset + 1;
    const firstChar = input.charCodeAt(entityStart);
    let consumed;
    let value;
    if (firstChar === CharCodes.NUM) {
      const packed = parseNumericEntity(input, entityStart, inputLength);
      consumed = unpackConsumed(packed);
      if (isStrict && consumed > 0 && input.charCodeAt(entityStart + consumed - 1) !== CharCodes.SEMI) {
        consumed = 0;
      }
      value = consumed === 0 ? "" : codePointToString(packed & CODE_POINT_MASK);
    } else if (isAlpha(firstChar)) {
      consumed = 0;
      value = "";
      const rootSlotIndex = firstChar - rootJumpOffset;
      let nodeIndex;
      if (rootSlotIndex >>> 0 < rootBranchCount) {
        const stored = decodeTree[1 + rootSlotIndex];
        nodeIndex = stored === 0 ? -1 : rootBranchCount + stored & 65535;
      } else {
        nodeIndex = -1;
      }
      let bestNodeIndex = 0;
      let bestValueLength = 0;
      let current = nodeIndex < 0 ? 0 : decodeTree[nodeIndex];
      let index = entityStart + 1;
      trie: while (index < inputLength) {
        while (
          // Value-less, non-run node with a nonzero jump offset.
          (current & (BinTrieFlags.VALUE_LENGTH | BinTrieFlags.FLAG13)) === 0 && (current & BinTrieFlags.JUMP_TABLE) !== 0
        ) {
          const jumpOffset = current & BinTrieFlags.JUMP_TABLE;
          const branchCount = (current & BinTrieFlags.BRANCH_LENGTH) >> 7;
          if (branchCount === 0) {
            if (input.charCodeAt(index) !== jumpOffset)
              break trie;
            nodeIndex += 1;
          } else {
            const slot = input.charCodeAt(index) - jumpOffset;
            if (slot >>> 0 >= branchCount)
              break trie;
            const stored = decodeTree[nodeIndex + 1 + slot];
            if (stored === 0)
              break trie;
            nodeIndex = nodeIndex + branchCount + stored & 65535;
          }
          current = decodeTree[nodeIndex];
          index += 1;
          if (index >= inputLength)
            break trie;
        }
        if ((current & (BinTrieFlags.VALUE_LENGTH | BinTrieFlags.FLAG13)) === BinTrieFlags.FLAG13) {
          const runLength = (current & BinTrieFlags.BRANCH_LENGTH) >> 7;
          if (input.charCodeAt(index) !== (current & BinTrieFlags.JUMP_TABLE)) {
            break;
          }
          index += 1;
          const remaining = runLength - 1;
          let wordIndex = nodeIndex + 1;
          let charIndexInPacked = 0;
          for (; charIndexInPacked + 1 < remaining; charIndexInPacked += 2) {
            const packed = decodeTree[wordIndex];
            if (input.charCodeAt(index) !== (packed & 255))
              break trie;
            index += 1;
            if (input.charCodeAt(index) !== (packed >> 8 & 255))
              break trie;
            index += 1;
            wordIndex += 1;
          }
          if (charIndexInPacked < remaining) {
            if (input.charCodeAt(index) !== (decodeTree[wordIndex] & 255))
              break;
            index += 1;
          }
          nodeIndex += 1 + (runLength >> 1);
          current = decodeTree[nodeIndex];
          continue;
        }
        const valueLength = current >>> 14;
        const char = input.charCodeAt(index);
        if (valueLength !== 0) {
          if (char === CharCodes.SEMI) {
            consumed = index - entityStart + 1;
            value = valueLength === 1 ? String.fromCharCode(current & BinTrieFlags.VALUE_MASK) : readTrieValue(decodeTree, nodeIndex, valueLength);
            break;
          }
          if (!isStrict && (current & BinTrieFlags.FLAG13) === 0) {
            consumed = index - entityStart;
            bestNodeIndex = nodeIndex;
            bestValueLength = valueLength;
          }
          if (valueLength === 1)
            break;
        }
        const next = determineBranch(decodeTree, current, nodeIndex + (valueLength || 1), char);
        if (next < 0)
          break;
        nodeIndex = next;
        current = decodeTree[nodeIndex];
        index += 1;
      }
      if (value === "") {
        const finalVL = current >>> 14;
        if (finalVL !== 0 && !isStrict && (current & BinTrieFlags.FLAG13) === 0) {
          consumed = index - entityStart;
          bestNodeIndex = nodeIndex;
          bestValueLength = finalVL;
        }
        if (consumed > 0) {
          value = readTrieValue(decodeTree, bestNodeIndex, bestValueLength);
        }
      }
    } else {
      consumed = 0;
      value = "";
    }
    if (consumed === 0 || isAttribute && firstChar !== CharCodes.NUM && input.charCodeAt(entityStart + consumed - 1) !== CharCodes.SEMI && entityStart + consumed < inputLength && isEntityInAttributeInvalidEnd(input.charCodeAt(entityStart + consumed))) {
      offset = entityStart;
    } else {
      if (chunkStart < offset) {
        result += input.slice(chunkStart, offset);
      }
      result += value;
      offset = chunkStart = entityStart + consumed;
    }
    if (input.charCodeAt(offset) !== CharCodes.AMP) {
      offset = input.indexOf("&", offset);
    }
  } while (offset >= 0);
  return result + input.slice(chunkStart);
}
function decodeHTML(htmlString, mode = DecodingMode.Legacy) {
  return decodeWithTrie(htmlString, mode === DecodingMode.Strict, mode === DecodingMode.Attribute);
}

async function articleBlocks(page2) {
  const blocks = [], stack = [];
  let ignored = 0, primary = 0, size = 0;
  await new HTMLRewriter().on("script,style,template,noscript,nav,footer,header,form,table", { element(el) {
    ignored++;
    el.onEndTag(() => ignored--);
  } }).on("main,article", { element(el) {
    primary++;
    el.onEndTag(() => primary--);
  } }).on("p,h1,h2,h3,li", { element(el) {
    const block = { text: "", primary: primary > 0, ignored: ignored > 0 };
    stack.push(block);
    el.onEndTag(() => {
      if (stack.at(-1) === block) stack.pop();
      if (block.ignored) return;
      const text = decodeHTML(block.text).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
      if (!text) return;
      size += text.length;
      if (size > 64e3 || blocks.length >= 512) error("source_limit", "Article text exceeds the 64,000-character / 512-block limit; use a smaller source.");
      blocks.push({ ...block, text });
    });
  } }).onDocument({ text(chunk) {
    if (stack.length && !ignored) stack.at(-1).text += chunk.text;
  } }).transform(new Response(page2)).arrayBuffer();
  return (blocks.some((b) => b.primary) ? blocks.filter((b) => b.primary) : blocks).map((b) => b.text);
}
function tableDatasets(tables, issues) {
  const datasets = [];
  for (const [index, t] of tables.entries()) {
    const title = t.title || t.caption || "Table " + (index + 1), table_key = "source-table-" + (index + 1);

        if (plan.datasets.some((d) => d.kind !== "prose")) {
          let start = 1;

          for (const d of plan.datasets) {
            datasets.push({ kind: d.kind === "prose" ?             start += d.row_count || 0;
          }
          continue;
        }
      }
      if (t.unsupported || t.supported === false) {

        continue;
      }
      if (!t.rows.length) continue;
      if (t.headers.length < 2 || t.headers.length > 100) {
        issues.push(title + ": Import requires 2\u2013100 source columns.");
        continue;
      }
      const groups2 = t.headers.length <= 8 ? [t.headers.map((_, i) => i)] : Array.from({ length: Math.ceil((t.headers.length - 1) / 7) }, (_, part) => [0, ...Array.from({ length: Math.min(7, t.headers.length - 1 - part * 7) }, (_2, i) => 1 + part * 7 + i)]);
      const normalizeCells = (cells) => cells.map((c) => String(c).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim());
      const line = (cells) => normalizeCells(cells).join("	");
      const table_name = descriptiveTableName(title, t.headers);
      const local = [];

        const selectedHeaders = columns.map((i) => t.headers[i]), ranked = rankShape(selectedHeaders);
        const context = ranked && title.length <= 500 ? "Table context: " + title + "\n\n" : "";
        const header = line(selectedHeaders);
        if (header.length > 2048) error("source_limit", "A table header exceeds the evidence limit.");
        const rowLimit = ranked ? Math.min(24, Math.floor(50 / (ranked.wide ? ranked.ranks.length : 1))) : 24;
        let batch = [], length = context.length + header.length, start = 1;
        const range = columns.slice(1);
        const columnLabel = groups2.length === 1 ? "" : " \xB7 " + (columns.at(-1) < 8 ? "columns 1\u2013" + columns.length : "shared column 1 + columns " + (range[0] + 1) + (range.length > 1 ? "\u2013" + (range.at(-1) + 1) : "")) + " of " + t.headers.length;
        const flush = () => {
          if (!batch.length) return;
          const text = context + header + "\n" + batch.join("\n");
          const meaning = rankingPlan(text);
          const mapping = meaning || detectColumns(text, MAPPING_VERSION, true);
          if (!mapping) error("table_mapping", "Source column headings cannot be mapped; no zero-record table was reported as imported.");
          local.push({ kind: "table", table_title: title, table_name, total_rows: t.rows.length, grid: { headers: normalizeCells(selectedHeaders), rows: batch.map((v) => v.split("	")) }, display_label: table_name + " \xB7 rows " + start + "\u2013" + (start + batch.length - 1) + " of " + t.rows.length + columnLabel, label: title + " \xB7 rows " + start + "\u2013" + (start + batch.length - 1) + " of " + t.rows.length + columnLabel, text, row_count: batch.length, column_count: columns.length, record_count: meaning?.factCount ?? batch.length, table_key, row_start: start, total_columns: t.headers.length, column_indices: columns });
          start += batch.length;
          batch = [];
          length = context.length + header.length;
        };
        for (const row of t.rows) {
          const value = line(columns.map((i) => row[i] ?? ""));
          if (value.length > 2048) error("source_limit", "A table row exceeds the 2,048-character evidence limit.");
          if (batch.length === rowLimit || length + value.length + 1 > 12e3) flush();
          batch.push(value);
          length += value.length + 1;
        }
        flush();
      }
      if (groups2.length > 1) issues.push(title + ": " + t.headers.length + " source columns are split into " + groups2.length + " column groups of up to eight. The shared first column supplies context, not a proven unique join key.");
      datasets.push(...local);

    }

function proseDatasets(blocks) {
  const datasets = [];
  let batch = [], length = 0;
  const flush = () => {
    if (batch.length) datasets.push({ kind: "prose", label: "Article text \xB7 part " + (datasets.length + 1), text: batch.join("\n\n"), row_count: null });
    batch = [];
    length = 0;
  };
  for (const block of blocks) {
    if (block.length > 12e3) error("source_limit", "One article block exceeds 12,000 characters; use a smaller source.");
    if (batch.length === 24 || length + block.length + 2 > 12e3) flush();
    batch.push(block);
    length += block.length + 2;
  }
  flush();
  return datasets;
}
async function sourceFetch(request, url, env, { fetchPage, analyze }) {
  const checks = [], issues = [];
  if (request.method !== "POST") return reply4({ error: "POST required" }, 405);
  if (request.headers.get("origin") && request.headers.get("origin") !== url.origin) return reply4({ error: "Cross-origin fetching is blocked." }, 403);
  if (!/^application\/json(?:;|$)/i.test(request.headers.get("content-type") || "")) return reply4({ error: "JSON required" }, 415);
  try {
    const reader = request.body?.getReader();
    let text = "", bytes = 0;
    const decoder2 = new TextDecoder();
    if (reader) try {
      while (true) {
        const { value, done } = await reader.read();
        if (done) break;
        bytes += value.length;
        if (bytes > 4096) {
          await reader.cancel();
          return reply4({ error: "Fetch request exceeds 4 KiB." }, 413);
        }
        text += decoder2.decode(value, { stream: true });
      }
    } finally {
      reader.releaseLock();
    }
    text += decoder2.decode();
    let body;
    try {
      body = JSON.parse(text);
    } catch {

    }
    if (!body || Array.isArray(body) || Object.keys(body).some((k) => k !== "url") || typeof body.url !== "string") return reply4({ error: "Provide one public HTTPS URL." }, 400);
    const { source: fetchedSource, page: page2 } = await fetchPage(body.url, url.hostname);
    let source = fetchedSource;
    checks.push({ method: "static-html", status: "passed", message: "Public HTTPS page fetched within network and size checks." });
    const analysis = await analyze(page2, source, [], { sourceImport: true });
    for (const item of analysis.discovery?.inventory || []) if (item.status === "omitted") issues.push(item.title + ": Not imported \u2014 " + item.reason);
    if (analysis.code === "possible_access_barrier") error("access_barrier", analysis.message);
    let datasets = tableDatasets(analysis.tables, issues), method = "static-html";
    let prose = [];
    try {
      prose = proseDatasets(await articleBlocks(page2));
    } catch (e) {
      issues.push("Article text not imported: " + e.message);
    }
    let supportedProse = false;
    if (!datasets.length) for (const part of prose) {
      if (hasTextRelations(part.text)) {
        supportedProse = true;
        break;
      }
      const rich = hasRichQuantities(part.text), packet = await createPacket({ source: { text: part.text, url: source }, schema: rich ? QUANTITY_SCHEMA : PROSE_SCHEMA });
      if ((rich ? extractQuantities(packet) : extractProseRules(packet)).records.length) {
        supportedProse = true;
        break;
      }
    }
    const jsNeeded = !datasets.length && !supportedProse && analysis.tables.every((t) => !t.rows.length && !t.unsupported) && analysis.signals.app_roots > 0 && analysis.signals.linked_scripts > 0;
    if (jsNeeded) {
      checks.push({ method: "static-html", status: "no_supported_records", message: "No usable table or recognized prose facts; application container and linked scripts indicate possible client rendering." });
      if (!env?.LOCAL_RENDERER) {
        return reply4({ error: "This page may need JavaScript. Automatic rendering is available through the local npm run dev server with an installed Chrome, Edge or Chromium browser.", code: "renderer_unavailable", source, checks, issues }, 422);
      }
      try {
        const response = await env.LOCAL_RENDERER.fetch(new Request("https://local-renderer/render", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ url: source }) }));
        const rendered = await response.json();
        if (!response.ok) throw Error(rendered.error || "Local renderer failed.");

        method = "local-chromium";
        datasets = tableDatasets(rendered.tables, issues);
        if (!datasets.length && rendered.article_blocks?.length) datasets = proseDatasets(rendered.article_blocks);
        checks.push({ method, status: datasets.length ? "passed" : "no_supported_records", message: rendered.diagnostics.message });
        for (const blocked of rendered.diagnostics.blocked_resources || []) issues.push("Blocked resource: " + blocked.reason);
        if (!datasets.length) {
          return reply4({ error: "Ordinary fetching and JavaScript rendering found no importable tables. Images, canvas, login barriers, pagination and unsupported layouts are not interpreted.", code: "both_methods_no_data", source, checks, issues }, 422);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        return reply4({ error: "Ordinary fetching found no supported records. Local JavaScript rendering failed: " + e.message, code: "render_failed", source, checks: [...checks, { method: "local-chromium", status: "failed", message: e.message }], issues }, 422);
      }

      if (selectedCount >= 32 || size + d.text.length > 128e3) {

      }
      size += d.text.length;

    });

    const table_catalog = capturedTableCatalog(datasets);
    for (const d of datasets) if (d.grid) {
      d.table_preview = { headers: d.grid.headers, rows: d.grid.rows.slice(0, 3) };
      delete d.grid;
    }

    for (const [i, d] of datasets.entries()) {
      d.id = "retrieved-" + (i + 1);
      d.snapshot_hash = await digest(d.text);
    }

  } catch (e) {

function clean(value) {
  return value.replace(/\[[^\]]*\]/g, "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}
function normalizeRows(rows) {
  const elements = rows.filter((c) => /^\d+$/.test(clean(c[0] || ""))).map((c) => {
    if (c.length !== 16) throw new Error("Source table columns changed; extraction stopped.");
    const group2 = clean(c[4]);
    return {
      atomic_number: Number(clean(c[0])),
      symbol: clean(c[1]),
      name: clean(c[2]),
      group: /^\d+$/.test(group2) ? Number(group2) : null,
      period: Number(clean(c[5]))
    };
  });
  elements.sort((a, b) => a.atomic_number - b.atomic_number);
  if (elements.length !== 118) throw new Error("Expected 118 elements; extraction stopped.");
  const symbols = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  const names = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  elements.forEach((e, i) => {
    if (e.atomic_number !== i + 1 || !/^[A-Z][a-z]?$/.test(e.symbol) || !/^[A-Za-z]+$/.test(e.name) || symbols.has(e.symbol) || names.has(e.name) || !Number.isInteger(e.period) || e.period < 1 || e.period > 7 || e.group !== null && (e.group < 1 || e.group > 18)) {
      throw new Error("Element identity or range validation failed; extraction stopped.");
    }
    symbols.add(e.symbol);
    names.add(e.name);
  });
  if (elements[0].symbol !== "H" || elements[117].symbol !== "Og") {
    throw new Error("Source identity validation failed.");
  }
  return elements;
}
function toCSV(elements) {

}

    element(el) {

      });
