async function checkPublicDNS(hostname, signal) {
  const answers = await Promise.all(["A", "AAAA"].map(async (type) => {
    const url = new URL("https://cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query");
    url.searchParams.set("name", hostname);
    url.searchParams.set("type", type);
    const r = await fetch(url, { headers: { Accept: "application/dns-json" }, redirect: "manual", signal });
    if (!r.ok) throw new InputError("Public DNS verification is unavailable. Try again later.", 502);
    const body = await r.json();
    if (body.Status !== 0) throw new InputError("The source hostname could not be resolved publicly.");
    return (body.Answer || []).filter((a) => a.type === 1 || a.type === 28).map((a) => a.data);
  }));
  const addresses = answers.flat();
  if (!addresses.length || addresses.some((ip) => !publicAddress(ip))) throw new InputError("Private, reserved, and unresolved network destinations are not supported.");
}
async function readBounded(response) {
  if (Number(response.headers.get("content-length")) > LIMITS2.bytes) {
    await response.body?.cancel();
    throw new InputError("Page exceeds the 2 MiB size limit.", 422);
  }
  if (!response.body) throw new InputError("The source returned an empty page.", 422);
  const reader = response.body.getReader(), chunks = [];
  let size = 0;
  try {
    while (true) {
      const { value, done } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      size += value.byteLength;
      if (size > LIMITS2.bytes) {
        await reader.cancel();
        throw new InputError("Page exceeds the 2 MiB size limit.", 422);
      }
      chunks.push(value);
    }
  } finally {
    reader.releaseLock();
  }
  return new Blob(chunks, { type: "text/html" });
}
async function fetchPublicPage(input, ownHost) {
  let url = publicURL(input);
  const signal = AbortSignal.timeout(15e3);
  for (let redirects = 0; redirects <= 3; redirects++) {
    if (url.hostname === ownHost) throw new InputError("Choose a source page outside this toolkit.");
    await checkPublicDNS(url.hostname, signal);
    const r = await fetch(url.href, { redirect: "manual", signal, headers: { Accept: "text/html", "User-Agent": "GenericScraperToolkit/1.0 (public HTML tables)" } });
    if ([301, 302, 303, 307, 308].includes(r.status)) {
      const location = r.headers.get("location");
      await r.body?.cancel();
      if (!location || redirects === 3) throw new InputError("Source redirected too many times or omitted its destination.", 422);
      url = publicURL(new URL(location, url).href);
      continue;
    }
    if (!r.ok) {
      await r.body?.cancel();
      throw new InputError(`Source returned HTTP ${r.status}. Login-protected or blocked pages are not supported.`, 422);
    }
    if (/^image\//i.test(r.headers.get("content-type") || "")) {
      await r.body?.cancel();
      throw new InputError("This URL returns an image. Reading image-based data requires OCR, which is not enabled. Use an HTML source or an official text/CSV export.", 422);
    }
    if (!/^text\/html(?:;|$)/i.test(r.headers.get("content-type") || "")) {
      await r.body?.cancel();
      throw new InputError("The source must return an HTML webpage.", 422);
    }
    const charset = (r.headers.get("content-type") || "").match(/charset\s*=\s*[\"']?([^;\s\"']+)/i)?.[1];
    if (charset && !/^(utf-?8|us-ascii)$/i.test(charset)) {
      await r.body?.cancel();
      throw new InputError("This first version supports UTF-8 HTML pages only.", 422);
    }
    return { source: url.href, page: await readBounded(r) };
  }
}
async function discoverTables(page2, accessible = false, { sourceImport = false, inventory = [], budget = { scanned: 0, accepted: 0, rows: 0, cells: 0 } } = {}) {
  const rootSelector = accessible ? '[role="table"], [role="grid"]' : "table";
  const rowSelector = accessible ? '[role="row"]' : "tr";
  const cellSelector = accessible ? '[role="cell"], [role="gridcell"], [role="columnheader"], [role="rowheader"]' : "td, th";
  const tables = [], stack = [];
  let totalRows = 0, totalCells = 0, ignored = 0;
  const current = () => stack[stack.length - 1];
  const rewrite = new HTMLRewriter().on(rootSelector, { element(el) {
    if (accessible && el.tagName === "table") {
      if (current()) current().unsupported = "Nested tables are not supported yet.";
      return;
    }
    if (sourceImport ? ++budget.scanned > 100 : tables.length >= LIMITS2.tables) throw new InputError(sourceImport ? "Table discovery exceeds the scan limit of 100 table elements." : "Page exceeds the limit of 20 tables.", 422);
    const parent = current();
    if (parent && !sourceImport) parent.unsupported = "Nested tables are not supported yet.";
    const table2 = { rows: [], caption: accessible ? el.getAttribute("aria-label") || "" : "", unsupported: parent && !sourceImport ? "Nested tables are not supported yet." : null, parent, children: [], sourceIndex: tables.length + 1, role: el.getAttribute("role") || "", classes: el.getAttribute("class") || "" };
    if (parent) parent.children.push(table2);
    tables.push(table2);
    stack.push(table2);
    el.onEndTag(() => {
      if (current() === table2) stack.pop();
    });
  } }).on(rowSelector, { element(el) {
    const table2 = current();
    if (!table2) return;
    if ((sourceImport ? ++budget.rows : ++totalRows) > LIMITS2.rows) throw new InputError("Page exceeds the limit of 5000 total rows.", 422);
    const row = [];
    table2.rows.push(row);
    table2.row = row;
    table2.cell = void 0;
    el.onEndTag(() => {
      if (table2.row === row) {
        table2.row = void 0;
        table2.cell = void 0;
      }
    });
  } }).on(cellSelector, { element(el) {
    const table2 = current();
    if (!table2?.row) return;
    if (table2.row.length >= LIMITS2.columns || (sourceImport ? ++budget.cells : ++totalCells) > LIMITS2.cells) throw new InputError("Page exceeds the cell or column limit.", 422);
    if (["rowspan", "colspan", "aria-rowspan", "aria-colspan"].some((k) => el.hasAttribute(k) && el.getAttribute(k) !== "1")) table2.unsupported = "Merged cells are not supported yet.";
    const cell = { text: "", header: accessible ? el.getAttribute("role") === "columnheader" : el.tagName === "th" };
    table2.row.push(cell);
    table2.cell = cell;
    el.onEndTag(() => {
      if (table2.cell === cell) table2.cell = void 0;
    });
  } }).on("img", { element() {
    if (current()?.cell) current().cell.images = (current().cell.images || 0) + 1;
  } }).on("caption", { element(el) {
    const table2 = current();
    if (!table2) return;
    table2.inCaption = true;
    el.onEndTag(() => {
      table2.inCaption = false;
    });
  } }).on("script, style, template", { element(el) {
    ignored++;
    el.onEndTag(() => {
      ignored--;
    });
  } }).on("br", { element() {
    const t = current();
    if (t?.cell) t.cell.text += " ";
  } }).onDocument({ text(chunk) {
    const table2 = current();
    if (!table2 || ignored) return;
    if (table2.inCaption) {
      table2.caption += chunk.text;
      if (table2.caption.length > LIMITS2.text) throw new InputError("Table caption is too long.", 422);
    } else if (table2.cell) {
      table2.cell.text += chunk.text;
      if (table2.cell.text.length > LIMITS2.text) throw new InputError("A table cell exceeds the text limit.", 422);
    }
  } });
  await rewrite.transform(new Response(page2)).arrayBuffer();
  const normalize = (text) => decodeHTML(text).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  for (const t of tables) {
    t.rows = t.rows.filter((r) => r.length);
    t.wrapper = t.children.length > 0 && t.rows.length === 1 && t.rows[0].length === 1 && !t.rows[0][0].header;
    t.navigation = t.role === "navigation" || /(?:^|\s)(?:navbox(?:-[\w-]+)?|sidebar)(?:\s|$)/.test(t.classes) || !!t.parent?.navigation;
  }
  return tables.filter((t) => t.rows.length).map((t, id) => {
    const width = Math.max(...t.rows.map((r) => r.length));
    let rows = t.rows;
    const heading = rows[0]?.every((c) => c.header);
    let repeated = 0;
    if (sourceImport && heading) {
      const first = rows[0].map((c) => normalize(c.text));
      rows = [rows[0], ...rows.slice(1).filter((r) => {
        const duplicate = r.every((c) => c.header) && r.length === first.length && r.every((c, i) => normalize(c.text) === first[i]);
        if (duplicate) repeated++;
        return !duplicate;
      })];
    }
    const numericCell = (c) => /^[+-]?\$?\s*(?:\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+|\d+)(?:\.\d+)?\s*%?$/.test(normalize(c.text));
    if (rows.slice(heading ? 1 : 0).some((r) => r.some((c) => c.header) && r.every((c) => c.header) && (!sourceImport || !r.some(numericCell)))) t.unsupported ||= "Multiple distinct header rows are not supported yet.";
    if (rows.some((r) => r.length !== width)) t.unsupported ||= "Rows have inconsistent column counts.";
    if (sourceImport) {
      if (t.children.length && !t.wrapper && t.role !== "presentation") t.unsupported ||= "Nested data tables require explicit mapping.";
      if (t.parent && !t.parent.wrapper && t.parent.role !== "presentation" && !t.navigation) t.unsupported ||= "Nested data tables require explicit mapping.";
    }
    const result = {
      id,
      title: normalize(t.caption) || `${accessible ? "Accessible table" : "Table"} ${sourceImport ? t.sourceIndex : id + 1}`,
      headers: heading ? rows[0].map((c) => normalize(c.text)) : Array.from({ length: width }, (_, i) => `Column ${i + 1}`),
      rows: rows.slice(heading ? 1 : 0).map((r) => r.map((c) => normalize(c.text))),
      unsupported: t.unsupported,
      extraction_method: accessible ? "aria-grid" : "html-table"
    };
    if (!sourceImport) return result;
    let reason = "", status = "candidate";
    if (t.navigation) {
      status = "ignored";
      reason = "Navigation table.";
    } else if (t.role === "presentation") {
      status = "ignored";
      reason = "Presentation/layout table; independent child data tables are inspected separately.";
    } else if (t.wrapper) {
      status = "ignored";
      reason = "Single-cell layout wrapper; child data table inspected independently.";
    } else if (!heading && rows.length === 1 && t.rows[0].some((c) => c.images)) {
      status = "ignored";
      reason = "Single-row image/chart layout; image and chart contents are not interpreted.";
    } else if (width < 2) {
      status = "ignored";
      reason = "Single-column layout/list; no two-column dataset was inferred.";
    } else if (budget.accepted >= 20) {
      status = "omitted";
      reason = "20 candidate tables already selected; use a narrower source.";
    } else {
      budget.accepted++;
      if (result.unsupported) {
        status = "unsupported";
        reason = result.unsupported;
      }
    }
    const imageOnly = t.rows.reduce((n, r) => n + r.filter((c) => c.images && !normalize(c.text)).length, 0);
    inventory.push({ table_index: t.sourceIndex, title: result.title.slice(0, 200), rows: result.rows.length, columns: width, status, reason, repeated_headers_omitted: repeated, image_only_cells: imageOnly });
    if (["ignored", "omitted"].includes(status)) return null;
    result.capture_notes = [...repeated ? [repeated + " repeated header rows omitted."] : [], ...imageOnly ? [imageOnly + " image-only cells have no extracted text; OCR is disabled."] : []];
    return result;
  }).filter(Boolean);
}
async function discoverDCIScores(page2) {
  const sections = [];
  let section, row, field;
  const normalize = (text) => decodeHTML(text).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  const capture = (selector, key, destination) => ({ selector, handler: {
    element(el) {
      const target = destination();
      if (!target) return;
      if (key === "title" && target.title) throw new InputError("Multiple DCI divisions in one grid are not supported yet.", 422);
      const current = { target, key, text: "" };
      field = current;
      el.onEndTag(() => {
        target[key] = normalize(current.text);
        if (field === current) field = void 0;
      });
    },
    text(chunk) {
      if (field?.key === key) {
        field.text += chunk.text;
        if (field.text.length > LIMITS2.text) throw new InputError("A score field exceeds the text limit.", 422);
      }
    }
  } });
  let rewriter = new HTMLRewriter().on(".score-tbl.finalscores", { element(el) {
    if (sections.length >= LIMITS2.tables) throw new InputError("Page exceeds the table limit.", 422);
    const current = { title: "", headers: {}, rows: [] };
    sections.push(current);
    section = current;
    el.onEndTag(() => {
      if (section === current) {
        section = void 0;
        row = void 0;
        field = void 0;
      }
    });
  } }).on(".score-tbl.finalscores .tbl-row:not(.poweredby-row)", { element(el) {
    if (!section) return;
    if (sections.reduce((n, s) => n + s.rows.length, 0) >= LIMITS2.rows) throw new InputError("Page exceeds the row limit.", 422);
    const current = {};
    section.rows.push(current);
    row = current;
    el.onEndTag(() => {
      if (row === current) row = void 0;
    });
  } });
  for (const [selector, key, destination] of [
    [".score-tbl.finalscores .score-division-name", "title", () => section],
    ...[[".col-2", "place"], [".col-7", "corps"], [".col-3", "score"]].flatMap(([column, key2]) => [
      [".score-tbl.finalscores .filter-cards .row > " + column + " > span", key2, () => section?.headers],
      [".score-tbl.finalscores .tbl-row:not(.poweredby-row) .row > " + column + " > span", key2, () => row]
    ])
  ]) {
    const { handler } = capture(selector, key, destination);
    rewriter = rewriter.on(selector, handler);
  }
  await rewriter.transform(new Response(page2)).arrayBuffer();
  return sections.filter((s) => s.rows.length).map((s, id) => {
    if (s.headers.place !== "Place" || s.headers.corps !== "Corps" || s.headers.score !== "Score") throw new InputError("DCI score headings changed; extraction stopped.", 422);
    const rows = s.rows.map((r) => [r.place, r.corps, r.score]);
    if (rows.some(([place, corps, score]) => !/^\d+$/.test(place || "") || !corps || !/^\d{1,3}\.\d{3}$/.test(score || "") || Number(score) > 100)) throw new InputError("DCI score layout or values changed; extraction stopped.", 422);
    return { id, title: s.title || "DCI final scores", headers: ["Place", "Corps", "Score"], rows, unsupported: null, extraction_method: "dci-final-scores" };
  });
}
async function inspectPage(page2) {
  const signals = { html_tables: 0, accessible_grids: 0, json_blocks: 0, linked_scripts: 0, app_roots: 0, password_fields: 0, layout_hints: 0, images: 0, canvases: 0, title: "" };
  let title = false;
  await new HTMLRewriter().on("table", { element() {
    signals.html_tables++;
  } }).on('[role="table"], [role="grid"]', { element(el) {
    if (el.tagName !== "table") signals.accessible_grids++;
  } }).on("script", { element(el) {
    const type = (el.getAttribute("type") || "").toLowerCase();
    if (["application/json", "application/ld+json"].includes(type)) signals.json_blocks++;
    if (el.hasAttribute("src")) signals.linked_scripts++;
  } }).on("#root, #app, #__next, #__nuxt", { element() {
    signals.app_roots++;
  } }).on("img", { element() {
    signals.images++;
  } }).on("canvas", { element() {
    signals.canvases++;
  } }).on('input[type="password"]', { element() {
    signals.password_fields++;
  } }).on("[class]", { element(el) {
    if (/(?:^|[\s_-])(table|tbl|score|grid|row)(?:$|[\s_-])/i.test(el.getAttribute("class") || "")) signals.layout_hints++;
  } }).on("title", { element(el) {
    title = true;
    el.onEndTag(() => {
      title = false;
    });
  }, text(chunk) {
    if (title && signals.title.length < 300) signals.title += chunk.text.slice(0, 300 - signals.title.length);
  } }).transform(new Response(page2)).arrayBuffer();
  signals.title = decodeHTML(signals.title).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  return signals;
}
function noDataReason(signals) {
  if (/access denied|just a moment|verify (you are|you're) human|attention required|sign in|log in/i.test(signals.title) || signals.password_fields) return {
    code: "possible_access_barrier",
    message: "The returned page contains a sign-in or verification indicator, and no supported data structure was found.",
    next_action: "Check the URL in your browser. Use a public source or an authorized export; this toolkit does not sign in or bypass verification."
  };
  if (signals.json_blocks) return {
    code: "embedded_data_detected",
    message: `Found ${signals.json_blocks} embedded JSON blocks but no supported table. These blocks may contain page metadata rather than the requested rows.`,
    next_action: "The next extraction option is a validated embedded-data adapter or a documented public API. No script was executed and no JSON was guessed into rows."
  };
  if (signals.app_roots && signals.linked_scripts) return {
    code: "possible_client_rendering",
    message: "Found an application container and linked scripts, but no supported rows in the returned HTML. The data may load after JavaScript runs; this is an indication, not a confirmed diagnosis.",
    next_action: "Look for an official export or public data endpoint. Browser rendering is not enabled, and the toolkit did not execute these scripts."
  };
  if (signals.layout_hints) return {
    code: "unsupported_page_layout",
    message: "Found table-like layout class names, but no HTML table, accessible grid, or matching supported adapter. Class names alone do not establish which values belong together.",
    next_action: "This page needs a validated layout adapter or explicit row/column selection. The toolkit stopped rather than guessing a dataset."
  };
  if (signals.images || signals.canvases) return { code: "visual_content_present", message: `Found ${signals.images} images and ${signals.canvases} canvas elements, but no supported dataset. Their presence does not prove the requested data is in a picture. Image contents were not read.`, next_action: "If the data is shown only as an image, OCR plus row/column verification is needed. OCR is not enabled. Prefer an official text or CSV export when available." };
  return { code: "no_supported_structure", message: "The page downloaded successfully, but no supported row-and-column structure was found. There is not enough evidence to say JavaScript or login is the cause.", next_action: "Check that this is the actual data page. Try a direct public table, an official export, or provide the page for a new adapter." };
}
async function analyzePage(page2, source, checks, { sourceImport = false } = {}) {
  const signals = await inspectPage(page2);
  const inventory = [], budget = { scanned: 0, accepted: 0, rows: 0, cells: 0 };
  let tables = await discoverTables(page2, false, { sourceImport, inventory, budget });
  const summarize = (label, items) => ({ step: label, status: items.length ? "found" : "not_found", message: items.length ? `${items.length} structures found; ${items.filter((t) => !t.unsupported).length} usable for preview and export.` : "No matching structures found in the returned HTML." });
  checks.push(summarize("HTML tables", tables));
  const accessible = await discoverTables(page2, true, { sourceImport, inventory, budget });
  checks.push(summarize("Accessible tables and grids", accessible));
  tables.push(...accessible);
  const u = new URL(source);
  if (["www.dci.org", "dci.org"].includes(u.hostname) && u.pathname.startsWith("/scores/final-scores/")) {
    const scores = await discoverDCIScores(page2);
    checks.push(summarize("DCI final-score adapter", scores));
    tables.push(...scores);
  } else checks.push({ step: "Supported site adapters", status: "not_applicable", message: "No site-specific adapter matches this URL." });
  const cells = tables.reduce((n, t) => n + t.rows.length * t.headers.length, 0);
  if (!sourceImport && tables.length > LIMITS2.tables || tables.reduce((n, t) => n + t.rows.length, 0) > LIMITS2.rows || cells > LIMITS2.cells) throw new InputError("Combined extraction exceeds the table, row or cell limit.", 422);
  checks.push({ step: "Embedded data", status: signals.json_blocks ? "found" : "not_found", message: `${signals.json_blocks} JSON blocks found. They may contain metadata rather than table rows; no dataset was inferred from them.` });
  checks.push({ step: "JavaScript indicators", status: signals.app_roots && signals.linked_scripts ? "indicated" : "checked", message: `${signals.linked_scripts} linked scripts and ${signals.app_roots} application containers found. Scripts were not executed; these clues do not confirm where data loads.` });
  checks.push({ step: "Images and canvas", status: signals.images || signals.canvases ? "found" : "not_found", message: `${signals.images} images and ${signals.canvases} canvas elements found. Their contents were not read; OCR is not enabled.` });
  const discovery = sourceImport ? { scanned_tables: signals.html_tables + signals.accessible_grids, inventory, ignored_tables: inventory.filter((t) => t.status === "ignored").length } : void 0;
  if (!tables.length) return { tables, signals, discovery, ...noDataReason(signals) };
  const usable = tables.filter((t) => !t.unsupported).length;
  return { tables: tables.map((t, id) => ({ ...t, id })), signals, discovery, code: usable ? "extracted" : "unsupported_table_structure", message: usable ? `${usable} usable datasets found.` : "Tables were found, but their structures are not supported yet.", next_action: usable ? "Choose a dataset to preview and export." : "Choose a table to see its specific issue, such as merged cells, nested tables or inconsistent columns." };
}
async function tablesAPI(request, url) {
  if (request.method !== "POST") return new Response("Method not allowed", { status: 405, headers: { ...SECURITY, Allow: "POST" } });
  const origin = request.headers.get("origin");
  if (origin && origin !== url.origin) return json({ error: "Cross-origin extraction is not supported." }, 403);
  if (!/^application\/json(?:;|$)/i.test(request.headers.get("content-type") || "")) return json({ error: "Send a JSON request." }, 415);
  const checks = [];
  let phase = "Request validation";
  try {
    if (Number(request.headers.get("content-length")) > 4096) throw new InputError("Request is too large.", 413);
    const reader = request.body?.getReader();
    const chunks = [];
    let bytes = 0;
    if (reader) {
      try {
        while (true) {
          const { value, done } = await reader.read();
          if (done) break;
          bytes += value.byteLength;
          if (bytes > 4096) {
            await reader.cancel();
            throw new InputError("Request is too large.", 413);
          }
          chunks.push(value);
        }
      } finally {
        reader.releaseLock();
      }
    }
    const text = await new Blob(chunks).text();
    let body;
    try {
      body = JSON.parse(text);
    } catch {
      throw new InputError("Invalid JSON request.");
    }
    if (!body || typeof body.url !== "string") throw new InputError("Provide a public HTTPS URL.");
    checks.push({ step: "Request validation", status: "passed", message: "A bounded JSON request with a URL was received." });
    phase = "Public page request";
    const { source, page: page2 } = await fetchPublicPage(body.url, url.hostname);
    checks.push({ step: phase, status: "passed", message: "Public HTTPS and DNS checks passed for the request and redirects. HTML downloaded within the size and time limits." });
    phase = "Structure detection";
    const result = await analyzePage(page2, source, checks);
    const diagnostics = { code: result.code, summary: result.message, next_action: result.next_action, checks, signals: result.signals };
    if (!result.tables.length) return json({ error: result.message, source, diagnostics }, 422);
    return json({ source, retrieved_at: (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toISOString(), tables: result.tables, diagnostics });
  } catch (error2) {
    const message2 = error2.name === "TimeoutError" || error2.name === "AbortError" ? "The source exceeded the 15-second request limit." : error2.message || "Table extraction failed.";
    checks.push({ step: phase, status: "failed", message: message2 });
    return json({ error: message2, diagnostics: { code: "extraction_stopped", summary: message2, next_action: phase === "Request validation" ? "Correct the request and try again." : "Resolve the failed check before retrying. A later extraction strategy cannot bypass an access or request-limit failure.", checks } }, error2.status || 502);
  }
}
var worker_default = {
  async fetch(request, env, ctx) {
    const accessDenied = await ownerAccess(request, env);
    if (accessDenied) return accessDenied;
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    if (request.method === "GET" && ["/workspace", "/workspace-client.js"].includes(url.pathname)) return new Response(url.pathname === "/workspace" ? WORKSPACE_PAGE : workspace_client_default, { headers: { ...SECURITY, "Cache-Control": "no-store", "Content-Security-Policy": "default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'none'", "Content-Type": url.pathname === "/workspace" ? "text/html; charset=utf-8" : "application/javascript; charset=utf-8" } });
    if (url.pathname === "/api/workspace") return workspaceAPI(request, env);
    if (url.pathname === "/api/interpretation/storage") return feedbackStorage(request, env);
    if (["/interpretation", "/interpretation-client.js", "/api/interpretation/start", "/api/interpretation/action", "/api/interpretation/select"].includes(url.pathname)) return labFetch(request);
    if (url.pathname === "/api/interpretation/fetch") return sourceFetch(request, url, env, { fetchPage: fetchPublicPage, analyze: analyzePage });
    if (url.pathname === "/api/tables") return tablesAPI(request, url);
    if (request.method !== "GET") return new Response("Method not allowed", { status: 405, headers: { Allow: "GET" } });
    if (url.pathname === "/example") return new Response(PAGE, { headers: { ...SECURITY, "Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" } });
    if (["/", "/workbench"].includes(url.pathname)) return new Response(WORKBENCH_PAGE, { headers: { ...SECURITY, "Cache-Control": "no-store", "Content-Security-Policy": "default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'", "Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" } });
    if (["/file-import.js", "/pdf.worker.mjs"].includes(url.pathname)) return new Response(url.pathname === "/file-import.js" ? fileClient : pdfWorker, { headers: { ...SECURITY, "Content-Type": "application/javascript; charset=utf-8", "Cache-Control": "no-cache" } });
    if (url.pathname === "/tables") return new Response(TABLE_PAGE, { headers: { ...SECURITY, "Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" } });
    if (!["/api/elements", "/elements.csv"].includes(url.pathname)) return json({ error: "Not found" }, 404);
    try {
      const key = new Request(new URL("/_cache/elements-v1", url.origin));
      let cached = await caches.default.match(key);
      let data;
      if (cached) data = await cached.json();
      else {
        const upstream = await fetch(SOURCE, { headers: { "User-Agent": `ElementExtractorDemo/0.1 (${url.origin})`, Accept: "text/html" }, redirect: "manual", signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15e3) });
        if (!upstream.ok) throw new Error(`Wikipedia returned HTTP ${upstream.status}. No automatic retry was made.`);
        if (!(upstream.headers.get("content-type") || "").includes("text/html")) throw new Error("Unexpected source content type.");
        const elements = await extract(upstream);
        data = {
          source: SOURCE,
          retrieved_at: (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toISOString(),
          count: elements.length,
          elements,
          attribution: "Wikipedia contributors, List of chemical elements; CC BY-SA 4.0",
          license: "https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/"
        };
        ctx.waitUntil(caches.default.put(key, new Response(JSON.stringify(data), { headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=86400" } })));
      }
      if (url.pathname === "/elements.csv") return new Response(toCSV(data.elements), { headers: {
        ...SECURITY,
        "Content-Type": "text/csv; charset=utf-8",
        "Content-Disposition": 'attachment; filename="chemical-elements.csv"',
        "X-Source-URL": SOURCE,
        "X-Retrieved-At": data.retrieved_at,
        "Cache-Control": "no-store"
      } });
      return json(data);
    } catch (error2) {
      return json({ error: error2.message || "Extraction failed. Try again later." }, 502);
    }
  }
